bluejetty:00165754:ios.name: NOCD: OCD Therapy and Tools
bluejetty:00165754:ios.summary: NOCD offers online OCD therapy and in-between session support, right in the NOCD platform. Get matched with a licensed OCD therapist in your state and do live, face-to-face video sessions with a therapist trained in exposure and response pr
bluejetty:00165754:ios.description:
NOCD offers online OCD therapy and in-between session support, right in the NOCD platform. Get matched with a licensed OCD therapist in your state and do live, face-to-face video sessions with a therapist trained in exposure and response prevention (ERP) therapy, the gold standard treatment for OCD. NOCD was created by people with OCD, along with some of the world's top experts.
Online therapy sessions with an OCD specialist:
- Match with an OCD therapist who fits your preferences
- Personalize your OCD treatment plan
- Do live video sessions with a therapist who specializes in exposure and response prevention (ERP) therapy, the gold standard treatment for OCD
Additional support between sessions:
- Use OCD therapy tools 24/7
- Message your therapist anytime
- Interact with a community who knows what you’re going through
- Dozens of weekly support groups with others in NOCD Therapy
WHAT IS OBSESSIVE COMPULSIVE DISORDER (OCD)?
OCD is a common psychiatric disorder that involves repetitive, unwanted thoughts that cause anxiety, and compulsive behaviors done in an attempt to reduce this anxiety. Commonly misunderstood as nothing more than a personality quirk, OCD usually involves intense distress and can become completely debilitating when left untreated.
IS NOCD THERAPY EFFECTIVE?
NOCD live video therapy has been shown to be as effective as face-to-face therapy. Our model has been backed by research from the Columbia University Medical Center, which found a reduction in OCD severity by an average of 40% in 8 weeks of NOCD Therapy.
WHO ARE NOCD THERAPISTS?
NOCD’s extensive therapist network includes licensed counselors, psychologists, and social workers. Every NOCD Therapist receives specialty training in exposure and response prevention (ERP) therapy, the most effective OCD treatment. All NOCD therapists are managed by our clinical leadership team of experts who have 20+ years of experience treating OCD and have designed some of the world’s top OCD treatment programs.
IS NOCD SECURE?
Our services are powered by AWS and Aptible, both of which are fully SOC2 and HIPAA compliant. Your therapy data is stored in our EHR that also complies with all HIPAA requirements. All medical notes and records are only accessible by you and your therapist. Furthermore, in addition to internal privacy safeguards, we regularly enlist security researchers to assess our services for vulnerabilities. For more information, find our complete Privacy Policy at https://www.treatmyocd.com/privacy-policy/, and Terms of Use at https://www.treatmyocd.com/terms/
Download the NOCD app today and schedule a free phone call with our care team to learn how we can help you regain your life from OCD.

bluejetty:00012791:ios.description:
Do more in less time with 25-minute blocks. Take it one block at a time and surprise yourself with how much you can accomplish. 
Inspired by tried and trusted time management techniques. Block & Flow is simple, beautiful and will get your productivity flowing. 
FEATURES:
- A 25-minute visual countdown keeps you focussed and avoiding distractions.
- Manage your energy levels with regular breaks
- Measure your day, week and longer by how many blocks you finish. 
- Colour code a block for the activities that you do often or care particularly about. 
- Goals enable you to be intentional with your time.
- History gives you an understanding of where your time goes. 
- A block’s duration can be changed to your ideal time.
WHY IT WORKS:
- It makes it easy to get the day started. Just do your first block.
- Creates an enjoyment and satisfaction as you see all that you get done. See your blocks build up one by one. 
- It is clear when to stop. Stop when your block has finished, or after you have done x many blocks for the day.
- Every block that you finish is a small success. As these small successes build-up, your self- belief grows. 
- If you keep finishing your blocks. The time will add up to a lot and you will surprise yourself. (We under-estimate what we can do in the long term). 
WHO IS IT FOR?
People tell me that they do x many blocks a day, or over a week which is fantastic. A few people have been completing their blocks for a year and more. I imagine someone completing their blocks over a month, a year and ultimately many years. I believe they will grow as a person, stretch themselves, and be surprised with what they are able to learn, create and accomplish. This is what excites me and motivates me to do my best for someone that chooses Block & Flow. 
What will you accomplish, one block at a time?
Happy Block & Flowing
Stefan

bluejetty:00153247:ios.description:
GRIND HERO – 2D CROSS-PLATFORM MMORPG WITH PVP, GUILDS AND EPIC ADVENTURES!
Get ready to dive into a nostalgic and challenging world in GRIND HERO – a 2D MMORPG made for players who love leveling up characters, exploring vast maps, and testing their skills in intense PvP battles!
PLAY ANYWHERE
Grind Hero is fully cross-platform, allowing you to play with the same account on both PC and mobile. Take your adventure with you wherever you go!
CLASSES AND EVOLUTION
Choose from 4 unique classes and unlock a powerful upgrade upon reaching level 20. Each class has its own playstyle, abilities, and battlefield role!
PARTIES AND GUILDS
Form parties with your friends or team up with other adventurers! Join a guild to take part in exclusive events, conquer territories, and grow as a team.
PVP WITH SKULL SYSTEM
Engage in PvP combat in dedicated areas! The skull system marks player killers, adding more risk and strategy to every encounter.
AUTOMATED BOSS EVENTS
Prepare for epic battles against bosses that spawn automatically across the world! Team up and fight for rare loot and glory.
SIGIL SYSTEM
Unlock and equip Sigils – unique passive abilities that enhance your strength, defense, speed, regeneration, and more. Customize your build to match your playstyle.
SKILL TRAINING SYSTEM
Leveling up is only part of the journey. Train your skills over time to become stronger and more efficient in combat.
A VAST WORLD FULL OF SECRETS
Explore a huge open world with diverse regions, immersive quests, hidden chests, and secrets waiting to be uncovered. There’s always something new to discover!
MAIN FEATURES:
• Lightweight and addictive 2D MMORPG
• Full cross-platform support (PC and Mobile)
• Party and guild systems
• PvP with skull system
• 4 classes with evolution at level 20
• Passive Sigils for deep customization
• Automated world boss events
• Real-time skill training
• Open map with quests, chests, and hidden content
Love grinding, exploring, fighting bosses and becoming a legend in a nostalgic 2D world? Grind Hero is for you!
Download now and begin your journey!

bluejetty:00116084:ios.description:
هل تستعد لاختبار القدرات العامة (قياس) وتبحث عن طريقة ذكية وفعّالة للتدريب؟
مجتهد هو رفيقك المثالي للوصول إلى أعلى الدرجات من خلال محاكاة حقيقية، محتوى محدث باستمرار، وتحليل دقيق لأدائك خطوة بخطوة.
لماذا مجتهد هو الخيار الأفضل؟
• تجميعات حديثة ومختارة بعناية تغطي اللفظي والكمي مع تحديثات مستمرة.
• اختبارات محاكاة واقعية بنتائج فورية وتحليل شامل يساعدك على فهم أخطائك وتقوية نقاط ضعفك.
• شروحات مبسّطة وملاحظات ذكية تعزز الفهم قبل الحفظ وتختصر عليك الوقت.
• لوحة تحليل متقدمة تعرض تطورك، متوسط زمن الحل، ونقاط القوة والضعف.
• مجموعات تدريب ونقاشات صوتية للتفاعل مع زملائك ومشاركة طرق الحل.
• نظام تحفيزي وجوائز يساعدك على الاستمرار والالتزام بخطة التدريب.
• تجربة تدريب مرنة تناسب كل الأوقات—اختبارات قصيرة أو محاكاة كاملة حسب جدولك.
كيف يساعدك مجتهد؟
ابدأ باختبار محاكاة، احصل على تحليل دقيق يناسب مستواك، ثم واصل التدريب عبر التجميعات والشروحات والنقاشات الصوتية… كل ما تحتاجه للوصول إلى درجتك المستهدفة في مكان واحد.
مجتهد — طريقك الأسرع للتفوّق في اختبار القدرات.
حمّله الآن وابدأ رحلتك نحو أعلى الدرجات!

bluejetty:00120189:ios.description:
Save time and money on your instrument flight training by mastering IFR holding pattern entries at the comfort of your own mobile device.
Make IFR flight training easier!
Is the following scenario familiar? You receive a holding clearance from ATC, and only have a couple of minutes, sometimes only a few seconds, to choose the correct entry. By the time you've figured out what's going on, you've already passed the holding fix and don't know what to do next.
If this sounds familiar, then you need not to worry. Confusion during holding entries happens to practically almost every new instrument student. Even instrument-rated pilots occasionally have the same problem — when they don't get enough practice.
Holding Trainer solves this problem and as a result, cuts the time you have to spend on expensive flight and ground lessons. With Holding Trainer, you can practice on your own time and convenience, so that choosing the best holding entry in the air becomes a breeze. 
Features: 
-Entry Trainer - Drills you on choosing the best holding entry. Practice until choosing holding entries becomes second nature and impress your flight instructor with your skills.
-Holding calculator. Solve and visualize any holding scenario by entering your current bearing to the fix and a outbound or inbound holding radial. 
-Holding tutorial - learn how to choose the best holding entry quickly and easily.
Holding Trainer for iOS is a complete rewrite based on my popular Flash-based desktop Holding Trainer app available on pilotscafe.com.
***Don't get "stuck" next time you receive a holding pattern clearance!***

listings.description:

Make IFR flight training easier!

Is the following scenario familiar? You receive a holding clearance from ATC, and only have a couple of minutes, sometimes only a few seconds, to choose the correct entry. By the time you've figured out what's going on, you've already passed the holding fix and don't know what to do next.

Holding Trainer solves this problem and as a result, cuts the time you have to spend on expensive flight and ground lessons. With Holding Trainer, you can practice on your own time and convenience, so that choosing the best holding entry in the air becomes a breeze. 


Features: 

-Entry Trainer - Drills you on choosing the best holding entry. Practice until choosing holding entries becomes second nature and impress your flight instructor with your skills.

-Holding calculator. Solve and visualize any holding scenario by entering your current bearing to the fix and a outbound or inbound holding radial. 

-Holding tutorial - learn how to choose the best holding entry quickly and easily.

Holding Trainer for iOS is a complete rewrite based on my popular Flash-based desktop Holding Trainer app available on pilotscafe.com.

***Don't get "stuck" next time you receive a holding pattern clearance!***

bluejetty:00013695:ios.description:
Online Bible: the ‘offline’ study bible app.
Mission-based Bible application that helps and encourages you to dive deeper into the Word of God. Easy to use, with advanced study features.
This app helps you read and study the Bible, find relevant passages, and get a better understanding by examining the Greek and Hebrew with Strong's numbers. Get a better understanding of the message of the Bible by using the different versions of the Bible.
This free app for iPad and iPhone comes standard with extensive content, including:
• Authorised (King James) Version with Strong’s Numbers
• New International Version 2011 (US-edition – anglicised edition free option)
• New American Standard Version 2020 (1995 edition free option)
• Amplified Bible 2015 with extensive footnotes
• Expanded Greek and Hebrew Lexicons
• Revised Easton’s Bible Dictionary
• Treasury of Scripture Knowledge Notes and Cross-References
• Thematic Studies and References
• and more
Plus many additional Bibles, commentaries and books. All free.
The Online Bible App is based on a mission to provide quality Bible resources to Christians, students, and pastors. In doing so, we support the ministries of those who cannot afford to purchase books for their ministry. By providing them with in-app study features, we are taking Bible reading beyond the capabilities of printed books.
## Online Bible Premium ##
In the application, we offer the opportunity to become a Professional Premium User. By doing so, you will help with the continuation and future development of the Online Bible app and the development of content in Spanish, Portuguese, French and other languages. This will have a great impact on Christians in Africa and Central and South America. In addition to supporting the mission, you will receive a range of additional content in your own language. This extra content is marked "professional" in the app.
Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period at the rate of your selected plan.
Current subscription may not be cancelled during the active subscription period; however, you can manage your subscription or turn off auto-renewal by visiting your iTunes Account Settings after purchase.
Privacy policy: https://onlinebible.com/privacy
Terms of use: https://onlinebible.com/terms-apple-sub

bluejetty:00115377:ios.description:
One song, one mood, your own AI music video.
Some things are hard to say out loud, and some moments deserve more than a spot in your camera roll.
Give a song to Sondo, add a photo or write down the story you want to tell, and the AI understands the rhythm, emotion, and lyrics in the music to generate the visuals, arrange the story, and finish the editing for you. In minutes, you can turn how you feel right now into a complete music video.
No film crew, no editing skills, and no aligning the music frame by frame. All you have to do is tell Sondo what you want to express.
Let the music tell your story
It could be longing for someone, a relationship that has ended, an unforgettable trip, or simply an emotion that suddenly surfaced today.
Sondo unfolds the story along with the music's emotion: when the melody grows quiet, the visuals slow down; when the chorus hits, the emotion is released along with the shots; and when the lyrics reach a key moment, the story responds on screen.
Your music is no longer just sound—it now has characters, emotion, and a story.
Make photos the star of your music video
Choose a photo of yourself, a friend, family, or your pet, and let the people in the photo step into the world of music.
With no filming required, you can turn an ordinary photo into a music video with movement, emotion, and a cinematic feel.
Create what you truly want to express
Here, you can:
Make a complete music video for your own original song so more people can hear and see your work;
Use a song to capture birthdays, trips, anniversaries, and important moments;
Turn your wedding memories into a love story you can replay anytime;
Make a music video that belongs only to you and someone you miss;
Express how you feel through creative visuals you can share;
Make a friend, family member, or pet the star of a music video;
Follow trending music to quickly make short videos with rhythm and a story.
More than music videos
AI music creation: Write a sentence, a story, or a few lines of lyrics, and the AI can generate an original song of your own. It supports many music styles including pop, rap, rock, and jazz, and you can go straight on to generate a music video.
Diverse visual expression: You can describe the mood you want, such as warm, lonely, passionate, romantic, or nostalgic. Based on your emotion, the AI chooses more fitting visuals and shots, rather than simply applying a single visual style.
Music can capture your experiences, and it can also express the things you never said out loud.
Let your music be not only heard, but also seen.
Terms of Service: https://www.sondo.ai/sondo-terms.html

invisaWear is perfect for:
 • College students,
 • Professionals working late night shifts or alone,
 • Runners active in rural areas, 
 • Seniors who don’t want to wear a bulky panic button, 
 • Travelers who want some peace of mind,
 • Anyone interested in wearable technology & safety, and
 • So many more!
invisaWear products are stylish, discreet, and easily accessible. They use Bluetooth Low Energy to automatically pair with your smartphone app. Here’s a list of awesome features we’ve designed just for you:

bluejetty:00063091:ios.description:
In the fast turn-based strategic battles you will be helped by the unique skills of your cards, you will deal crushing blows and strike the enemy with spells and magic to win. Whether you are a novice or a skillful strategist, you will easily master the game, feel its depth and excitement, and beautiful graphics and special effects will not leave you indifferent. The sharpened balance of the game will give you a thrill from fights with real rivals.
SEND TO THE ADVENTURE! The game begins with a fascinating journey in which you release the captured lands from enemies that keep the secrets of the ancient scrolls. The plot tasks will help you quickly learn, and in return, you will get new cards from chests and powerful artifacts.
COLLECT YOUR PERSON. Battles accumulated in battle will replenish your collection, which will grow with your skill. Develop your strategy, collect a deck that you like, and forward to victory!
Each card has three parameters:
- Health;
- Unique ability;
- Attack.
THE LEGENDARY ARENA. Participate in online battles in the arena against real players, get rewards for reaching new leagues and get to the list of the best.
TOURNAMENT OF GLORY. A weekly global event will give you emotions and a new gaming experience because each time the rules change a little. Think of the right strategy, take the prize place and everyone will know about it!
CLAN. You can create your own clan or join existing clans. The clan is a kind of castle with its buildings, improvements and bonuses. The citadel, the treasury, the building of the brotherhood of glory, the source of wisdom, the ancient altar and the silver mine are accessible to construction. Do the tasks with the clan of the clan and get a clan chest with bonuses to the level of cards. Collect the best heroes who, with the help of sword and magic, will lead your clan to victory!
CHAMPIONSHIP. Every week there is a full-scale battle in which the best players of the server are determined, among all countries. The best players get great prizes, for example, +1 level to any card from your deck.
Honor skill, use different tactics, collect an epic deck of cards and who knows, maybe you will become a Legend?
HEROES / CARDS:
- WARLOCK - ability to reduce enemy attack
- TITAN - every new round increases its attack and health parameters
- PHOENIX - after death, 1 time rebounds in the next round
- ENGINEER - at death, inflicts damage on all enemies
- ASSASSIN - in the first round the damage was doubled
- VAMPIRE- restores his health when attacking the heroes of the enemy
- ASP - inflicts non-healed damage to enemy cards, poisonous attack
- SHADOW - damage from long-range attacks reduced by half
- MAG - attacks any 2 targets
- ANGEL - resurrects an ally with 50% health and dies
- PALADIN - heals 1 ally and has good armor
- HEALER - heals 2 allies;
- DRUID - heals 3 allies;
- HOLY - sacrifices himself, increasing ally's health
- DOCTOR - the most effective treatment of 1 ally
- SHAMAN - attacks anyone in his line, passively heals allies
- HUNTER - attacking himself or next
Collect your best deck in CCI / CCG and hit the top!
Features:
* This is a collectible card game CCG / TCG, with elements of RPG and strategy
* Fast card battles last only 2-3 mins
* Languages: English, German, French, Italian, Spanish, Russian, Polish, Portuguese
* The game takes place online, so you need an Internet connection to play with your friends
* Having problems? Write about it in the Help section of our in-game forum and we’ll make sure to help you
* We recommend 1GB or more of RAM and a CPU of at least 1.2GHz
* Requires less than 1GB of memory on your device.
* Contact us at support@skytecgames.com
* Agreement: http://www.skytecgames.com/terms-of-service.html
* Privacy Policy: http://www.skytecgames.com/privacy-policy.html

bluejetty:00148912:ios.description:
Want to quickly unlock your strongest, healthiest body and mind? 
When you join InsideTracker, you enter a guided program that turns your blood, DNA, and fitness tracker data into simple, science-backed recommendations. 
It’s effective, but not complicated. Think high-impact rather than high effort. 
After one blood test: 
• 80% of people improve at least one at-risk biomarker
• 60% of people reduce their InnerAge
• 75% improve at least one Healthspan Category Score (such as fitness, sleep, or hormone health)
Download the app to start your membership.
TRACK EVERYTHING
Your data unlocks your recommendations—which is why InsideTracker goes so deep. 
You’ll track your blood, DNA, nutrition, and fitness tracker data in one place. You’ll also self-report information such as dietary preferences, supplement intake, and workout habits.
For blood and DNA testing, you can purchase tests through us, or you can upload data you already have from another provider.
FOLLOW YOUR PERSONALIZED ACTION PLAN
As a member, you’ll receive a personalized Action Plan complete with foods, supplements, exercises, and other healthy habits. 
All of your recommendations will be based on a curated body of research that includes thousands of clinical studies. 
VALIDATE YOUR HEALTHY CHOICES 
With repeat blood testing, you’ll quickly see the impact of each recommendation. 
You’ll learn exactly what works and what doesn’t, and over time, you’ll develop a sixth sense about how your body responds to different foods, supplements, and training routines. 
BUILD YOUR MOTIVATION
Most health plans fail as soon as people start feeling lost. InsideTracker won’t let that happen. We’ll keep you on track with ongoing support.
Along with your Action Plan, you’ll get: 
• Weekly Healthspan Habit Reports
Keep your routine dialed in with one personalized habit to focus on every 7 days.
• Daily ProTips
Access spontaneous moments of health with real-time recommendations based on your sleep, workouts, and other activities.
• InnerAge
Slow or reverse your aging with an analysis of your body’s true age—plus recommendations to drive it lower.
• Terra
Become an expert in your body by talking to a personalized AI guide that has access to your health data.
• Healthspan Category Scores
Focus on what matters most with blood tests and analysis for 10 key health areas, including fitness, sleep, inflammation, and hormone health.
• Nutrition DeepDive
Improve your sleep, workout recovery, and overall energy with your personalized nutrition and meal-timing report.
ABOUT INSIDETRACKER
InsideTracker was founded in Cambridge, Mass., in 2009 by experts in aging, genetics, and biology. Today, it's the industry leader in personalized health. 
Using blood, DNA, fitness, and nutrition data, it provides personalized recommendations for living longer, looking younger, and achieving peak performance. 
Whether you're an athlete, professional, or parent, InsideTracker can deliver peak health in a way that fits seamlessly into your life.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00062631:ios.summary: Reading Eggs is the multi-award winning learning program that helps children learn to read. Based on scientific research and designed by experienced elementary teachers, it’s proven to help kids learn to read using interactive reading games
bluejetty:00062631:ios.description:
Reading Eggs is the multi-award winning learning program that helps children learn to read. Based on scientific research and designed by experienced elementary teachers, it’s proven to help kids learn to read using interactive reading games, guided reading lessons, fun activities, and over 4,000 e-books. 
Reading Eggs has already helped over 20 million children worldwide learn to read. 
Access all our premium learning programs for up to four children:
• Reading Eggs Junior (ages 2–4): Toddlers build pre-reading skills such as phonemic awareness and alphabet knowledge with fun activities, games, videos, and read-aloud books. 
• Reading Eggs (ages 3–7): Children take their first steps in learning to read, covering phonics, sight words, spelling, vocabulary, and comprehension. 
• Fast Phonics (ages 5–10): A systematic, synthetic phonics program to help emergent and struggling readers build key phonics skills. 
• Reading Eggspress (ages 7– 13): Continues the learning journey by helping children learn to read for meaning and enjoyment. 
• Mathseeds (ages 3–9): Develops essential early numeracy skills, covering numbers, measurement, shapes, patterns, and more. 
ABOUT THE READING EGGS LEARN TO READ APP 
• TRUSTED: used in over 12,000 schools and trusted by elementary educators. 
• SELF-PACED: children are matched to the perfect level and progress with self-paced, one-on-one lessons. 
• HIGHLY MOTIVATING: the reward system consists of golden eggs, collectable pets, and games, motivating children to keep learning. 
• RESEARCH-BASED: based on scientific research and the most up-to-date learning principles on the most effective way children learn to read. 
• COMPREHENSIVE: Reading Eggs is a complete learn to read system for children aged 2–13 and covers the five essential components of reading: phonics, phonemic awareness, vocabulary, fluency, and comprehension. 
• PROVEN RESULTS: our hundreds of testimonials, multiple awards, 91% success rate AND money-back guarantee gives you the confidence in knowing that your child will learn to read using the most effective and results-driven online reading curriculum. 
• SEE REAL PROGRESS: see instant results in your very own parent dashboard and receive detailed progress reports, which show you exactly where your child is improving and where extra attention is needed. 
• LEARN TO READ ON THE GO! Your child can learn to read anytime, anywhere on a desktop or tablet device. 
Users must log in with their account details to access Reading Eggs. 
Min requirements: 
• Wireless internet connection 
• iPad (5th Generation), iPad Air 2, iPad Pro 1st Generation 
• iPad Mini 4 
• iPhone - last 5 models of iPhone 
• OS Version - iOS 15.8+ 
• An active trial or subscription 
Recommended devices and iOS version: 
• Latest iPad, Latest iPad Air, Latest iPad Pro 
• Latest iPad Mini 
• Latest iPhone 
• Latest iOS Version 
Note: Teacher accounts are currently not supported 
For assistance or feedback email: info@readingeggs.com 
More Information:
• Up to 4 children are covered under a single family subscription
• Each Reading Eggs and Mathseeds subscription provides access to Reading Eggs Junior, Reading Eggs, Fast Phonics, Reading Eggspress and Mathseeds 
• Each Reading Eggs subscription provides access to Reading Eggs Junior, Reading Eggs, Fast Phonics and Reading Eggspress 
• The first month of a monthly subscription is free for new customers
• Subscriptions renew automatically; your App Store account will be charged unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period 
• Cancel anytime in your App Store account settings 
Privacy Policy: http://readingeggs.com/privacy/ 
Terms and Conditions: http://readingeggs.com/terms/

bluejetty:00041178:ios.description:
Life moves fast. Your soul doesn’t.
The Pause App offers a simple way to step out of the noise, release what you’re carrying, and reconnect with God in the middle of your busy day.
Built around short, guided pauses, the app helps you slow down, breathe, and return to a grounded place of peace and presence. 
Whether you have one minute or ten, these gentle moments create space for your soul to recover.
Inspired by the practice shared in Get Your Life Back, Resilient, and Experience Jesus. Really., the Pause App began as a tool our team used every day—and has become a daily rhythm for people around the world.
What you can do with the Pause App
• Take short “Pauses” to reset your mind and heart
 - Choose from 1-, 3-, 5-, or 10-minute sessions designed to help you let go, recenter, and reconnect with God.
• Build simple daily rhythms
 - Set reminders that fit your life—morning, evening, or anytime you need a breath.
• Check in with your soul
 - A quick, guided way to name where you are and receive a gentle next step.
• Go deeper with guided programs
 - Explore multi-day journeys like 30 Days to Resilient and Experience Jesus. Really.—designed to strengthen your inner life and help you walk with God in a grounded, honest way.
Why people love the Pause
The Pause App is simple on purpose.
No pressure. No performance. Just small, honest moments to breathe again, reconnect with God, and recover the life of your soul.
If you’re feeling tired, overwhelmed, distracted, or simply hungry for a deeper connection with God in the flow of real life, the Pause is a gentle place to begin.

bluejetty:00121633:ios.description:
WinAI brings AI predictions, live data, and match analysis for soccer, American football, basketball, and baseball into one clean match center. Every prediction comes with the numbers behind it, so you can see not only what the AI expects, but why.
AI PREDICTIONS FOR EVERY MATCH
- Match result, total goals or points, first half, cards, and more
- A probability, fair odds, and a confidence bar on every prediction
- AI pick of the day, highlighted on your home screen
- Predictions lock at kick-off, and finished matches show which picks were right and which were wrong
PLAYER PROPS
- AI player predictions with over/under lines
- Recent hit history for each player
- Confidence levels for every prop
LIVE MATCH CENTER
- Live scores, momentum, and an event timeline
- Expected goals (xG) for soccer matches
- Live AI predictions that update as the match unfolds
- Alerts for your favorite teams' matches
EVERYTHING ABOUT THE MATCH IN ONE PLACE
- Lineups, standings, head-to-head records, and recent form
- Box scores, player stats, injuries, and starting pitchers where available
- League pages with fixtures, results, and tables
- Team pages with upcoming matches and recent results
A TRANSPARENT TRACK RECORD
WinAI shows how its predictions performed yesterday, sport by sport, so you can judge the results for yourself.
ASK WINAI
Premium members can chat with the WinAI Analyst about any upcoming or live match. Get a written match reading, key factors, and the strongest angles, then ask your own follow-up questions. Premium includes 3 match analyses per day. Additional analyses are available as optional in-app purchases of AI credits.
MADE FOR YOU
- Pick your favorite sports, leagues, and teams
- Choose decimal, fractional, or American odds formats
- Set a daily notification time
- No account required
PREMIUM SUBSCRIPTION
WinAI is free to download. Premium unlocks all predictions, player props, live AI predictions, and Ask WinAI, and removes ads. Premium is offered as weekly, monthly, and annual auto-renewing subscriptions.
- Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase.
- Your subscription renews automatically unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
- Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period.
- You can manage or cancel your subscription in your Apple Account settings after purchase.
IMPORTANT
WinAI provides sports predictions and statistics for informational and entertainment purposes only. WinAI does not accept bets or wagers of any kind. Predictions are not guaranteed and past results do not guarantee future outcomes. You must be 18 or older to use WinAI. If you choose to bet, please do so responsibly and in accordance with the laws where you live.

bluejetty:00121673:ios.description:
Eek eek! It’s time to release the King Kong inside you! Get ready to really MONKEY IT OUT in this amazing clicker evolution game! Combine different and awesome kinds of monkeys and go beyond your imagination mixing up these crazy fun clowns of the jungle!

• Impostors: watch out for impostors trying to steal the spotlight from the monkeys

• Drag and drop similar monkeys to create new mysterious creatures
• Use monkey poop coins to buy new creatures and make even more money
• Alternatively, fiercely tap a monkey to make coins pop when they poop

Bu
bluejetty:00079503:ios.description:
Welcome to the engaging and addictive RPG game, "Last Base: Zombie Survival". Immerse yourself in a post-apocalyptic world where survival is everything, and every decision you make shapes the fate of your base and its brave survivors.
But don't let the gathering aspect fool you, your base needs constant defense against the relentless hordes of zombies. Construct a solid shelter using various building materials and defensive structures, while setting cunning traps to catch the unsuspecting undead off guard. Plan your defenses strategically, considering the strengths and weaknesses of these monsters. Your base must be impenetrable!
However, defense isn't the only priority. Assemble a skilled team of survivors, each with unique abilities and specialties, to fight alongside you. Train them, equip them with powerful weapons and armor, and unleash their full potential to protect your base from both zombies and other hostile factions. Each survivor plays a vital role in your fight for survival and exploration of the dangerous world around you.
As you progress, venture beyond your base and explore uncharted territories. 
"Last Base: Zombie Survival" offers visually stunning and immersive gameplay with its detailed graphics, realistic environments, and captivating sound design. 
Navigate seamlessly through the game with intuitive controls and enjoy the thrilling experience at every turn.
Adapt your strategies to the ever-changing conditions, exploit the environment, and use your ingenuity to overcome challenges.
With its extensive features, "Last Base: Zombie Survival" provides endless possibilities for players seeking an exciting gaming experience. Whether you're a fan of base-building, fighting, or adventure, this game has something for everyone. So gear up, fortify your base, and embark on an epic adventure where survival and conquest go hand in hand. Will you triumph over the wastelands and establish your dominance, or will you succumb to the perils of this zombie-infested world? 
The choice is yours.

Yeah, that was a keyword dump. We did it on purpose so you can actually find us. Here's the real stuff:
Quick Start
Download the app, confirm your phone number and verify your identity using Diia or your ID documents. You get a virtual card in the app right after registration, and a physical card can be delivered to you through Nova Poshta or Ukrposhta
Cards for EveryDay Life
Debit and credit cards, currency cards for dollars and euros, a unified Diia.Card for government payments and a child’s card with parental controls. Contactless payments with Apple Pay — add your card to your wallet and pay with your phone
Credit Online
Apply for a credit limit in the app. The decision is made after reviewing your data, terms, rates and limits are shown before confirmation
Split Payments
Buy electronics and other goods at partner stores: installments are available, with terms shown before you confirm the purchase. Turn past purchases into parts — you get the money back on your card and repay it gradually
Transfers and Smart payments
Money transfer to a card or account, transfers by phone number, international transfers. Pay bills in a few taps: electricity, gas, water, internet, TV, mobile top-up and fines. Zero fees, and the transfer status is visible in the app. Send money with ease
Currency Exchange
Buy and sell currency online — the exchange rate is shown before you confirm
Deposit
Open a deposit in a minute; rates and terms are available in the app. Government bonds are also available in mono
Cashback
Choose categories every month and get cashback on groceries, taxi, fuel, cafes, books, sports plus, and entertainment under the program terms. Additional offers with WOG Pride
Business Portal and SP for Work
Open a Business Portal for entrepreneurs (SP) online: control taxes, reports and payments without paperwork — in the same banking app.
Insurance
Car insurance (MTPL and Green Card) issued online in minutes. Policy terms are shown before payment
Banka
Create a Banka to collect money for charity, community initiatives, or shared goals with friends and family
monomarket and monobazar
An in-app market for new goods with installment options, plus a marketplace for pre-owned items — buy and sell without leaving the app. Shop smart, whatever your budget
eSIM
Connect an eSIM — a digital alternative to a physical SIM card — right in the app
Also in the app
Track spending, manage group expenses with friends, accept payments from your phone. Support in chat, 24/7
Transparent terms
Fees, limits and rates are always visible in the app before you confirm a transaction. Credit terms depend on a review of your data and the bank's decision.

bluejetty:00127247:ios.description:
PhotoMeister is a revolutionary slideshow app that displays pictures and videos on your Smart TV. Avoid having unused photos and videos taken during special moments. Discover this app to quickly get the most out of your captured memories.
You can now create spectacular slideshows in record time. Use the impressive transitions, music, and effects. Now your photos and videos really come to life. 
Amaze family, friends and colleagues by sharing your personalized slideshow. It’s super easy!
Effortlessly admire your slideshow on your Smart TV. PhotoMeister automatically recognizes your TV on your home network, making it very easy for you. It's a piece of cake!
Select your footage without hassle, add effects and enjoy wonderful memories. Watch them on the big screen or share them on social media.
Develop your talent, improve your pics and vids and make the most of your unforgettable moments.
PhotoMeister functionalities:
■ Combine countless pictures & videos.
■ Play slideshows on Smart TVs.
■ Add amazing music.
■ Accurately cut your videos.
■ Adjust the playback speed.
■ Express yourself with epic themes.
■ Adjust, fill or rotate images.
■ Share media with loved ones.
PhotoMeister Instructions:
1) Make sure your device is connected to the same network as your TV. 
2) PhotoMeister scans your network and will automatically find your TV. 
3) Select a TV.
4) Allow access to your photo library.
5) Click + to create a new slideshow.
6) Start selecting your pictures and videos, use the slideshow and it will start on your Smart TV.
What you can do with PhotoMeister app:
- Get the most of your media with customised slideshows.
- Enjoy your imagery on big Smart TVs, from all major brands. Including Samsung, LG, Sony, Hisense, Philips, Panasonic, Chromecast, Roku and many more.
- Export it via social media & excite friends, family & co-workers. 
- Create your own style with special effects.
NO ADS / NO WATERMARK PRO SUBSCRIPTION

Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase.

bluejetty:00065513:ios.description:
Es gibt so vieles, was das Leben voller macht. Deswegen möchten wir von BILLA den Menschen das Leben einfacher machen. So verhelfen wir Ihnen zu mehr Zeit für die wirklich wichtigen Dinge im Leben. In unserer BILLA App finden Sie unseren Online Shop, Bons, Gutscheine und natürlich auch Ihre jö Bonus Club Karte.
Mit diesen Funktionen sorgt die BILLA App für ein volleres Leben:
- Lebensmittel entspannt im Online Shop bestellen
- Bons und Rabatte einfach mobil einlösen
- jö Bonus Club Karte & Vorteile immer dabei
- BILLA Marktfinder nutzen
- Einfach online bezahlen
- Aktuelle Flugblätter durchblätten
BILLA Online Shop
Mit dem BILLA Online Shop sparen Sie sich jede Menge Zeit und das Tragen der Einkäufe übernehmen wir gerne für Sie. Zu entdecken gibt es im Online Shop über 12.000 Produkte. Ihren Einkauf liefern wir direkt vor die Haustüre oder Sie bestellen per Click & Collect – dann können Sie Ihren Einkauf in einem unserer Märkte abholen. Online können Sie mit Kreditkarte, PayPal und auf Rechnung zahlen. Alle jö Bonus Club Vorteilsbons und Ihren Rabattsammler können Sie natürlich auch im Online Shop einlösen.
jö Bonus Club Karte
Mit der BILLA App haben Sie Ihre jö Bonus Club Karte immer dabei und können diese einfach an der Kassa am Smartphone herzeigen. In der App können Sie alle Vorteile der Karte nutzen. Außerdem können Sie den aktuellen Stand Ihrer Ös und Ihres Rabattsammlers abfragen und Gutscheine über Ihr Smartphone einlösen.
Rabatte und Bons
Mit der BILLA App haben Sie Ihre Rabattgutscheine und Bons immer mit dabei. Einfach am Handy auswählen und direkt an der Kassa im Markt vorzeigen oder beim Einkaufen in der App einlösen.
Flugblatt
Unser Flugblatt lässt sich über die BILLA App auch unterwegs durchstöbern - dort finden Sie die neuesten Angebote, Aktionen und Rabatte.
Marktfinder
Der nächste BILLA Markt ist sicher ganz nah. Mit unserem Marktfinder werden alle Märkte in der Nähe angezeigt. Dort finden Sie auch die Adresse, Telefonnummer und die Öffnungszeiten des Marktes. Außerdem gibt es Informationen zur Verfügbarkeit von Parkplätzen, Barrierefreiheit oder Elektrotankstellen.
Mobil bezahlen
Das Bezahlen ist mit Kredit- oder Debitkarte, mit Apple Pay, per Kauf auf Rechnung oder mit PayPal möglich.
Ihre Produkte jederzeit griffbereit
Füllen Sie Ihren wöchentlichen Warenkorb auf zeitsparende Weiße. Durch gespeicherte Lieblings-Artikel in Ihren Favoriten ersparen Sie sich umständliche Einkaufslisten.

Kada otvoriš aplikaciju primjetićeš izmjene u vizuelnom identitetu koji ide u korak sa trendovima i našim našim novim brendom. Uz to, unaprijedili smo i funkcionalnosti i strukturu aplikacije tako da možeš lakše da pronađeš i aktiviraš usluge koje želiš da koristiš. 
Nova navigacija. 
Sada još lakše i brže možeš da pronađeš uslugu koja ti je potrebna jer smo unaprijedili strukturu navigacije. Umjesto menija koji se ranije nalazio sa lijeve strane sada imaš jasan pregled svih sekcija aplikacije na dnu ekrana. Takođe smo ukinuli horizontalnu navigaciju u tabovima na desno i sve opcije u sklopu unutrašnjeg menija poređali po logičkim cjelinama radi lakšeg pristupa.
Korišćenje menija
Otkrij, izaberi, aktiviraj.
Kada klikneš na neku od opcija prikazaće ti se spisak svih usluga u okviru izabrane sekcije, a zatim izaberi i aktiviraj uslugu koju želiš, sve u tri klika!
Pristup svim svojim brojevima
Unaprijedili smo i opciju pomoću koje možeš da se prebaciš i upravljaš bilo kojim svojim brojem u našoj mreži. U gornjem lijevom uglu ekrana sada imaš mogućnost da izabereš broj za koji želiš da provjeriš stanje ili aktiviraš neki dodatak. Promjenu na drugi broj možeš uraditi i sa stranice Profil.
Stranica profil
Unaprijeđena verzija aplikacija sada ima i stranicu Profil gdje možeš da pronađeš sve informacije o svom broju i ugovoru.

bluejetty:00119388:ios.description:
My Eyes Only® is the ultimate password manager and personal information organizer.  Knowing that your data is safe, even if your phone is lost or stolen, gives you peace of mind. 
With My Eyes Only®, you can store all your sensitive information, from website passwords and credit card information to insurance and bank accounts. Plus, My Eyes Only® makes accessing your data on any of your iOS devices easy. With our multi-device syncing, your information is always with you, no matter where you are. And with secure cloud backup, you'll never have to worry about losing your data again. Plus, you can even share your data with a loved one on their device.
But what really sets My Eyes Only® apart is the advanced encryption technology. With password protection, and powerful 256-bit AES encryption, you can have peace of mind knowing that your data is safe, even if your phone is lost or stolen. Not even we can see or access your data.
With over 15 years of continuous service, we have been helping people like you keep their critical information safe and organized. Countless customers have been using My Eyes Only® non-stop for 15 years, and we are proud of it!
Try Before You Buy
- Free to download; add up to 20 items before deciding if you want to purchase a subscription
- Auto-renewing subscription, pay once for all your devices and have access to all the features you need.
Features
- User-friendly interface with pre-defined categories and the ability to create custom categories
- Store all your sensitive information, from website passwords and credit card information to insurance and bank accounts.
- Multi-Device syncing and Secure Cloud Backup keep your information always available, no matter where you are.
- Share your data with a loved one on their device
Security
You can have peace of mind knowing that your data is safe, even if your phone is lost or stolen. Not even we can see or access your data.
- Advanced encryption technology
- Password protection
- Powerful 256-bit AES encryption
- Additional layer of keychain security,
Long-term Support
We are committed to supporting My Eyes Only® well into the future, so you can have peace of mind knowing that your data will always be available to you.
----------------------------------------------------------
Auto-Renewing Subscription
Your subscription will automatically renew each month or year, and your credit card will be charged through your iTunes account. You can turn off auto-renew at any time from your iTunes account settings.

bluejetty:00070277:ios.summary: Insecta provides an engaging way to explore the wonderful world of insects. It includes a collection of weird and colorful insects, each featuring a description, habitat information, and a gallery of photos. You’re able to interact with hig
bluejetty:00070277:ios.description:
Insecta provides an engaging way to explore the wonderful world of insects. It includes a collection of weird and colorful insects, each featuring a description, habitat information, and a gallery of photos. You’re able to interact with highly detailed 3D models of each insect and hang out with them in augmented reality.
The app’s amazing AR experience enhances users’ learning experience too. Choose from more than twenty insects from the collection and, in the blink of an eye, you’ll find one of those creepy creatures hanging out right by your desk. If your friends don’t believe you, take a picture and send it to them. You can also identify insects you encounter in the real world by taking a photo or uploading one from your gallery, allowing Insecta to analyze the image and help identify the insect. Once identified, explore detailed information, images, interactive 3D models, and even place the insect in your space using augmented reality for an up-close learning experience.
Access to all insects and future updates with Explorer:
The Explorer is an auto-renewing subscription. Payment for Explorer subscription will be charged to your Apple ID account at the confirmation of purchase. The subscription will renew automatically unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You can manage and cancel your subscriptions at any time by going to your account settings on the App Store after purchase.

bluejetty:00087298:ios.summary:

“I've been present at dinner, I'm not using my phone while
bluejetty:00087298:ios.description:
"I have much better sleep, and slower mornings." Sara P., Unpluq Customer
"I use the phone less during family rush hours (morning and evening), also to set a good example for them."
“I've been present at dinner, I'm not using my phone while driving, and I'm not scrolling my phone in the middle of the night.” - Kim Trinh, Unpluq Customer
"I read an entire book on Sunday, went to hot yoga, made a mushroom and endive galette, and finished my vision board in the week since I started using Unpluq." - Sarah S., Unpluq Customer
Unpluq helps you take control of your time, be mindful and digital detox from your phone. Turn your phone into a dumbphone when you want. By interrupting your automatic phone pickups, you'll recover time, focus, and attention by making a conscious choice to access apps. Use your phone on your terms. Unpluq customers save more than 1 hour and 26 minutes a day of screen time.* 
How does it work?
Select which apps to block, and when. If you need to access a blocked app, make a conscious choice to open it by passing through an Unpluq Distraction Barrier–a digital key that makes you think twice and ensure you really do want to open that app.
Use Unpluq to:
- Block distracting apps and notifications–by default
- Choose what times you want apps blocked
- Choose only the apps you want to block
- Unblock apps by making a conscious decision with an Unpluq distraction barrier 
- Select the distraction barrier you prefer, or go RANDOM to make it harder
- Choose how hard each distraction barrier is
- Block different apps on different schedules
Choose your distraction barrier:
- Shake your phone for some time
- Tap a random pattern of buttons
- Scroll through blank space
- Randomly pick one of the above barriers
- Scan a unique QR code
- Use your Unpluq Tag on your keychain
Block apps when you need to:
- Stay focused
- Focus during work
- Disconnect after hours
- Be present for family meals
- Avoid working on the weekends
- Study uninterrupted
- Be more mindful every day
- Sleep and rest well
- Stop phubbing
- Reduce stress
- Lower anxiety 
Use your newly recovered free time to:
- See friends
- Workout
- Side hustle
- Read books
Unpluq helps you focus on what’s important in your life, without phone distraction. No more meals with family and friends staring at your phones.
Unpluq Premium Subscription
With Unpluq Premium, you’ll save 2x as much time.
- Unlimited: block apps–as many as you like, up to 50 per schedule
- Unlimited: schedules–work schedule, weekend schedule, you decide what works best for you
- Whitelist contacts, so notifications from them always get through
- All Barriers: Use all the available barrier options, including the patented Unpluq Tag, the keyfob that keeps you focused, as well as Scrolling, Random, or QR code barriers.
Unplug Free: Available to Everyone
With Unpluq Free, get off your screen, and back into your life.
- Block 2 apps
- 1 Schedule–all the time, during work, on the weekend, or after hours–whatever time you choose
- 2 Barriers: Choose to tap buttons or shake your phone to unblock apps
The Unpluq Tag 
Do you have an Unpluq Tag? Pair your Tag with your Unpluq app anytime to save more time. The NFC powered yellow Tag fits on your keychain and works with your app. Science like Rational Override Theory shows that this physical ritual to get virtual control of your phone is the most effective way to change your screen time habits. 
*The average Unpluq customer in May 2023 saves 1 hour 22 minutes a day.
Privacy 
We care about your privacy and take steps to protect it. Unpluq does not sell or share your data–personal or not. Having our customer’s with privacy in mind and protecting them is one of our core values. See Privacy Policy: https://www.unpluq.com/privacy-policy 
Payments & Subscriptions Terms of Use
This app offers both in-app purchases as well as subscriptions. For the Terms of Use, please see https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00125735:ios.name: Yalla Ludo - Ludo&Jackaroo
bluejetty:00125735:ios.summary: Yalla Ludo is a vibrant app that fuses classic board games—Ludo, Jackaroo, and Domino—with real-time voice chat! Whether you're in the mood for gameplay or hoping to connect with new friends in a lively voice chat room, Yalla Ludo delivers
bluejetty:00125735:ios.description:
Yalla Ludo is a vibrant app that fuses classic board games—Ludo, Jackaroo, and Domino—with real-time voice chat! Whether you're in the mood for gameplay or hoping to connect with new friends in a lively voice chat room, Yalla Ludo delivers a truly immersive experience.
[Voice Chat with Friends]
Enjoy real-time voice chat that lets you share tips and tricks with fellow gamers anytime, anywhere. Make new friends while having fun! Add personality to your gameplay with expressive voice chat.
[Various Game Modes]
Ludo: Choose between 2&4 Players mode and Team mode. Each mode has 4 gameplays: Classic, Master, Quick, and Arrow. You can also use Magic tools to make the game more fun! 
Domino: Play in 2&4 Players mode, each featuring two gameplays: Draw Game and All Five.
Others: More new games are waiting for you.
[Brand New Jackaroo]
Get ready for fast-paced Jackaroo gameplay! Pick from a variety of game modes (Basic, Complex, and Quick), and team up with friends to claim victory. Make your moves even more fun by expressing yourself with lively game stickers!
[Voice Chat Room]
Join the global public chat room, where you can connect with people from all over the world. Chat freely, share ideas, and send cute gifts! Broaden your network of friends and enjoy a relaxing time.
[Generous Rewards Await You]
Yalla Ludo offers multiple daily activities. Complete game or chat room tasks to earn various rewards (such as golds, diamonds, skin fragments, and gifts, etc). With daily tasks and arrival chests, you'll always find something exciting!
Yalla Ludo connects you with others, so let's enjoy the joyful moments in Yalla Ludo!
Subscribe to Yalla Ludo VIP to enjoy the extra advanced features:
Collect free daily golds, diamonds, and VIP daily benefits.
Privileged game room: create your room in the VIP room, invite others to play together, and have more options for bets.
-----------------------------------
If you choose to subscribe to Yalla Ludo VIP, the purchase will be billed to your iTunes account.
Your iTunes account will be charged automatically for the renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period.
You can manage and cancel your subscriptions at any time by going to your iTunes Account Settings after purchase.
Ludo VIP includes two types: Knight and Baron. The price for Knight is USD 11.99/month and the price for Baron is USD 39.99/month. Prices are in U.S. dollars, may vary in countries other than the U.S. and are subject to change without notice.
No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during the active subscription period. You could still have great fun in Yalla Ludo without becoming a Yalla Ludo VIP.
We will continue to give our best shot to provide you with more fun games which will enrich your daily life.
Privacy Policy: https://www.yallaludo.com/term/EN/TermOfService.html
Terms of Service: https://www.yallaludo.com/term/EN/TermOfService.html#TermsOfService

bluejetty:00152458:ios.description:
Wander through the gothic grandeur of the "Halloween Secrets: The Blood Vow" free-to-play Halloween game! Every corner hides Halloween hidden objects, mysteries, and each room drips with spooky games atmosphere, as danger—and perhaps something watching—lurks in the dark. Put your puzzle-solving skills to the test with a wide array of mystery hidden object games and scary halloween games. Each challenge brings you closer to unraveling the sinister mysteries of Darkhand Castle. Are you ready for our scary adventure games?
Three bored friends are eager to prove their bravery and have a little fun on Halloween night. But when they accidentally awaken an ancient presence lurking in the heart of a crumbling estate, a night of dares turns deadly. Shadows twist into monsters. Nightmares bleed into the waking world. And one of them vanishes before their eyes. Now, Alex and Kate, haunted by undead horrors, must unravel the dark truth behind the witches of Darkhand Castle. With each step deeper into the town’s cursed history, they uncover secrets that refuse to stay buried and forces that defy the beyond.
· Unforgettable experience!
Prepare for unforgettable Halloween games with the ultimate creepy games. Perfect for fans of horror hidden object games and vampire games, this adventure will invite you to a world of dark secrets and spine-chilling thrills. Get ready for a Happy Halloween like never before!
· Haunted Castle Exploration!
Explore a haunted castle overflowing with cursed relics and eerie puzzles. Perfect for fans of halloween games and hidden object games, you’ll uncover chilling secrets while you find hidden objects in one of the most creepy games and scary halloween games!
· Trick and Disappearance!
Get ready for a chilling journey filled with scary halloween games, halloween stories, and adventure as you gather an eerie assortment of Halloween-themed collectibles. From spooky games to pumpkin treasures, dive into the mystery hidden object games to unravel the secrets of these macabre treasures!
· Dark Puzzles and Curses!
Solve sinister mini-games, trace curses to their blood-soaked origins, and confront restless spirits. Not just another of the halloween games—it’s a nightmare come alive. Hidden object games where you find hidden objects in creepy games and scary halloween games.
This spine-tingling free-to-play Halloween adventure is sure to satisfy your craving for spooky games, ready to start?

bluejetty:00148595:ios.description:

By taking specific actions in the Unitea app fans earn Karma that can be redeemed for Rewards and Drops in the Unitea Marketplaces. This gives fans a chance to use their engagement and support of artists as currency.

- Earn Karma for the music you're listening to when you connect your Spotify account
- Earn Karma for creating video Vibes with music from your favorite artists
- Share music with friends through your Soundtrack
- Discover new music and save it into your Favorites
- Connect with other fans and build community with people who love the same music and events as you

bluejetty:00178454:ios.description:
Transform your iPhone or iPad into an all-in-one document scanner that makes going paperless effortless. UltraScanner lets you quickly scan, edit, sign, and share documents with just a few simple taps.
Advanced Scanning Capabilities
• Smart Capture: Automatically scan multipage documents with intuitive shutter control and precise border detection.
• Easy Scanning: Quickly capture receipts, letters, invoices, books, homework, IDs, business cards, credit cards, and more.
• Image Enhancement: Automatic shadow and noise removal plus color correction for clear, legible scans.
• PDF Editing: Crop, rotate, add, delete, reorder, and merge pages to create the perfect PDF.
Seamless Sharing & Printing
• Instant Sharing: Tap the “Share” button to email, message, or export your scans as PDF, JPG, or TXT files.
• Flexible Output: Choose from multiple file sizes and print directly via any WiFi printer.
Effortless E-Sign & OCR
• E-Signature Ready: Create, save, and apply custom signatures in various colors, then sign PDFs in seconds.

• Text Layout: View recognized text in a clean layout that preserves its position on the original page, and save or share it as a PDF.
• Searchable Documents: Search inside PDFs and text files, including text in scanned documents, and create searchable PDFs.
Organize Your Documents
• Smart Organization: Store and manage your scans in unlimited folders and subfolders directly on your device—no Internet required.
• Easy Navigation: View your files in thumbnail or list mode, and quickly search or sort by date, name, or size.
Robust Security & Privacy
• Secure Your Files: Lock and encrypt your PDFs by adding a password.
• Advanced Protection: Safeguard documents with a 4-8 digit PIN or biometric authentication (Face ID/Touch ID).

Our workouts embody home exercise, offering a full-body experience. Embrace the convenience of our regimen for transformative results. Sculpt and lean with Pilates, refining muscle definition without needing a gym.

Embark on a holistic journey with revitalizing Pilates workouts, providing breaks from demanding workdays. Dispel misconceptions – Pilates transcends trends, yielding proven results. Our Pilates Yoga Fitness Workouts app features stretching home exercises designed to enhance flexibility in various muscle groups.

Incorporate Pilates into your routine and track progress with our Pilates Yoga Fitness Workouts app, promoting overall well-being without the need for a gym.

_________________________________________________

• Cultivating a comprehensive full-body fitness encounter.

• Adapting to diverse fitness stages and individual requisites without the need for a gym.

• Enhancing posture and fostering a self-assured demeanor without relying on a gym setting.

• Cultivating flexibility through targeted stretches, providing a gym-free approach to improved flexibility.

• Experiencing secure exercise, safeguarding knees and joints, without the constraints of a gym environment.

• Sustaining prime condition with Pilates workouts, promoting well-being without the necessity of a gym.

Revel in these features within our Pilates Fitness Workouts app:
_________________________________________________

• Engage with animated demonstrations and exhaustive exercise elucidations for a comprehensive understanding of each workout.

• Gradually intensify workout demands to match your evolving fitness level, ensuring a progressive and tailored exercise experience.

• Immerse yourself in the finest Pilates app, meticulously crafted to elevate and enhance your overall workout venture.

• Acquire step-by-step guidance for each pose and exercise, ensuring proper form and technique.

• Utilize the Health Calculator to monitor and assess your overall well-being.

• Make use of the Weight Calculator feature to track and manage your weight-related goals.

bluejetty:00028770:ios.description:
Yatzy Infinity is a new take on the classic, fun dice game, so called yatzy, yach, yatzi and so on.
Enjoyed by millions of players, it is super addictive and exciting to play with friends, family, or even online opponents from all over the world!
If you're not so competitive, why not try to challenge yourself to a better score, or defeat CPU?
While luck is crucial to this game, one cannot master the game of dice without analyzing and predicting the dices!
It is simple, addictive, but takes a lot to become a master of the dice!
■ How to play
- Roll the dice to complete the combinations. Calculate the risks before giving it another throw!
- 3 rolls maximum avery round. Keep the desired dices and reroll the not-neede ones!
- Rolled five of the same number? Yatsy!!! This is the combination with the highest score in game!
- Diffucult combinations worth more scores! Beat your opponent by getting a higher score!
- Need one more to complete the desired combination? Use Extra Dice to reroll one additional time!
- May the player with the best luck and strategy wins!
■ Features
Easy and exciting game to enjoy. Never know the real winner is until the end!
Compete with players all over the world! A world-wide beloved game is worth the enthusiasm!
Utilize the items to aim for higher scores. Luck is not the only path to winning!
Play with your family and friends and compete over this fun and addicting game!
Get rewards every day with Daily Reward!
■ Recommend for
- Those who loves board games
- Those looking for a game which takes both luck and strategy
- Those looking for games to enjoy with family and friends
- Those who wants to take their luck into competition
- Those looking for a casual and exciting game to enjoy antwhere, anytime
- Those who loves dice games

*Now with over 100,000 downloads! Thank you for all your support!*
Unleash the Power of Yes and No with the Yes/No Button App! Whether you’re here for laughs, chaos, or helping someone communicate, this app has you covered!
Features:
• Over 200 wild Yes/No phrases: Customize your favorites with the new sound selection page!
• Color Customization: Make the buttons pop—set the Yes button to green for easy recognition, even for colorblind users!
• VoiceOver Accessibility: Fully supports screen readers to assist users with vision impairments!

• Go Pro for Free: Unlock premium features just by watching a few ads!
This app isn’t just for fun—it’s been a game-changer in over 25 facilities, helping non-verbal autistic children communicate with simple Yes/No answers.
 How will you use it?
• Want to say YES to pizza? Smash the Yes button!
• Need to shout NO to doing chores? Hit that No button with flair!
• Helping someone find their voice? Let them choose their favorite sounds and start communicating with ease.
The Yes/No Button App is your ticket to endless fun, creative expression, and even meaningful connections!

Cleanup Home: Cleaning Games is here to help player learn how to clean up, do their daily chores, build good habits, keep their clothes, toys and things tidy.
Play the cutest house and horse stable cleaning games:
· Wash dishes and tidy up the kitchen!
· Scrub the tub, sink, toilet and floor in the bathroom!
· Put things to their places, clean the window, wipe the dust and vacuum the floor in the bedroom!
· Take care of dirty clothes in the laundry room: sort, wash, dry and iron!
· Clean up in the garage: wash and polish the car, collect trash and clean the inside of the car!
· Clean the swimming pool: skim tree leaves with a net, clean the water with pool vacuum and fix the broken tiles!
· Wash, clean up, fix and color the old water slide and have tons of water slide fun with Sweet Panda Kute!

· Get ready for a BBQ party: scrape and scrub the grill, prepare it for cooking and make the best burgers for Sweet Panda Kute and her friends!
· Clean up spider webs and dirt in the pony stable, wash, groom and shower the cutest little pet pony, and play with it in the yard!
· Make Sweet Panda Kute pet puppy happy: clean up, decorate, fix and color the doghouse, then feed, style and dress up the puppy!
· Collect trash, vacuum the floor, repair the bean bag and wipe the table in the treehouse!
· Paint and decorate the tree house fence with your favorite decorations!
· Play every day, get extra coins and collect gifts!
Panda Kute and her friends are in the Dream House waiting for you to join their super fun spring cleaning and home makeover party. Messy kitchen, bedroom, bathroom, laundry room, car, swimming pool, water slide, pony stable, doghouse, treehouse, fence, barbecue grill and fridge need your care and attention. Get ready to clean up, vacuum, wash, bath, mop, wipe, scrub, fix and more!

Name 3 things in 5 seconds. Sounds easy, until the clock starts!
5 Second Guess is the fast, loud party game for friends and family. Pass the phone, read the question, and blurt out three answers before the timer runs out. Everyone else decides if you nailed it or failed it.
HOW TO PLAY
1. Add your players and pick the number of rounds
2. Read the question, tap Start, and name 3 things in 5 seconds

WHY YOU'LL LOVE IT
- Hundreds of quick-fire questions
- Up to 20 players on one phone
- Choose from 1 to 10 rounds
- Automatic scoreboard after every round
- Family friendly mode for all ages
- No setup, no cards, no internet needed to play

bluejetty:00145927:ios.description:
Your company has invited you to join United Heroes. Welcome. Here, you and your colleagues take action side by side, through experiences that are good for you: taking care of yourself, building connections, moving forward together and making an impact.
YOU'RE IN THE RIGHT PLACE
United Heroes is the app your company has chosen to get its teams moving, every day. You join using the access link your company sent you or, if you don't have one, with a company code. Both are provided by your leadership team or your managers.
WHAT YOU CAN DO
Challenges
Take part, solo or as a team, in sports, well-being or charity challenges. Walking, running, cycling, swimming, yoga: every activity counts.
Streaks
Build habits that last. Stack up active days, track your streak and see your progress over time.
Events
Experience your company's big moments: themed weeks and connected challenges that bring your teams together around a shared moment.
Themed Streams
Explore monthly journeys across the app's 6 areas: Vitality, Serenity, Cohesion, Inclusion, Impact, Prevention.
Community & teams
Connect with your colleagues, meet others beyond your own team, share content and celebrate everyone's efforts.
Real-time leaderboards
Follow the momentum of your colleagues, your department and your site, in a friendly, team-first spirit.
Personal dashboard
All your activity in one place: progress, points, habits. Works with Apple Health, Strava, Fitbit, Garmin and most connected devices.
HOW IT WORKS
1. Download the app
2. Open the access link your company sent you (or enter the company code you were given)
3. Join your team and get started
NEED THE LINK OR THE CODE?
Ask your leadership team or your managers.
ABOUT
United Heroes supports more than 1,000 organizations and 3 million people in 150 countries. United Heroes is a certified B Corp and holds ISO 27001 certification. Learn more at united-heroes.com.
United Heroes: together in action.

bluejetty:00176988:android.description:
Water Sort Puzzle Color is an addictive, thrilling liquid sorting game - the perfect way to pass the time while having a blast. Play Water Sort Puzzle for FREE and challenge your brain with over 1,000 levels of liquid sorting fun! In this amazing puzzle game, your task is to fill cute-looking glass tubes by sorting colored liquids until all the same ones are together. It's a true test of your logic and reasoning skills!
If you're tired of classic ball sort puzzle or water sort puzzle games, Water Sort Puzzle Color Game is the perfect choice. With its thrilling color sorting process, addictive gameplay, and beautiful high-definition graphics, you'll be hooked from the very first level.
But that's not all - Water Sort Puzzle Color Game is also simple to play and offers a relaxing ASMR experience as you complete each level. And with no charge, no time limit, and no Wi-Fi needed, you can enjoy this fun and challenging puzzle game anytime, anywhere.
Here's how to play Water Sort Puzzle:
➢ Tap a tube with the liquid you want to move, and then tap the next tube to place the liquid there.
➢ Follow the only game rule: you can only place a liquid of the same color on top of the other one while sorting liquids by color.
➢ Feel free to restart the game level, if you feel you won’t get the colored liquid combination at once.
➢ Use the “Retry” button if you’re stuck in this puzzle on any game level.
➢ When stuck and lost, add a special tube to finish the level.
➢ Fill the tubes with liquids of the same color - and win!
🧩 TOP FEATURES of Water Sort Puzzle Color Game 🧩
➢ NO charge - it's absolutely free to play water sort puzzle!
➢ NO time limit - restart the liquid sorting game whenever you want and play our water sort color puzzle at your own pace!
➢ NO Wi-Fi needed - enjoy the water game offline on-the-go at any place any time!
➢ Beautiful, addictive, high-definition color sorting levels to keep you entertained and truly puzzled for hours.
➢ Satisfying and relaxing ASMR as you sort puzzle and complete levels
Have you tried classic water sort puzzles or pouring games and wish to play something new for a change? Up for some water sort game now? Then Water Sort Puzzle: Color Game is exactly what you need! Being one of the greatest picks on the market of sorting games for adults, Water Sort Puzzle will give you that special vibe of sort puzzle game you’ve been searching for!
Just fill the cup with all liquids of the same color and celebrate the level completion. As simple as that!
Please leave us a rating and a review to support this cool color sorting puzzle game and help us make it even better!
Any questions? Feel free to reach out to us!
Enjoy Water Sort Puzzle Color Game!

➢ When stuck and lost, add a special tube to finish the level.

bluejetty:00131257:ios.name: Pokémon Sleep
bluejetty:00131257:ios.summary:
Collect Pokémon Through Sleeping!
In the world of Pokémon Sleep, Pokémon with the same sleep type as you will gather around as you catch some Zs, so discover all the various different sleep styles that Pokémon can have as you aim to comple
bluejetty:00131257:ios.description:
Collect Pokémon Through Sleeping!
In the world of Pokémon Sleep, Pokémon with the same sleep type as you will gather around as you catch some Zs, so discover all the various different sleep styles that Pokémon can have as you aim to complete your Sleep Style Dex!
What A Day Looks Like in Pokémon Sleep
■ When Night Falls...
It’s time to track your sleep! All you need to do is place your smart device by your pillow (don’t place your device under your pillow or blankets as it may overheat), then call it a night. You can also play using sleep data tracked via your smartwatch.
■ A New Day Dawns
By the time you wake, Pokémon will have gathered in Pokémon Sleep based on your sleep type and how long you slept for. Carry out research on these Pokémon’s sleep styles to complete your Sleep Style Dex!
■ And the Rest of the Day...
Raise Snorlax big and strong! Snorlax will grow larger by receiving Berries from the Pokémon you befriend. The more you raise Snorlax, the greater your odds will be of encountering Pokémon with rare sleep styles!
Rest Your Very Best!
■ Check Your Sleep Report
What kind of sleep did you get last night? Your sleep report contains tidbits like how long you took to fall asleep, how long you spent in different sleep stages, and whether you snored or talked in your sleep.
■ Get Support to try to Sleep Your Best
You can have Pokémon at your side even when you sleep! With features like Pokémon-inspired music to relax you into sleep, plus smart alarms that wake you when you’re in a shallow stage of sleep, Pokémon Sleep may help you to rest your very best.
■ Smartwatch Pairing
By linking with Apple Health, you can use sleep data tracked through certain smartwatches to play Pokémon Sleep.
Compatible devices can be checked here.
https://www.pokemonsleep.net/en/devices/
- Terms of Use
https://view.sleep.pokemon.co.jp/legal/terms/index.html

bluejetty:00166899:ios.name: Evolutioner
bluejetty:00166899:ios.summary: For centuries it has already been known that sound can affect our mental and physical health. Today, more people are starting to realize just how powerful sound frequencies are. Sound frequencies have the ability to promote mental and physi
bluejetty:00166899:ios.description:
For centuries it has already been known that sound can affect our mental and physical health. Today, more people are starting to realize just how powerful sound frequencies are. Sound frequencies have the ability to promote mental and physical healing. There is an amazing science behind how that is possible, and it all has to do with brainwaves.
Brainwaves are the electrical signals the brain uses to process information, think, and communicate with the body. Brainwave imbalances directly relate to poor mental health, and it is more common in teenagers and young adults. Weakened brainwaves directly relate to poor physical health, and it is more common in older adults.
So how can sound affect brainwaves? Brainwaves are frequencies, and sound is also frequencies. When a person listens to a sound frequency, it increases the strength of the brain’s electrical form of that frequency, which are brainwaves.
For example, when a person listens to a pulsing sound of 4 beats per second, it increases the strength of the 4 Hz Delta brainwave.
Albert La Grange has spent more than 12 years of research and has done over 6,000 sound frequency tests to create a program called Evolutioner. Evolutioner uses specific sound frequencies to strengthen fundamental brainwaves and optimize the balance between the different frequency bands. This enables the body and brain to heal and function more efficiently.
The sound frequencies are embedded in beautiful music sessions. The user simply needs to listen to a daily 12-minute music session. No other action is needed for it to work, and it can be listened to from any device, such as a phone, tablet, or computer.
The program is already being used by more than 50,000 people every day.
You can also start using it today by signing up for the 7-day free trial.
Please note that Evolutioner is not a replacement for medical or psychological treatment and is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease. We do not express, imply, or intend any medical claims. Although all statements on the website are accompanied by research or user feedback, no statements have been approved by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration.
Privacy Policy: https://evolutioner.com/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://evolutioner.com/terms-of-use

Every race is a battle, a clash of speed, skill, and daring as you drift through corners, fly over jumps, and tear through intense courses. Whether you're racing on dirt, snow, or asphalt, the real-time drifting mechanics and smooth controls will keep you in the action, but mastering each track will require true mad skills. Only the top drivers can claim victory in this intense racing challenge. It’s one of the best rally games you’ll play.

Stunning visuals and fast-paced gameplay will make you feel like part of the real racing experience. Whether you’re perfecting your drift, boosting past rivals, or unlocking the latest upgrade for your rally car, each race is a chance to prove your skills. 
With daily challenges, exclusive events, and countless upgrades, this rally game provides endless excitement. You can modify your car to dominate each track and outpace the competition. Whether you’re playing solo or competing in exciting events, the variety of tracks and challenges ensures no two races are the same. From sharp corners to huge jumps, every race pushes your drifting and racing skills to the limit.
If you love fun racing games and drifting games, download and play Mad Skills Rallycross now!

Download Mad Skills Rallycross now to join the action, compete in high-speed clashes, and prove you have what it takes to become the ultimate rally car champion.
