bluejetty:00137487:ios.description:
Thinking about a new business? Get in your car and go to the farmer and buy some fruit and vegetables. Rent a small shop and sell whatever you can! This is how the career of a sales tycoon begins. Turn a small vegetable stall into a huge network of supermarkets. Create your own brand, name the store whatever you want and give it the look you like. Manage your own supermarket!
Vegetables and fruits. Eggs, cheese, breakfast cereals, juices or milk, chips, fries, meat, burgers - order all products cheaply online and put them on your shelves. Expand your store, make it bigger and provide the best possible service. Create promotions and set competitive prices so that the goods sell quickly. Handle cash and card payments and watch out for thieves. Maybe you will need protection to prevent any thief simulator from stealing anything from your store? Over time, renovation, painting of walls, or hanging new lamps and decorations will be necessary. You will do all this in the open world of a store manager simulator with excellent, realistic 3D graphics. Have fun and don't go broke. Achieve real success.
Take on the role of a supermarket manager in an addictive simulation game for mobile devices - expand your store and turn it to a huge supermarket or even hypermarket! Open the doors to your store and build it from scratch, transforming a small shop into the ultimate super market. Become supermarket manager and make your supermarket outstanding.
Manage Inventory: Keep shelves always full. Order products, negotiate prices and follow trends to attract customers.
In this 3d simulation game you can freely customize your brand: change the appearance of your shop, choose themes, colors and decorations that best reflect your style.
Expand your product range: Unlock new products, activities and services that will satisfy even demanding customers.
Manage Staff: Recruit, train and motivate employees to ensure the best customer service and operational efficiency.
Customer Satisfaction: Monitor your customers' needs and respond to their feedback. Ensure high quality of service to build a permanent base of satisfied customers.
Unlock chips, sushi, crab sticks and tons of new products! Have fun and develop supermarket! You can buy sunglasses, fruits and vegetables and customize your store.
IGRS rating: 13+

bluejetty:00157804:ios.description:
Calmer is a toolkit for anxious, stressful moments: quick ways to calm down, and small daily habits that help you feel steadier over time.
WHAT'S INSIDE
• SOS calm-down tools for moments of panic
• Guided breathing, grounding and relaxation exercises
• Sleep stories and guided meditations to help you wind down
• Anxiety School: short lessons on how stress and anxiety work
• A daily plan and a guided 7-session program
• Mood check-ins to notice what helps you
• AI companion: talk things through any time (not a therapist or medical service)
WHY PEOPLE USE CALMER
• Calm down in minutes, wherever you are
• Build a simple routine that fits your day
• Understand what sets off your stress
• Get to sleep with less racing thought
IMPORTANT
Calmer is a self-help wellness app. It does not diagnose or treat any condition and is not a substitute for professional care. If you're struggling, please talk to a doctor or a mental health professional. If you're in crisis, contact your local emergency number or a crisis line; in the app, tap the help button in the AI companion.
SUBSCRIPTION
Calmer Plus unlocks all exercises, stories, lessons and unlimited AI companion messages. Monthly and yearly plans are available; some include a free trial. Payment is charged to your Apple ID account when you confirm the purchase, or when the free trial ends. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel in your Apple ID account settings.
Terms of Use: https://gocalmer.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://gocalmer.com/privacy

bluejetty:00106321:android.summary: Looking for a new crossword game? Play Word Show and start your journey to becoming a word master! Word Look is a word game in which you can connect, cross and break words from stacks of letter blocks into thousands of interesting themes. A
bluejetty:00106321:android.description:
Looking for a new crossword game? Play Word Show and start your journey to becoming a word master! Word Look is a word game in which you can connect, cross and break words from stacks of letter blocks into thousands of interesting themes. A word search, word connect, crossword game for everyone, there are so many free and fascinating themes, jokes, puzzles and brain teasers in this category word game and new word search puzzles are updated every day! As you find, connect and break words, you will enjoy the mixed fun of word search, crossword, word puzzle, logic puzzle, word guessing, category game, jigsaw puzzle, scrabble, wooden blocks, solitaire as well as tons of funny jokes and puzzles on the way to becoming the word guru! By playing Word Show every now and then during the day, you can give your brain a good workout by associating words with different fun topics. Word Look is a simple convenient and practical way to sharpen your mind. Not to mention the beautiful nature background images that create a relaxing atmosphere and help you build your inner peace while collecting wisdom flowers in the Garden of Words.
Each level has a unique theme and a stack of letter blocks. All you have to do is find the words that match the theme, connect the letters by swiping and collect the words one by one and finally complete the level. These themes are accessible to everyone, you can play any puzzle anytime, anywhere. With Wort Schau you can practice your sense of logic and vocabulary while having fun, alone or with friends!
Why should you play Word Show?
- Easy to use! Simply swipe and connect letters to locate words in anagrams.
- What a crossword puzzle! Enjoy a classic word puzzle. Letter blocks will fall down if you are correct!
- Challenge others and yourself - criss-cross the stacks of letters to become the best word juggler!
- Fascinating game designs accompany you level by level and allow you to immerse yourself in another world.
- Play offline anytime and anywhere there is WiFi!!
- Entertain your mates, friends and family with this fantastic new game. Guessing words together is just as fun as playing alone!
- Fun for all ages! Word Show is a wonderful and addictive game for adults, adolescents and children that everyone can experience together.
- New puzzles to solve every week to keep your mind busy with endless fun!

bluejetty:00131359:ios.description:
Waye Navigation provide exceptional navigation experience. 
Avoid traffic delays with real-time traffic information about situation on the road.
Even if you know the way, Waye tells you instantly about traffic, construction, police, crashes, & more. 
Why Waye?
• Speed limit of the next section, allowing you adjust your speed through the section accordingly. App tells you when (distance) the speed limit is going to change
• The speed limit feature will show the maximum speed for the road
• Get the speed limits of the current section and the speed limits of the next section.
• Parking near your destination
• Head-up Display projects navigation onto the windshield of your car, making driving at night safer
• Turn-by-turn directions
• Ability to report incidents to help other drivers
• Reported alerts including accidents, hazards, road closures, and more
• Warning sounds alerts to warn you of potential traffic problems near your location
• Weather Forecast Map
• Places Near your location
• Auto Refresh Traffic Data
• Siri Shortcuts
• Apple CarPlay Connectivity - all navigation features on your car’s built-in display
• Auto-zoom map according to your speed
• Find the best time to leave
• and more
Information about the auto-renewable nature of the subscription
- Every time in a month you can reach Standard or Premium feature and if you want to continue with these features, your subscription should be continued.
- The subscription period is 1 month. Every 1 month your subscription renews.
- The price of the subscription is $1.99 Standard, $3.99 Premium,
- Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase
- Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period
- You can cancel your subscription via this url: https://support.apple.com/en-us/HT202039
- Privacy policy: https://bit.ly/3x7oE7P
- Term of use: https://bit.ly/3RNsKeP

The CreditSights Mobile app is designed to help you stay connected with the market insights that drive your day. Through your mobile phone or tablet, you can now access our independent credit research and comprehensive market insights to make timely, well-informed decisions and better manage risk.
Top Features: 
• Access your feed directly from your mobile device 
• View individual companies with valuable info and metrics
• Save articles and read them offline 
• Receive notifications when relevant research is published
• Filter content by region, credit grade, or sector 
• Review Top Read and most recent research 
CreditSights empowers more than 40,000 financial professionals among the world's largest institutions with the credit-risk tools, independent research and comprehensive market insights they need to make well-informed credit decisions. Setting the standard for global credit research since 2000, we provide timely data, news, and unbiased analysis of over 30,000 issuers around the world. Over 90% of the world's largest institutions use CreditSights enabling market participants to know more, risk better and ultimately create value.
Note: This app is for CreditSights subscribers and current login credentials are required to sign in.

bluejetty:00182545:ios.description:
Transport yourself back to the 1920s – the golden age of tennis – in Tennis Game in Roaring ’20s (World of Tennis: Roaring ’20s). Join refined ladies and gentlemen partaking in a good old-fashioned battle of wits and skill on the court.
Use swipe or touch controls to place shots and dictate where your player moves. As you play, our new tennis AI system learns your playstyle and can play multiplayer tennis games as you against other players when you are away.
Do you prefer to serve and volley or stick to the baseline and smash powerful forehands? Whatever your style, hit tennis courts and enjoy tactical gameplay while honing your skills. Compete with players from all over the world and become number one tennis champion!
Key Features:
• Play with precision using swipe and touch controls.
• Immerse yourself in realistic 3D tennis play with true motion ball and shot physics.
• Enjoy lag-free asynchronous multiplayer action in league, tournament and practice matches.
• Earn trophies in major tournaments inspired by Grand Slam tournaments like Wimbledon, Australian Open, US Open, and Roland-Garros.
• Train your AI character to play just like you.
• Choose one of the 7 tennis player character types.
• Customize and develop your in-game character into an ultimate tennis pro. 
• Join private clubs, earn prizes, and climb global leaderboards!
Contact support: http://www.worldoftennis.com/contactus
Like us: https://www.facebook.com/worldoftennisgame
Share your feedback, show your support – and let’s make the world’s best mobile tennis game together!

bluejetty:00065829:ios.name: Bridgemate App
bluejetty:00065829:ios.summary: The Bridgemate® app is a personal add-on to the existing Bridgemate Pro or Bridgemate II scoring system for bridge clubs. It enables players during or directly after the bridge game to review their scores, rankings and competitors’ scores f
bluejetty:00065829:ios.description:
The Bridgemate® app is a personal add-on to the existing Bridgemate Pro or Bridgemate II scoring system for bridge clubs. It enables players during or directly after the bridge game to review their scores, rankings and competitors’ scores for the boards that they have just played. Since version 3, it is also possible to enter scores through the app. It also offers an interactive analysis tool to provide educative feedback on your play. Clubs that use the Bridgemate scoring system can upload the Bridgemate scores and other data during their event from the Bridgemate Control Software, and this information is displayed in real time in the app on the player’s smartphone.
The Bridgemate app offers an extensive range of information for players:
- A guide card for the current event. Find out who your opponents will be during the event.
- Your personal scorecard. This is updated in real time, and the results are updated as soon as new scores come in.
- Current rankings are displayed for the section in which you’re playing.
- An overview of your competitors’ scores can be displayed for each board played.
- If hand records are available, they are displayed in the app along with makeable contract information.
- An interactive analysis of the boards you’ve just played. For each possible card you could have played, the app tells you how this would have affected your board result. 
- Extensive functionality for tournament directors (both playing and non-playing) to keep track of the session. Combined with the latest Bridgemate II updates, it is also possible to receive TD calls within the Bridgemate app.
- Register attendance at a current event. (choose your starting table and direction)
- Enter scores in the app.
The Bridgemate app is an individual service for players who participate in bridge games that use the Bridgemate scoring system. In order to use the Bridgemate app in a bridge game, the organiser of the game (i.e. the bridge club) is required to create a club account on the Bridgemate website and upload the event data in real time via the Bridgemate Control Software. Clubs control which information is visible in the app during the game. Before using this app, consult with your bridge club about whether it uploads data in this way.

bluejetty:00187333:ios.description:

Over 4,000 organizations use PowerDMS as their policy and procedure software to increase trust and efficiency by simplifying the way they share crucial information and handle their policy management.

• Electronic signature with a simple swipe or fingerprint.
• Full-text search of all documents.
• Replace paper files and manuals with secure cloud storage.
An active PowerDMS license is required to access the PowerDMS app.

bluejetty:00075635:ios.description:

The national certifying examination for surgical technologists covers the knowledge and skills common to competent entry-level Surgical Technologists in varied settings and geographical locations. Committee members designed the examinations to assess the skills that comprise the core body of knowledge for all surgical technologists and surgical first assistants. The Certified Surgical Technologist (CST®) examination examines practical knowledge, and one night of studying will not lead to passing grades.
Key features:
- Choose from different exams
- Practice with 550+ questions written by instructors and expert tutors
- Track your strengths and weaknesses within Stats section of the app
- Study detailed statistics of every test you take
- Compare your score to the community average for almost any type of exam
- - - -

Subscriptions can be managed and auto-renewal can be turned off in Account Settings in iTunes after the purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.

bluejetty:00180273:ios.summary:
tcCalc is a calculator built for one job: timecode math for video production. Add and subtract timecode, let it handle drop frame for you, and switch to a frame count with a single tap, all with the feel of an ordinary calculator.
Time bas
bluejetty:00180273:ios.description:
tcCalc is a calculator built for one job: timecode math for video production. Add and subtract timecode, let it handle drop frame for you, and switch to a frame count with a single tap, all with the feel of an ordinary calculator.
Time bases
23.98 / 24 / 25 / 29.97 / 30 / 50 / 59.94 / 60 fps, plus hh:mm:ss for working without frames. Drop frame is applied automatically at 29.97 and 59.94 fps.
Features
- Add and subtract timecode
- One-tap switching between timecode and frame count (seconds in hh:mm:ss mode)
- Automatic drop frame handling (29.97 / 59.94 fps)
- Constant calculation: press = again to repeat the last operation
- Memory: add, subtract, recall, and clear
- Calculation history: up to 20 entries with frame rate and date; tap to restore, swipe to delete
- Open history with the clock button or by swiping up on the display
- Copy and paste from the ••• menu or by touching and holding the result
- Built-in How to Use guide
Easy to read
- Large keys, color-coded by role
- Dark mode
- iPhone and iPad, in all four orientations
- Dynamic Type and VoiceOver support
Simple by design
- No ads
- No in-app purchases
- No account or sign-in
- The app itself makes no network connections and works offline
- No analytics and no tracking
Whether you are timing a shoot, finding an edit point, or adding up the length of your footage, tcCalc keeps the math out of your way.

bluejetty:00126706:ios.summary: Get ready to pass your Pharmacy Technician Certification Exam (PTCE) with confidence! The PTCE Practice Test app helps you master key pharmacy concepts through realistic questions, detailed explanations, and AI-powered learning tools. Devel
bluejetty:00126706:ios.description:
Get ready to pass your Pharmacy Technician Certification Exam (PTCE) with confidence! The PTCE Practice Test app helps you master key pharmacy concepts through realistic questions, detailed explanations, and AI-powered learning tools. Developed for aspiring and practicing pharmacy technicians, this app is your ultimate companion for mastering all PTCE exam topics — from drug classifications to federal laws, dosage calculations, and safety standards.
Our PTCE prep questions are categorized into various topics:
• Medications
• Federal Requirements
• Patient Safety and Quality Assurance
• Order Entry and Processing
• Top 200 Drugs Test
**Why You’ll Love This App**
- Realistic PTCE Practice Tests: Simulate the actual Pharmacy Technician Certification Exam with questions modeled after the official PTCB format. Gain hands-on experience with exam-level difficulty.
- Study by Topic: Review core domains like Pharmacology, Pharmacy Law & Regulations, Sterile & Nonsterile Compounding, and Medication Safety. Strengthen your weak areas with targeted quizzes.
- AI Mentor – Smart Study Assistant: Learn faster with Mentora, your AI tutor. It explains complex concepts, clarifies tricky questions, and helps you retain knowledge effectively.
- Custom & Diagnostic Tests: Start with a diagnostic test to identify your strengths and weaknesses, then create custom tests focused on specific domains or difficulty levels.
- Detailed Explanations & References: Each question comes with step-by-step explanations and study references so you can understand the reasoning behind every answer.
- Progress Tracking & Insights: Track your performance with passing probability charts and analytics by topic. Stay motivated and measure your improvement over time.
**Designed for Pharmacy Technician Success**
Whether you're preparing for your first certification or retaking the exam, this app helps you study smarter, track your progress, and boost your confidence before test day.
Start Your PTCE Journey Today! Download the PTCE Practice Test app now and take your first step toward becoming a certified pharmacy technician.

bluejetty:00121127:ios.description:
Take your creativity to the next level with Cut & Paste Photo. Explore incredible new ways to remove or change the background of your photo, cut out any portion from a photo & blend with any other photo background. 
• AI CUTOUT •
Our advanced AI Cutout will automatically remove the photo background to make your task easier.
• LASSO •
Cut any portion or extract people from your photo with our amazing Lasso tool. 
Select any area of a photo & cut out that specific area instantly. Apply this cutout portion on any background image you want. 
• ERASER •
You can Erase the background of your photo, remove any unwanted object from your photo, or erase corner & edges of your cutout photo with our Eraser tool.
• SHAPE •
Cut your photo in different shapes with just a tap. We have 170 different shapes separated in 7 different categories.
• PRESET CANVAS •
Select any canvas for your project from our 100+ preset canvases. You can also create your own canvas with custom ratio and resolution. For simplicity just pick a photo from gallery and use it as a canvas. We have all the options for you to create a new project.
• OPACITY CONTROLLER •
Very swiftly change the opacity of your photo.
• BLEND PHOTOS & SUPERIMPOSE •
With our 30+ advanced Blending Modes, Merge & Blend your Background image with your Foreground image like a pro. Change opacity & colors of each blending modes to explore lots of versions of your blended photos.
• BACKGROUND TEMPLATE •
With our own collection you will get 200+ Background images, 100+ pattern templates, 100+ gradient templates and 100+ color templates to choose from.
• TEXT ON PHOTO •
With 200+ stylish Fonts & 100+ colors for each font, make your photos more meaningful & expressive.
• PHOTO CLONE •
Paste multiple copies of people in photos to create fun clone effect.
• PHOTO FILTERS •
Lots of amazing Filters to stylize your photos.
• QUOTES •
Chose from our amazing collection of trendy quotes to apply on your photo. Change the color of each quotes with hundreds of colors! 
• STICKERS •
Lots of stickers collection to choose, to apply on your photo. You can even edit the stickers with lasso or eraser tool. 
• SAVE & SHARE •
Advanced output option with different formates PNG & JPEG. You can save and share with transparency on and off.

Hmmm so I have a bill of $259.65 including tax, so how much should I tip?
Tipping used to be simple. Now with a truck load of taxes, service charges, per person splitting and what not, a simple restaurant etiquette has turned into a full on battle of the brains.
Luckily, there’s Tap Tip to save you the hassle of tipping wrong. And even calculating it. Within seconds you can get the perfect amount of tipping needed to keep that waiter smiling, your reputation intact and your finances up and running. 
Imagine tipping incorrectly at every meal every time you eat out. Sounds simple but the damage builds up over time to be something serious. An app like Tap Tip can help you loads.
Oh, and it has lots of other nice features too!
• You can calculate service based tipping
• Up to 100 person split of the bill ( VERY convenient) with per person billing and tipping 
• Just a simple tap and swipe action to operate
• You can exclude sales taxes from tipping
• You can round the tip or the total
• Switch the currency with ease!
• Oh and if you want, you can even share results by text or email
• And, you can tip even faster with the companion Apple Watch app
• Currency change, rounding and sales tax exclusion are available via in-app purchase.
• Fully compatible with Dark Mode.
PS: That would be $00.00 for the app (tip included!)

bluejetty:00127911:ios.description:
This app is exclusively for the Fujifilm instax mini LiPlay™ and instax mini LiPlay+™ hybrid instant cameras. 
You can enjoy the following functions by connecting your camera and this app via Bluetooth:
instax mini LiPlay+™ Features
(1) instax Sound Album™
Create videos using images from your smartphone and combining them with music. 
　Choose an image, add a QR code, and print it from your camera. 
　Play the video by scanning the QR code with your smartphone. You can also download the video.
(2) instax Sound Print™
Add sounds to an image from your smartphone to make an instax™ photo.
(3) GALLERY
View images printed from your camera and videos from the app. 
　You can also download the data to your smartphone and reprint. 
Basic Features
(4) SOUND
Sound recorded with your camera or smartphone can be converted into an instax™ photo with QR code.
　Scan the QR code with your smartphone to play the image with sound.
　With the instax mini LiPlay+™ camera, you can use the instax Sound Album™ feature to combine multiple images with sound and music into a video. 
(5) REMOTE SHOOTING
Take photos with the camera remotely using your smartphone.
(6) DIRECT PRINT
Print images from your smartphone's camera roll and turn them into instax™ photos. 
(7) CUSTOM FRAME
Change the design frame set on the camera using the app.  
　On instax mini LiPlay™, design frames are set to the three shortcut buttons on the side of the camera. 
　Access instax mini LiPlay+™ frames from the “Frame Settings” menu in the settings screen.
[Supported OS] iOS 16.0 or later

bluejetty:00159986:ios.description:
Choose what you want to listen to, where and how with MusicCast. MusicCast is a streaming and multi-room audio system built into many Yamaha products, including sound bars, wireless speakers, AV receivers and more. The MusicCast app lets you easily control them all.
Music Everywhere
 -Listen to music throughout your whole home
 -Listen to the same or different music in each room
Stream your favorites
 -Stream from popular music services or from Internet Radio stations
 -Access your music library from your smartphone, NAS drive or computer
 -Stream internal or external content (TV, CD Player, Blu-ray Disc Player, USB, and more)
Don't skimp on quality
 -Supports High Resolution Audio playback (up to 192kHz/24bit)
Create wireless setups
 -MusicCast Stereo: Pair compatible models for a wireless 2-channel or 2.1-channel setup 
 -MusicCast Surround: Pair select models together for the ease of wirelss surround sound
Make your music yours
 -Multiple settings to customize your experience 
Requirements
 - iOS 16.0 or higher
 - A Wi-Fi router and one or more MusicCast-enabled products within the same network
Compatible models vary by region.
Please refer to the following site for compatible models.
https://www.yamaha.com/2/musiccast/
This application performs following functions for purposes described below.
- Making a connection under Wi-Fi enabled environment
 The application uses Wi-Fi function on your mobile terminal for the purpose of operating network-enabled devices.
- Accessing to music information stored in your smartphone / tablet
 This application accesses to music information stored in your smartphone / tablet for the purpose of displaying, playing and editing the music information and/or playlist.
To setup your MusicCast devices, this app needs to find your Wi-Fi network as location information. This app doesn’t collect your actual location using GPS or Wi-Fi based positioning technologies.

bluejetty:00123850:ios.name: Dope Wars (Weed Edition) Lite
bluejetty:00123850:ios.summary: The good news - you have $2,000 in cash, and licenses to legally trade. The bad? You owe $5,500 to Dishonest Harry, a not-too-friendly loan shark, interest is piling up, he'll be visiting you soon for his money, and he owns a chainsaw! Just
bluejetty:00123850:ios.description:
The good news - you have $2,000 in cash, and licenses to legally trade. The bad? You owe $5,500 to Dishonest Harry, a not-too-friendly loan shark, interest is piling up, he'll be visiting you soon for his money, and he owns a chainsaw! Just sayin'. You only have one choice - dive into the world of wholesale trading of weed to make money fast and save your skin!
As you travel from location to location, a day passes and local prices change. Buy low, sell higher! But beware - Officer Hardass is looking out for you, so get prepared for a stand-off with the cops by visiting the Dope Wars Store to tool up for the inevitable confrontation! You can also buy more storage space along the way at the Store, so look out for sales and special offers.
Along the way, special market events will cause prices to rise or fall spectacularly, so be ready for these, this is how you get rich! There are muggers out there, so try to keep unused cash in the bank, earning interest. Other loan sharks can lend you money to solve short-term liquidity crunches, but they'll be after their money soon enough! If you get injured, pop in to see the local doctor at his surgery, but look out - he has no scruples, and you have kidneys. A bad combination.
Listen out for the crazy old lady, too. She sure has some wacky things to say, but occasionally, she'll give you a very handy tip off, which is essential to your financial success in Dope Wars. Also, keep an eye out (and cash on hand) for the chance to buy a larger coat. More space, more profit! Good luck my friend, you're sure going to need it!!
If your final score is good enough, you can submit it to the Game Center Leaderboards and see how well you fare against your friends, or the whole planet!
This is the ad-supported version. The full version removes ads, allows 15, 60, 90, 120 and 365 day game lengths for turn-based games and 1, 5, 10, 15 and 20 minutes for timed games, shows arrows indicating direction of daily price changes, and adds the powerful RCL 9000 weapon.
This version of Dope Wars is ported directly from the wildly popular version of the PC game, also from Beermat Software. Same great addictive game play, modified for your mobile device!
If you find any bugs in Dope Wars , or would like to see new features added to Dope Wars, please drop us an email at beermatsoftware@gmail.com

bluejetty:00137428:ios.description:
With over 7,000 recipes to choose from, find unique flavours, explore different cuisines and expand your usual repertoire, with a 14-day free trial of the Feast app. Or if you are already a Guardian subscriber, sign in to see if Feast is included in your subscription.
The Feast app is filled with daily inspiration from our world-class cooks – including Meera Sodha, Yotam Ottolenghi, Benjamina Ebuehi, Nigel Slater, Rachel Roddy and many others. Our food editors carefully curate the app each day, with new collections and recipes added to suit all moods, seasons and occasions.
Among their recipes there’s something for everyone - including a huge range of vegan and vegetarian dishes, ideas for weekend brunches, quick midweek dinners, sweet treats, gluten-free ideas, baking recipes, and much more.
Features our users love
Browse exclusive recipes - only available to Guardian Feast subscribers
Search by ingredient - use up leftovers in the fridge, save time in the supermarket and reduce waste
Filter your recipe search - by cooks, diets, cuisines, meal types, special occasions or popular filters
Create your own recipe collections - save your newfound favourites and add your own personal recipe notes 
Create your shopping list - add ingredients to your shopping list and then cross them off as you shop
Convert your recipes - automatically switch your recipe ingredients to US units
Switch on cook mode - follow step-by-step instructions which stay on your screen
Customise your Home tab - filter our curated recipe collections by meat-free, gluten-free, dairy-free, vegan, vegetarian or pescatarian options
Print your recipes - if you prefer a physical copy to follow
Share your recipes - with friends or family
Look up a cooking term - our food dictionary can guide you wherever you are in the world

bluejetty:00013915:ios.summary:
Until now, managing and interacting with your contacts has been a real frustration. Cardhop’s magical parsing engine is incredibly intuitive, letting you search, add, edit, and interact with your contacts using a simple sentence!
Just type
bluejetty:00013915:ios.description:
Until now, managing and interacting with your contacts has been a real frustration. Cardhop’s magical parsing engine is incredibly intuitive, letting you search, add, edit, and interact with your contacts using a simple sentence!
Just type in “John G” and John’s card will instantly appear. Or enter “Sarah Smith sarah@cardhopapp.com” and Cardhop will add a new contact to Sarah’s card. Or type in “call Michael S” and Cardhop will instantly start a phone call.
SEARCH, ADD, EDIT, AND INTERACT WITH YOUR CONTACTS LIKE NEVER BEFORE
• Tap on the Cardhop search field
• Type in the details for your contact
• That’s it!
TRY CARDHOP FOR FREE
• Beautiful, clean, and easy to use contacts app letting you to manage contacts
• Beautiful widgets to let you instant use and interact with your contacts (some widget actions require a Flexibits Premium subscription)
UPGRADE TO FLEXIBITS PREMIUM (requires subscription)
• Includes Cardhop on all platforms: Mac, iPhone, and iPad
• Business card scanning: Use your camera to take a picture of a business card and Cardhop will automatically create a new contact
• Relationships: View relationships between people in your Office 365 organization or between personal contacts through the related name field
• Invite action: Quickly invite people to a new event with Fantastical
• Fun alternate app icons to personalize your home screen
• If you’ve already subscribed to Flexibits Premium through Fantastical, all premium features are automatically included!
FEATURES
• A beautiful and simple contacts app, designed exclusively for your iPhone and iPad
• Instantly works with your existing iOS contacts, there’s nothing to configure
• Groups: quickly toggle contact groups with a tap
• Notes: a convenient and powerful way to add notes to your contacts, helping you to strengthen your relationships
• Recents: quickly interact with your recent contacts
• Birthdays: receive birthday notifications, instantly see upcoming birthdays, and easily send a wish on their special day
• Multiple widgets to quickly access your favorite contacts and actions
• Siri Shortcuts
• Full accessibility and VoiceOver support
• Dark and light themes
• And much, much more!
POWERFUL ACTIONS
• Quickly interact with your contacts with the following actions: Call, Copy, Invite, Relationships, Directions, Email, FaceTime, FaceTime Audio, Facebook Messenger, Large Type, Message, Skype, Telegram, Twitter, URL, Viber, and VoIP
• Simply enter an action or abbreviation (which you’ll find in the Help Book by entering “?” or “help”) followed by your contact’s name and Cardhop will handle the rest
• Even better, some actions are flexible. For example, you can add a subject to an email by entering “email Kent Lunch tomorrow?” and the email including the subject will instantly appear, ready to go!
• Customizable quick actions are also available per contact, allowing for single-tap actions
Cardhop — the contacts app you’ll want to use.

bluejetty:00027521:ios.name: iCollect Comic Books - Keys
bluejetty:00027521:ios.summary: iCollect Comic Books is the #1 app on the Apple App Store for managing your comic book collection and inventory, whether at home, work, or school. This app works on all device sizes and syncs directly with our iPhone, iPad, Mac apps, as wel
bluejetty:00027521:ios.description:
iCollect Comic Books is the #1 app on the Apple App Store for managing your comic book collection and inventory, whether at home, work, or school. This app works on all device sizes and syncs directly with our iPhone, iPad, Mac apps, as well as our apps on other platforms. Scan in or search within our database for any comic you own or want and add them to your lists. Full of incredible features!
• Manage and inventory any comic book from publishers such as Marvel, DC, Image, IDW, Dark Horse, Boom Studios, Dynamic Entertainment, Titan, and more! 
• Loaded with millions of comics from around the world in our database.
• Full barcode scanning and database search.
• Cloud Backup
• Sync across multiple devices, including iPad, iPhone, Mac, and more.
• Supports input in any language and allows selections of any country and currency.
• Filters, sorting, and importing.
• Three different custom layouts.
• Exporting
• Multi-level sorting
• Shake to Select
• Default Field Data
• Customize which fields are displayed
• Section Counts
• Share your comic collection with friends or on social media like Facebook and Twitter.
• Format your Titles with A, An, or The removed.
• Extra features like colored Themes, Dark Mode support, and more.
• Every field is editable.
• Store up to four pictures per comic, including front, back, and inside images of comics.
• Personal details per comic including Loaned, Purchase Price, Purchase Date, Date Added, Personal Rating, Storage Location, Opened, Notes, Estimated Value, and more.
• Index bars and search for quick access in large comic collections.
• Works with CGC and CBCS graded comics
This app is a completely new collecting experience, written from the ground up for iOS 18, the latest devices like iPhone 16, 16 Pro, 16 Pro Max, SE 2, iPad Pro, and full Universal iPhone/iPad support built-in and syncs directly to our Mac app. Our app was created with a cloud database backend designed specifically to allow each item to be stored with its own individual attributes.
We can import your comic book collection from nearly anywhere: CLZ Comics, Delicious Library, Key Collector Comics, Comics Price Guide, GoCollect, and much more. Just send us your import file and we'll get you rolling.
Note: Large collections require an in-app purchase to unlock unlimited storage. You will be prompted when you reach the limits of your selected collectible type.
Data provided by Amazon, Google, eBay, and users like you.
-------
PRIVACY INFO
-------
All of these are OPTIONAL when using our app.
Email Address: We only collect this if you enable Cloud Sync as a login user ID.
Contacts: We only use your contacts if you want us to for "Loaned To" fields.
Photos or Videos: We only use photos that you choose for your item details.
Camera: We only use this for barcode scanning.
None of your data is sold. See our Privacy Policy URL for details.
We do use Google Firebase and Facebook SDK's for analytics and crash data. See their policies for additional details on what they may track about your device.
-------
TERMS OF USE: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
PRIVACY POLICY: https://www.icollecteverything.com/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00142782:ios.description:
Never lose your contacts again! The fastest backup, transfer, restore, and sync solution for iPhone. Export to VCF, clean duplicates, and recover lost contacts in seconds.
INSTANT BACKUP & RESTORE
Create secure backups of all your contacts in one tap. Restore everything instantly when you need it. Email backup files to yourself for extra safety. Works completely offline with no internet required.
EASY CONTACT TRANSFER
Switching to a new iPhone? Transfer all your contacts seamlessly. Move contacts between devices, accounts, and platforms without losing any data. Fast, reliable, and secure transfer process.
SMART CLEANER & DUPLICATE REMOVER
Automatically detect and remove duplicate contacts. Merge similar entries to keep your address book organized. Delete multiple contacts at once. Clean up messy contact lists in minutes.
POWERFUL EXPORT OPTIONS
Export all contacts to VCF format instantly. Convert contacts to CSV for Excel and spreadsheets. Share your contact list with anyone. Full compatibility with all major platforms.
RECOVER LOST CONTACTS
Accidentally deleted contacts? Restore them from your latest backup in seconds. Never worry about losing important contact information again.
SYNC ACROSS DEVICES
Keep your contacts synchronized across multiple devices. Manage recent contacts efficiently. Quick access to your most important connections.
COMPLETE PRIVACY PROTECTION
Your contacts never leave your device. No cloud storage or server uploads. No tracking, no data collection, no ads. Complete transparency and security for your personal information.
PERFECT FOR USERS WHO NEED TO
- Transfer contacts when switching to a new phone
- Create regular backups before iOS updates
- Clean up disorganized and duplicate contact lists
- Export contacts to VCF or CSV for business use
- Recover accidentally deleted contacts
- Sync contacts across multiple devices
PROFESSIONAL FEATURES
Lightning fast backup and restore process. Clean and intuitive user interface. Universal app for iPhone and iPad. Regular updates with new features. Dedicated customer support team.
TRUSTED BY MILLIONS
Join over one million users worldwide who trust us to protect their valuable contact information. Rated highly for reliability, ease of use, and excellent customer service.
WHY CHOOSE US
Fast performance with no lag. Simple design anyone can use. No complicated setup. Works perfectly with the latest iOS versions. Continuous improvements based on user feedback.
Download today and take complete control of your contacts!
SUBSCRIPTION INFORMATION
Your subscription automatically renews unless turned off 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage your subscriptions and turn off auto-renewal from your Apple ID account settings after purchase. When canceling a subscription, your subscription will stay active until the end of the period. Auto-renewal will be disabled, but the current subscription will not be refunded.

bluejetty:00033891:ios.description:
Girls AND Boys!! Experience your dream wedding journey with Love Story Adventure 3D! From a couple to a married pair, you'll experience every step of your perfect love journey with Love Story Adventure 3D! This 3D game lets you explore your dream wedding from the engagement to the final kiss and offers tons of fun playtime for both girls and boys!
Key Features:
Wedding Planner: Become your own wedding planner and customize every aspect of your wedding. Choose your stunning wedding dress, select the perfect attire for the groom, and arrange every detail to reflect your unique love style. Whether you envision a grand ballroom celebration or an intimate beachside ceremony, Love Story Adventure 3D brings your dream wedding to life.
Romantic Moments: Girls! Immerse yourself in a beautiful love story with your boyfriend or girlfriend. Experience the joy of planning your marriage and relish romantic moments, from the engagement ring to the wedding kiss. Enjoy a variety of fun mini-games that add excitement to your wedding day and make every step of your love journey memorable.
Interactive Challenges: Face unexpected challenges as a couple that test your wedding planner skills and ensure everything goes smoothly. From last-minute changes to missing items, your quick thinking and planning will help you overcome these mini-games hurdles and make your wedding day perfect.
Love Tester Challenges: Fun challenges along the wedding day will be a love tester for you and your partner. Engage in mini-games and love tester activities as a couple to add an extra layer of excitement to your wedding planning process.
Captivating Storyline: Follow a heartfelt love story that transitions from a couple to a married duo. Experience the full range of emotions, from the engagement to the wedding kiss, and celebrate your marriage with style and elegance. The game’s engaging mini-games make each moment of your journey even more enjoyable.
Whether you’re a girl dreaming of the perfect wedding or a boyfriend and girlfriend planning their future together, Love Story Adventure 3D offers a fun and interactive way to explore your wedding fantasies and create unforgettable memories.
Download now and start your wedding planning adventure!

bluejetty:00082458:ios.description:
myENV is a one-stop platform for information on environment, water services and food safety in Singapore.
It provides a comprehensive suite of information and services from the Ministry of Sustainability and the Environment (MSE) which covers weather, air quality, dengue hot spots, water level, flood, water disruption, hawker centre, food hygiene, and recycling. Users can also report feedback to MSE and its agencies through this app.
• Access updated information on Singapore’s weather and receive push-notification alerts when heavy rain occurs
• View latest PSI & hourly PM2.5 information
• Locate dengue clusters
• Search for hawker centre
• View the food alerts and recall related information
• Obtain useful food hygiene related information such as Food Establishment Hygiene
 Grades and list of licensed food caterers
• Get alerted on environmental situations such as earthquake, drain water level, flash floods, lightning and haze
• View the water supply disruption information
• Convenience of providing feedback to NEA, PUB and SFA
• Save locations and personalise the relevant information you wish to see for each location
myENV app will need access to certain features on your phone for the following reasons:
Calendar
This allows myENV to provide you more accurate information events, alerting you on weather and environmental conditions before your event 
Location
Allowing myENV to use location will allow the app to serve you location-specific information (e.g weather, dengue)
Location When In Use
Allowing myENV to use location will allow the app to serve you location-specific information (e.g weather, dengue)
Location Always and When In Use
This allows myENV to use your location to understand your location patterns, so we can provide you more accurate suggestions based on your locations
Photos/Media/Files
Allow you to save photographs taken with myENV app in your phone and to attach them when you file a report to NEA/PUB/SFA
Camera
Access the phone's camera if you wish to attach a photograph while making a Report to NEA/PUB/SFA
Microphone
Required to record videos

bluejetty:00098776:ios.description:
Love isn't just something you feel — it's something you create together, every single day.
Welcome to Lovora, the relationship app for couples that brings back the spark, the laughter, and the deep connection you've always wanted.
Whether you're together or in a long-distance relationship, Lovora makes it easy to feel close, stay connected, and celebrate your love story through playful couple games, 2-player mini games, meaningful conversations, and romantic rituals designed to make your bond stronger.
Relationships grow when partners take the time to play, talk, laugh fondly about shared memories, and create new ones together. Lovora turns these small moments into daily experiences that help couples reconnect and grow closer.
Inspired by the many ways love evolves — sometimes playful like amora, sometimes warm and comforting like lovio, and always built through deeper relatio between two people — Lovora creates a space where couples can explore their connection in fun, meaningful, and memorable ways.
1. Play couple games and 2-player mini games together
Challenge each other in real-time couple games made for two — Chess, Ludo, Carrom, Sea Battle, Four in a Row, Snakes & Ladders, Tic Tac Toe, and a shared drawing board where you can doodle side by side. Quick to learn, easy to play, and endlessly fun.
2. Stay playful in long distance with online couple games
Living apart? Play together from separate phones, wherever you are. Lovora's long-distance games keep the laughter and friendly competition alive across any city, country, or time zone.
3. Keep each other close with couple widgets
Add couple widgets to your home screen and feel connected all day — see your shared moments, streaks, and little reminders of your partner without even opening the app.
4. Play Never Have I Ever – Couple Edition
Turn ordinary nights into unforgettable memories with playful couple challenges and fun couple games.
5. Deepen your bond with meaningful couples questions

bluejetty:00167995:ios.summary:

Hero Rescue 2026 is the brain-bending pin-pulling puzzle adventure where every move matters. Our hero set out for treasure and to rescue the princess — but dragons, wolves, monsters a
bluejetty:00167995:ios.description:
Pull the pins. Outsmart the puzzles. Save the princess.
Hero Rescue 2026 is the brain-bending pin-pulling puzzle adventure where every move matters. Our hero set out for treasure and to rescue the princess — but dragons, wolves, monsters and tricky puzzle traps stand in the way. The good news? You have the pins. Pull them in the right order and the path opens up.
Watch out: pull the wrong pin and lava floods the wrong room… or worse, the princess takes the hit. Pull the right one and monsters drown in poison, gold pours into the hero's hands, and the rope falls to free the princess. Simple. Satisfying. Smart.
Hundreds of free puzzles. New levels added all the time. No time limit. No pressure. Just you, your brain, and a hero who really, really needs your help.
HOW TO PLAY
- Tap the pins to pull them
- Plan the order carefully — physics decides the rest
- Pour lava and poison on enemies
- Cut ropes to save the hero and the princess
- Loot every coin you can on the way
FEATURES
- Hundreds of brain-bending pin puzzles
- Fresh levels added regularly
- Loot gold, defeat dragons and monsters
- Cut ropes to free the princess
- Build your own castle with looted treasure
- No time limit — think as long as you need
- 100% offline — play anywhere, no Wi-Fi required
- Friendly, simple controls
- Beautiful graphics and smooth sound
- Free to play (with optional Remove Ads upgrade for an ad-free experience)
A REAL BRAIN WORKOUT
Hero Rescue 2026 isn't just another casual game. It's a logic puzzle, a tricky brain test, and an IQ challenge wrapped in a fantasy adventure. Every level asks the same question: can you see the trick before you pull?
Most players give up somewhere around the harder boss puzzles. Only about 10% finish the game. Do you have what it takes to be a true hero?
PERFECT FOR FANS OF
- Pull the pin puzzle games
- Loot-and-rescue brain teasers
- Save the princess / rescue hero adventures
- Tricky brain tests and IQ challenges
- Logic puzzles, knight quests, dragon battles
- Casual offline puzzle games
Whether you have five minutes during a coffee break or a long flight ahead, Hero Rescue 2026 fits perfectly. Quick to learn. Hard to put down. Endless to master.
DOWNLOAD AND START RESCUING
Free to play, fully offline, no time pressure. Just pull the pin, beat the boss, save the princess. The treasure won't loot itself.
We read every review and feature request. Reach out anytime through the in-game support menu or via the email on our App Store page.
May your IQ be high — and your princess be safe!

bluejetty:00151864:ios.summary:

That’s how the song goes, right? Well, now it does, seeing as how the apocalypse has come and gone and the last remaining survivors, yourself included, are left to rebuild society, starting with the loca
bluejetty:00151864:ios.description:
► WALKING IN A WASTELAND WONDERLAND
That’s how the song goes, right? Well, now it does, seeing as how the apocalypse has come and gone and the last remaining survivors, yourself included, are left to rebuild society, starting with the local jail! Unexpected, yes, but just because the world got laid to waste doesn’t mean that all crime stopped. Craft, build, and defend your prison hub as you rehabilitate inmates while also building a shelter and trying to survive in this idle prison RPG.
► THEY’RE IN THE JAILHOUSE NOW
This game combines all the fun of idle games, where you’ll craft buildings, workbenches, and more that will collect resources for you in the background, with the fun of RPGs as you work to clean up the area, manage and expand the prison, and become an all-around jail tycoon. Along the way you’ll also have a chance to help rebuild your world, one reformed criminal and beautified spot at a time. Don’t go soft yet through: you’ve still got to defend your territory and survive!
We think you’ll love:
● Crafting: Simple items can turn into deadly tools and crazy weapons in your hands, all it takes is a bit of skill and a touch of forward thinking. Collect all manner of items as you clean up the last dregs of chaos, and then use these to help build new prison wings, weapons, and gear. Your survival depends on it!
● Upgrading: Once you have your base items, don’t sit back on your laurels! Upgrade them to the max so no matter what the wasteland throws at your shelter you’ll be prepared. In addition to weapons and gear you’ll also need to ensure your survival by constructing buildings and then setting up defenses and protecting them. Who knows what’s out there!
● Exploring: As your need for resources grows, you’ll have to travel further and further afield to collect items to keep your prison running and ensure your survival. Enjoy the opportunity to see a whole new world post-apocalypse and explore all manner of mysterious places as you roam. Don’t be afraid of a little danger though, that’s usually where you’ll find the best loot stashed.
● Growing: Grow your jail, your world, and even your character! The more you progress, the more skills will be unlocked, thus boosting your little guy and helping you survive.
● Playing: Your survival might be on the line, but this is still a game! You can enjoy this idle wasteland exploration game anytime, anywhere, as no internet connection is required. Squeeze in a little world building and jail building no matter what the situation.
► SURVIVAL OF THE SMARTEST
Test your post-apocalypse survival skills now in this fun and exciting idle game, where as one of the last survivors you’ll need to build a prison to rehabilitate the bad guys, maintain it, and make the world a little better in the process. Along the way build both your world and your character, explore exciting new landscapes, and move from surviving, to thriving. 
Download Lost Prison today to show that you’ve got what it takes!

Terms of Use: https://say.games/terms-of-use

Turn your iPhone or iPad into a powerful and elegant keyboard extension with numbers and navigation pads.

Create custom keypads for your professional tools to boost productivity.
Move freely and control your computer from across the room. No line of sight is required - the app uses WiFi to connect to your computer.

Setup is both quick and easy, just download the helper app from my website and install it on your computer and that's it.

The app exists since 2016 and has been downloaded more than 300,000 times and received very positive reviews both from users and from the press. It's actively maintained and receives frequent updates with new and exciting features.

MAIN FEATURES
- Numbers block
- Navigation block

ADVANCED FEATURES
- Create custom keypads to control apps and websites
- High customization of the app interface
- History of connected devices for quicker re-connection
- Wake On LAN

REQUIREMENTS
- Mac with macOS 10.10 or newer
- PC with Windows 7 SP1 or newer
- Free helper app, available at https://cherpake.com/get
- Shared network connection, WiFi or Personal Hotspot, see https://cherpake.com/connect

bluejetty:00145540:ios.description:
O GRUPO LRS
Após 25 anos prestando serviços de administração de condomínios em Blumenau e região, a Condor Condomínios se uniu a Emmy Serviços e a EMI Seguros para formarem o Grupo LRS.
Inovação, transparência e competência são os principais pilares do Grupo LRS e serão aplicados diariamente na execução dos nossos serviços, visando longevidade no mercado e a satisfação do cliente.
Apresentamos o aplicativo Grupo LRS permite automatizar as rotinas do condomínio como:
- cadastro completo de condôminos, seus veículos, animais de estimação e outros moradores da unidade
- comunicação entre síndico e moradores com controle de pendências, grupos de discussão, achados e perdidos, avisos, manutenção, etc (com moderação).
- reservas no salão de festas, mudanças e outras agendas,
- acesso ao regimento e demais documentos do condomínio,
- boletos das taxas mensais - prestação de contas interativa mês a mês com anexos dos comprovantes e aprovação online da pasta
- visão da evolução dos gastos por conta e grupo de conta (Gastos com água, energia, contratos, manutenções, etc)
- comparativo de orçado versus realizado (gráficos e detalhamento)
- visão da inadimplência (relatórios e gráficos)
- gestão de contratos com terceiros
- gestão de manutenções preventivas e periódicas
- gestão e comunicação de multas e advertências com direito a defesa,
- visão da relação de funcionários e corpo diretivo do condomínio,
- cadastro de fornecedores e prestadores de serviço,
- acesso aos dados de departamento pessoal (folha, escala de férias, projeções)
- controle da entrada e saída de visitantes,
- autorização da entrada de visitantes,
- acesso às câmeras de segurança,
- avisos de chegada e retirada de encomendas,
- registro e publicação da leitura de água e gás,
- integração com sistemas de portaria remota, controle de acesso, automação e muito mais.
Tudo isso para dar mais transparência e eficiência à gestão de condomínios.
Todas as mensagens geram notificação pelo aplicativo e por e-mail, bem como sua entrega e leitura são disponibilizadas no painel da administração.
Para se cadastrar como morador no aplicativo, é preciso que o seu condomínio já esteja cadastrado em nossa base.
Se tiver dúvidas entre em contato conosco. 
grupolrs@winker.com.br

DOWNLOAD and REGISTER now!
• Open to all networks 
• Zero-rated for Globe and TM 
• Regulated by BSP
SEND MONEY IN REAL-TIME
• Free GCash-to-GCash transactions
• Send to GCash accounts via Express Send
• Transfer funds to other e-wallets & banks such as Maya, BPI, BDO, Unionbank, Landbank, Metrobank, Chinabank, and more
• Save bank account details for future transfers
SA GLOAD, LAGING MAY BONUS SA BAWAT LOAD

• Free Health Insurance with up to ₱2.5K Hospital Allowance

• 2,400+ billers including Electric and Water Utilities, Loans, Government dues, and more
• Hassle-free payments with our schedule payments or simply save your favorite billers
• Short on funds? Settle your bill now, and pay later with GCredit or pay lighter via GGives
PAY EASILY EVERYWHERE YOU GO
• Enjoy barya-free payments with Scan to Pay via GCash QR or QRPh across millions of merchants nationwide and globally with Alipay+ QR, and use it more to unlock GGives installment options
• Use the GCash Card to pay with 0% forex in 200+ countries and territories
• Pay with GCash Tap to Pay at over 350,000 checkout terminals local and abroad
• Pay Online securely and instantly on e-commerce platforms, and get up to P20k coverage in case of scams with Online Shopping Protect
• Link directly to the App Store to pay for subscriptions, games, movies, and more
KAYA TODAY WHEN YOU BORROW WITH GCASH
• Borrow instantly up to ₱150k with GLoan 
• Pay later up to ₱50K with 0.17% daily interest with GCredit
• Pay in installments up to 24 months and zero downpayment with GGives
• Borrow Load for as low as ₱20 across all networks, payable up to 14 days
MANAGE YOUR WEALTH EASILY
• GSave - one savings marketplace
 - high interest rates from trusted bank partners
 - no minimum deposit or balance
 - easy to open, manage, and access anytime
* GStocks - Instant approval, become a part-owner of the top local companies for as low as ₱500
* GFunds - Simple investing managed by experts, and a wide selection of local and global funds for as low as ₱50
* GBonds - Invest in government securities for as low as ₱500, earn guaranteed interest
* GCrypto - Register in less than 30 seconds, get instant approval and access to curated cryptocurrencies for as low as ₱200, beginner-friendly
BE EXTRA READY & PROTECTED WITH INSURANCE
• Hospitalization & Accident Insurance starting ₱48, up to ₱1.2M coverage for medical expenses and critical illnesses
• Get Travel Insurance in fast as 5 minutes, starting ₱299, up to ₱2.5M coverage
• Scam Protection for only ₱30 for 30-day protection against scams, up to ₱15K coverage
CASH IN ONLINE & OFFLINE
• In-app: partner banks or online banking with Instapay 
• Over-the-counter: Cebuana Lhuillier, Palawan, Puregold, Pay&Go, and more
PLANT REAL TREES BY COLLECTING GREEN ENERGY
• Earn and collect Energy Points through GCash transactions, then our partners will plant real trees in various Philippine forests

bluejetty:00182829:ios.description:
Charge into the action in the best Tower Defense TD game ever created! Welcome to Kingdom Rush!
Kingdom Rush is the first installment of the award-winning offline tower defense saga, loved by millions and earning accolades from gamers and critics around the globe.
Use your strategy to defend & guard the kingdom and its castle as you crush the forces of evil. At your command, you will have a vast arsenal of epic towers and spells! Command the mightiest heroes and lead the greatest army in Linirea to victory in this epic offline tower defense game that will keep you hooked for hours!
Fight on a castle outskirts, forests, mountains, and wastelands, customizing your defensive strategy with different tower tests and specializations! Rain fire upon your enemies, summon reinforcements, command your troops, recruit elven warriors and face legendary monsters on this adventure to save the Kingdom from the forces of darkness!
Kingdom Rush game features:
SET YOUR STRATEGY WITH THESE AMAZING TOWERS AND UPGRADES
-PLAN YOUR STRATEGY! Choose among very different tower styles. Clash against your enemies! In this TD offline game, you will need to think about your strategy!
-MAXIMIZE YOUR ARMY'S POWER with 18 tower unique abilities. Rush and test them!
GUARD, LEAD, AND CONQUER THE KINGDOM
-13 MIGHTY HEROES who will help lead your troops to victory!
-COMMAND YOUR ARMY into action and watch them engage in hand-to-hand cartoon combat! Clash the hordes of enemies!
EPIC TOWER DEFENSE CONTENT
-OVER 50 UNIQUE ENEMIES from Goblins to Demons each with their own unique attributes! Fantasy TD at its best!
-MORE THAN 60 ACHIEVEMENTS with easter eggs to discover and challenges to overcome!
-EXTRA GAME MODES that will push your TD battle strategies to the limit!
-INTENSE BOSS FIGHTS with the Kingdom’s greatest threats, going head to head with your allies!
-IN-GAME ENCYCLOPEDIA with useful information from your towers and enemies alike! Use this to plan your best strategy and clash with your enemies!
-PLAY OFFLINE! Test your defense skills even offline as the battle action does not stop even if the internet does! Enjoy hours of tower defense gameplay anytime, anywhere!
HEARD ON THE MEDIA ABOUT THIS EPIC TOWER DEFENSE ROYALE GAME:
89/100 Metacritic score!
"Probably the best true tower defense game. It's funny, it's polished, and it's hard as balls." - IGN (Editor's choice 9/10 "Amazing")
"One of the most engaging TD games we've played..." -Slidetoplay.com (STP Score of 4 out of 4 "Must Have")
"Kingdom Rush can be filed in the thin folder marked "games that are pretty much perfect" -JayisGames.com
"This is one kingdom you'll be in no rush to escape from" -PocketGamer (Gold Award - Score 9)
"Kingdom Rush proves that the defense genre is still alive." -148Apps (4.5 Stars out of 5) Editor's Choice
"TD with a Touch of Excellence" -toucharcade.com (4.5 stars out of 5)
#8 at CNET's Top 30 Tablet games.
#7 at IGN's Top 25 Mobile games.
Command your troops and towers to protect the kingdom! ! Play the epic tower-defense royale Kingdom Rush game with your defense strategy!

It is fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage you personal finances. 
FEATURES
Multi-Account Aggregation: View all of your financial information (balances, transaction history, merchant spending averages) in one place for on-the-go organization.
Alerts & Notifications: Set alerts for low funds and be notified about upcoming bills.
Add Tags, Notes, Images & Geo-Information: By enhancing transactions with custom tags, notes or photos of a receipt or check, you have the ability to stay organized and find exactly what you're looking for when searching through your finances.
Contact: Locate ATM's or branches and contact International Finance Bank customer service directly from the app.
SAFE AND SECURE: The app utilizes the same bank-level security that protects you when you're on Internet Banking. The app also features a unique 4-digit passcode setting that prevents unauthorized access. 
GETTING STARTED: To use the IFB Business Mobile Banking app, you must be enrolled as an International Finance Internet Banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials. After you successfully login to the app, your accounts and transactions will begin updating.

bluejetty:00044999:ios.description:
Sleepal for watch – A Must-Have Apple Watch App for Better Sleep
Sleep is essential to everyone. That’s why Sleepal not only tracks your sleep with scientific, objective data—but also listens to how you really feel.
With a proprietary scoring algorithm rooted in scientific standards, Sleepal analyzes your sleep quality across multiple metrics, while also recording your subjective experience. Through cross-analysis and smart insights based on CBTi (Cognitive Behavioral Therapy for Insomnia), Sleepal helps you pinpoint the root causes of your sleep issues and offers personalized, evidence-based improvement suggestions.
Understandable Sleep Scores
- Sleepal exclusive scoring system draws on validated sleep scales, including the Pittsburgh Sleep Quality Index (PSQI), to generate a clear, daily score based on multiple dimensions of your sleep.
- Every morning, you’ll receive a personalized Sleep Report, featuring your overall sleep score, sleep stages, consistency, and physiological data—all explained clearly.
Snore Detection
- Free, stored locally, never uploaded — just open and use.
Fully Automatic Nap Detection
- Apple Watch doesn’t natively detect short naps—but Sleepal does. It accurately tracks naps longer than 15 minutes.
- Once installed, naps are logged automatically and you’ll get a notification when you wake up—no manual input required.
CBTi-Based Smart Suggestions
- If something’s off with your sleep, Sleepal helps uncover the underlying causes by linking related metrics and applying CBTi principles to guide you with effective, science-backed solutions.
- Common issues? We’ve got tailored suggestions for that too:
 - How can I reduce snoring?
 - How do I increase deep sleep time?
 - What if I keep waking up during the night?
Track Long-Term Trends
- Daily reports are useful—but long-term trends are crucial. Sleepal helps you spot real patterns of improvement by tracking changes over time.
- Monitor trends in sleep duration, efficiency, and regularity at a glance.
Correlate Sleep with Body Signals
- Sleepal links sleep data with physiological signals like heart rate, respiratory rate, and HRV, aligned with your sleep stages, helping you understand how your body responds during sleep.
For feedback or suggestions, reach out on TikTok @sleepal or email us at support@sleepal.ai
Thank you for using Sleepal! Sleep well every night!
Privacy Policy: https://www.xsmart.com/sleepal/about/global/en/privacy/
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00186248:ios.description:
** Editor's Choice ** — Apple
** App of the Day ** — Apple
** Approved for privacy, security, clinical assurance, and safety ** — DHAF & ORCHA
Rootd is anxiety and panic attack relief in your pocket. Award-winning, scientifically validated, female led and seen in Women's Health, Time Magazine, Healthline and more. With millions of users worldwide, Rootd is the go-to app for anxiety & panic attacks for more and more people each day.
“I’ve suffered from panic attacks for almost 10 years. I’ve done CBT, medication, meditation, but nothing helped me in the moment when that panic attack hit, until I downloaded Rootd. Rootd makes it feel like someone is with me, even when I’m alone. I owe my continued stability to this simple genius app. It's a MUST for all who are facing the same type of war.” RainyNally
Understand, and overcome anxiety & panic attacks with Rootd’s therapist-approved panic button, guided deep breathing, anxiety journal, soothing visualizations, stats page, emergency contact, and lessons. 
We set out to build Rootd after suffering from panic attacks and anxiety for several years. The only help we could find was either too expensive, ineffective, or poorly designed. Our mission is to help others find accessible relief from their panic and anxiety, and to end the stigma against those affected. 
Finally, an app for conquering panic attacks and anxiety that blends a guided process for both immediate and long term relief, with clean and engaging design. 
Rootd’s core features and content include:
THE ROOTR, PANIC ATTACK SOS BUTTON
A panic button to bring a swift end to panic attacks based on the latest techniques in Cognitive Behavioural Therapy (CBT).
LESSONS
Find some peace of mind by learning about where anxiety comes from, how our bodies and minds experience panic attacks, and why this all might be happening to you.
BREATHE
The perfect tool to practice deep breathing daily and find calm during times of stress.
JOURNAL
Track and identify moods, habits, and subconscious triggers of anxiety and panic attacks.
VISUALIZE
Guided body scans, visualizations, ASMR, and nature sounds to get rooted when feeling anxious.
SLEEP
White noise, ASMR, sleep stories, relaxing sounds, and music for you to gain calm and sleep deeply.
EMERGENCY CONTACT
For when you need to hear a friendly voice, you can immediately call a friend, family member, or nearby help center directly from the app. 
PERSONAL STATS
Take pride in your healing progress and gain appreciation for how far you’ve come.
To continue your journey, you can upgrade to unlock Full Access to Rootd, including:
MORE LESSONS
Learn changes you can make and exercises you can perform to guide you through the remainder of the journey to lifelong relief and to living panic attack free.
Rootd saves your Breathe, Visualize, and Sleep sessions to your Apple Health app.
Subscription Pricing and Terms
Get full access to all Rootd's content and features by purchasing a monthly or yearly auto-renewing Full Access subscription. Or get lifetime full access for a one-time payment. Pricing may vary by country.
Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Your Rootd subscription will automatically renew at the end of each term and your credit card will be charged through your iTunes account unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Subscriptions may be managed and auto-renewal turned off any time from your iTunes Account Settings after purchase.
“I appreciate the simple, factual, and yet caring approach of Rootd that makes it an inviting, interesting, and easy to use tool. I endorse this for individuals looking for support and tools for managing anxiety and panic attacks.”
Wendy Marion-Orienti - Licensed PRH counsellor
Terms: https://www.rootd.io/terms-conditions
Privacy Policy: https://www.rootd.io/privacy-policy

Priver is a private browser that automatically locks and protects your browsing history and bookmarks.
• On the home screen, it appears with a calculator-style icon and name, and can be used as a regular calculator at launch.
• When you enter your passcode, the app switches to browser mode, allowing secure and private internet browsing with its built-in browser. Your history and bookmarks are stored only within the app and are never accessible to other apps or devices.
• When the screen is turned off or you return to the home screen, browser mode automatically closes and reverts to calculator mode, keeping your privacy safe even after use.
• No account registration or personal information is required — you can start using it right away.
Note:
On first launch, a tutorial explains how to set and enter your passcode. If you use multiple iOS devices, please complete the tutorial on each device.

bluejetty:00161269:ios.name: Daily Rosary Meditations
bluejetty:00161269:ios.summary:
***The fastest growing daily rosary podcast now in an app!***
Want to start praying, but don’t know how? Pray, learn, and grow your faith with the Daily Rosary community, all completely free! Join us every morning for Scripture, meditation
bluejetty:00161269:ios.description:
***The fastest growing daily rosary podcast now in an app!***
Want to start praying, but don’t know how? Pray, learn, and grow your faith with the Daily Rosary community, all completely free! Join us every morning for Scripture, meditation, and a Rosary - all under 25 minutes. It’s perfect for your daily commute or your morning coffee.
People today are feeling increasingly distanced and lonely - we lack community. That’s why we’re growing an authentic Catholic community built on friendship, good conversation, and the Rosary - so we can lead people to Jesus through Mary and encourage each other in our faith.
WHY IS IT IMPORTANT TO PRAY THE ROSARY?
* Mary has come from Heaven asking us to pray the Rosary every day.
* In 1917, at Fatima, Our Lady requested: “Pray the Rosary every day, in order to obtain peace for the world, and the end of the war.”
* At Akita, Japan, in 1973, Mary said to Sr. Sasagawa: "Pray very much the prayers of the Rosary. I alone am able still to save you from the calamities which approach. Those who place their confidence in me will be saved."
* On April 10, 1986, in the approved apparition of San Nicolas, Argentina, Mary said, “You see this crown because this is what I want you to do, create a real crown of rosaries…the Holy Rosary is the weapon which the enemy fears. It is also the refuge of those who look for relief for their sufferings, and it is the door to enter into my heart. Glory to the Lord for the Light which He gives the world.”
* Praying the Rosary can change world events.
WHAT YOU GET
* Pray, learn, and grow your faith with new Rosary meditations each and every day
* Share faith with a community
* Join a team of people that prays together and shares life
* Meet and message other members like yourself
* Create your own groups and invite friends and family
* Free access to our daily Rosary podcast and other community benefits
* Receive alerts when new Rosary meditations are posted
The Daily Rosary Meditations podcast and other content is created by our two cofounders: Dr. Mike Scherschligt and Dr. Troy Hinkel. Both are theologians of the highest esteem who previously studied under Scott Hahn at the Franciscan University of Steubenville, where they received their master’s degrees in Theology. Following this, Dr. Mike received his Doctorate in Sacred Theology (STD) from the Marianum in Rome, and Dr. Troy received his doctorate in Modern European History with an emphasis on Church/State relations from the University of Kansas. Dr. Mike is also the author of the online series Faith Foundations, which is used to certify catechists throughout the United States.

bluejetty:00166105:ios.summary: Prepare for a thrilling new twist in the world of strategy gaming with Country Balls: World Battle! Experience the excitement of capturing territories and expanding your empire not just through direct combat but also by inciting riots and r
bluejetty:00166105:ios.description:
Prepare for a thrilling new twist in the world of strategy gaming with Country Balls: World Battle! Experience the excitement of capturing territories and expanding your empire not just through direct combat but also by inciting riots and revolts within enemy states. Transform the tides of war in this tactical adventure where you can either lead your army to a glorious victory or manipulate the unrest of your adversaries to secure your expansion!
In this dynamic strategy game, you will need to react quickly to dynamic changes on the playing field! Attack head-on or weaken your opponents from the inside. Command your unique Country Balls army as you engage in real-time battles, capture countries and overtake territories while cleverly leveraging the chaos of uprisings. It's your call—will you charge into battle, or will you mastermind the dissent and seize control without firing a shot?
Game Features:
Territory Capture & Riots: Use your strategic prowess to capture enemy states through direct conflict or incite riots to turn their own people against them!
Dynamic Gameplay: Participate in tactical, real-time strategy battles where every decision counts. Fight for every inch of land and adapt your plan based on emerging situations.
Resource Management: Build a robust economy, fortify your borders, and accumulate resources while keeping an eye on your enemies who may try to do the same.
Customization Options: Tailor your Country Balls avatar with a myriad of customization options to showcase your unique style while leading your troops.
Advanced Warfare: For players looking for an edge, unlock powerful game-changing options, including nuclear weapons to obliterate enemy strongholds and claim their territories effortlessly.
Challenge yourself as you strategize, build your state, and establish dominion over the globe in this exhilarating simulator. Watch as the balance of power shifts with every riot and troop movement—this is a world where the cunning and the courageous thrive!
Step into the shoes of a wise commander or a ruthless dictator as you cultivate your territory and engage in epic confrontations. Use your tactical skill to ignite revolts in enemy cities, paving the way for a new victorious reign under your leadership. In Country Balls: World Battle, every choice you make can lead to triumph or disaster.
Are you ready to rally your Country Balls warriors, initiate the riots, and capture the world? Download Country Balls: World Battle for free today and embark on your journey to conquest, strategy, and endless fun! Embrace your fate, and let the world witness your rise to power!

bluejetty:00097083:ios.description:
This app is home to Glenn Beck’s most important venture yet: Torch.
Every day, we're flooded with headlines, breaking news, and endless opinions. But information alone doesn't create understanding.
Torch was built for people who want to go deeper.
Torch connects today's biggest stories to the history, ideas, and principles that shaped them. Through original documentaries, exclusive analysis, historical research, and powerful storytelling, Torch helps you see not just what is happening—but why.
Whether you're looking to better understand current events, rediscover America's founding principles, or explore history through fresh eyes, Torch content on the Glenn Beck app gives you the context you won't find anywhere else.
Inside this app you'll find:
• The Glenn Beck Program — Watch or listen live and on demand.
• Exclusive Insider Shows — Go beyond the broadcast with extended conversations available only to Torch Insiders.
• Original Documentaries & Specials — Award-winning investigations and historical documentaries that connect the past to the present.
• George AI — Explore America's founding through an AI built from original source documents, including letters, speeches, diaries, debates, and more.
• Live Events & Q&As — Join exclusive conversations with Glenn and special guests.
• Educational Resources — Songs, study guides, and original content designed to help families pass America's story to the next generation.
• Community — Connect with other Torch Insiders near you and around the country and join a community of other truth-seeking Americans who “get it.”
Torch on the Glenn Beck app isn't just another streaming service. It's a place for people who believe understanding matters, history matters, and truth matters.
Download the Glenn Beck app and start exploring Torch today. Now compatible with Apple CarPlay.
