bluejetty:00091938:ios.summary: MotorMia revolutionizes how you plan and execute car modifications using cutting-edge AI technology. Whether you're a seasoned car enthusiast or just starting your modding journey, Mia helps you discover the perfect modifications for your v
bluejetty:00091938:ios.description:
MotorMia revolutionizes how you plan and execute car modifications using cutting-edge AI technology. Whether you're a seasoned car enthusiast or just starting your modding journey, Mia helps you discover the perfect modifications for your vehicle.
How It Works:
1. Add your vehicle using VIN lookup or manual entry
2. Chat with Mia about your car customization goals
3. Get personalized mod recommendations
4. Save parts to your build list
5. Share your build with the community
Key Features:
• AI-Powered Mod Recommendations – Our AI assistant gives you expert suggestions for car modifications based on your specific make, model, and customization goals
• Vehicle-Specific Parts – Add your car using VIN or manual entry to receive compatible mod recommendations
• Aftermarket Brand Discovery – Explore trusted aftermarket brands or let Mia recommend community favorites
• Save & Track Your Build – Keep track of planned upgrades and create your dream build list
• Visual Build Planning – Upload images of your car real world build to the community and learn from others
• Community Inspiration – Browse other car builds and get inspired by fellow enthusiasts
INTELLIGENT MOD RECOMMENDATIONS AT YOUR COMMAND
• Add your exact vehicle for personalized part compatibility
• Get AI-powered suggestions tailored to your performance and aesthetic goals
• Explore proven modifications backed by thousands of successful builds
• Make confident decisions with expert guidance every step of the way
COMPREHENSIVE MODIFICATION DATABASE
• Performance parts from trusted aftermarket brands
• Suspension components for street, track, or show
• Aesthetic upgrades from subtle to aggressive
• Engine modifications with supporting mod requirements
• Interior enhancements for comfort and style
SMART FEATURES FOR SMARTER BUILDS
• Natural chat interface – ask Mia anything about car mods
• Build list tracking to organize your project stages
• Community builds for real-world inspiration
• Brand-specific recommendations when you have preferences
• Compatibility checking to avoid costly mistakes
YOUR PERSONAL MOD CONSULTANT
• Get answers to complex modification questions instantly
• Understand the implications of each upgrade
• Learn about supporting mods needed for major changes
• Receive stage-based recommendations for gradual builds
STAY CONNECTED TO THE COMMUNITY
• Browse successful builds from other enthusiasts
• Share your own build journey and progress
• Learn from others' experiences and mistakes
• Find inspiration for your next modification
• Perfect for All Types of Car Mods:
• Performance upgrades (turbos, exhausts, intakes)
• Suspension & handling improvements
• Aesthetic mods (body kits, wheels, wraps)
• Interior customization
• Lighting upgrades
• Audio system enhancements
Ready to modify your car online? Start your AI car tuning journey free with Motormia. Your perfect build is just a conversation away!

Great for relaxing, inspiring yourself before sleep, or studying peacefully.
> Smart Search Option
Find stations instantly by name, city, or genre.
Explore new inspiring channels and discover trending broadcasts.
 Download Guatemala Radio FM Motivation now and stay inspired 24/7 with the best sounds of Guatemala!

bluejetty:00014711:ios.description:
ServiceNow Mobile Agent app delivers out-of-the-box, mobile-first experiences for the most common service desk agent workflows, making it easy for agents to triage, act on and resolve requests on the go. The app enables service desk agents to promptly manage and resolve end user issues from their mobile devices. Agents use the app’s intuitive interface to accept and update work even without Internet connectivity. The app greatly simplifies work by leveraging native device capabilities for tasks like navigation, barcode scanning, or collecting a signature.
The app comes with out-of-the-box workflows for service desk agents in IT, Customer Service, HR, Field Services, Security Ops and IT Asset Management. Organizations can easily configure and extend the workflows to meet their own unique needs. 
With Mobile Agent you can:
• Manage the work assigned to your teams
• Triage incidents and cases
• Act on approvals with swipe gestures and quick actions
• Complete work while offline
• Access the full issue details, activity stream, and related lists of records
• Optimize workflows with location, camera, and touchscreen hardware
NOTE: This app requires the ServiceNow Rome instance or later.

bluejetty:00146938:ios.description:
Date Christians with Ark—the unapologetically Christian dating app made by Christians, for single Christian men and women of all denominations. 
Find meaningful, faith-filled relationships without endless swiping, awkward small talk, or ghosting—it's time to board the Ark.
REAL PEOPLE, BIBLE VERIFIED 
• No catfish, no creeps—all profiles are Bible Verified with AI and human review, so you know every match is legit.
SWIPE WITH PURPOSE
• Swipe up to like, send a Note to leave a thoughtful impression, or swipe down to move on—because every swipe matters on Ark.
UNAPOLOGETICALLY CHRISTIAN MATCHES
• Match based on denomination, church attendance, marital history, and family planning goals.
CHAT FOR FREE
• Send unlimited messages to turn online matches into real-life dates.
MATCHES THAT MEAN SOMETHING
• Matches expire after a limited time without a message, reducing ghosting and wasted time.
LIFESTYLES THAT MATCH YOURS
• Find Christians who share your lifestyle preferences, like Pets, Fitness, Politics, or being Smoke-Free.
SEE WHO LIKES YOU
• View likes for free or skip the swiping with Ark First Class to match directly.
QUALITY OVER QUANTITY
• Strict standards mean fewer unsolicited inappropriate photos or overly suggestive content, while keeping bios free from reading like a grocery list.
SAFETY YOU CAN TRUST
• Advanced AI tools and human moderation keep Ark safe, secure, and focused on building a respectful and holy community.
PRIVACY THAT PUTS YOU IN CONTROL
• Keep your profile private and visible only to those you like, and know when your messages are read with Ark Premium.
PREMIUM FEATURES FOR BETTER MATCHES
•Filter matches by what matters most, send notes, and revisit skipped profiles with unlimited double-takes.
ALL DENOMINATIONS WELCOME
• Join Catholics, Baptists, Anglican, Evangelical, Reformed, Orthodox, Pentecostals, Lutherans, Methodists, Nondenominational and more who believe in Christ.
DATE INTENTIONALLY WITH ARK
Ark isn’t a worldly app. If you’re just fishing, this isn’t your boat. It’s where single believers ages 18 and upward+ find real, faith-centered relationships without compromises or wasted time.
• Privacy: https://support.arkdating.app/article/72-privacy-policy
• Terms: https://support.arkdating.app/article/71-terms-of-service
• Community Standards: https://arkdating.app/standards

bluejetty:00138958:ios.description:
Live Traffic Cameras in CA provides real-time access to traffic and traveler information supplied by the California Department of Transportation (Caltrans). Using this app, you can check traffic jam, travel alerts, road conditions, road closures and highway cameras before driving.
Best features:
- Near real-time updates on winter road conditions, traffic incidents, road closures and chain controls
- Filter cameras by districts or counties
- Easy to quick check road conditions with two columns camera displays 
- Statewide GPS traffic alert details display on map
- Roadwork and construction are also showed on map.
- Quickly locate the incident on map by selecting it from list
- Live Radio for all California's counties
- Find rest stops on your way
- Map can show both normal and satellite mode.
- Access to California statewide streaming traffic cameras with live capacities
- Dark Mode is very helpful for you when driving during the night
***
Thank you for downloading app. We are continuing to add more and more features. All feedback and suggestions are welcome.

bluejetty:00164988:ios.description:
Discover Find Lost BLE Device Tracker
Effortlessly locate your misplaced iPhone, iPad, AirPods, Apple Watch, Apple Pencil, headphones, speakers, earbuds, and other Bluetooth devices in minutes. TrackIt leverages your device’s Bluetooth signal to pinpoint locations with remarkable precision.
TrackIt supports all Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) devices, making it a universal tool for you and your family to find anything that’s gone missing with ease.
HOW IT WORKS:
1) Open TrackIt and grant Bluetooth permission.
2) Select the device you are looking for from the list.
3) Move around to improve signal strength.
4) Locate the device.
SIGNAL STRENGTH:
• Utilize the Bluetooth connection for precise tracking.
• Signal strength increases as you near the device.
• Built-in radar enhances accuracy.
• Estimated distance metrics facilitate quick recovery.
COMPATIBLE DEVICES:
• Supports most BLE devices.
• Supports all modern Apple devices and most Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) devices (Bluetooth 4.0 and later).
• Compatible with various Apple and third-party products.
• AirPods, AirPods Pro, AirPods (3rd generation), AirPods Pro (2nd generation), AirPods Max
• Apple Pencil 1, Apple Pencil 2, Apple Pencil (USB-C) (iPad app only)
• iPhone 5 and later (including all newer models)
• Apple Watch Series 1–10, Apple Watch SE (1st & 2nd generation), Apple Watch Ultra, Apple Watch Ultra 2
• iPad 3/4/5/6/7/8/9/10, iPad (10th generation and newer), iPad mini 2–6, iPad Air 1–5 (including M1), iPad Air (M2), iPad Pro 1–6 (including M1, M2, M4)
• iPod touch 6 and later
• MacBook, MacBook Pro, MacBook Air (including M1–M5), iMac, iMac Pro, Mac mini, Mac Studio
• JBL Charge, Flip 3
FEATURES:
• Visual radar for device proximity.
• Save frequently-used devices to a favorites list.
• Distance displayed in feet and meters.
• Compatible with Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) devices.
• Last known location timestamp for each device.
FREE TO USE:
Enjoy TrackIt's essential features at no cost, with optional in-app purchases available to support further development.
DISCLAIMER:
• TrackIt is unaffiliated with mentioned companies.
• All data is stored securely and locally.
Upgrade to TrackIt Gold for premium features:
- Support for All Bluetooth Devices
- Device Location on Map
- Ad-Free Experience
- Pinpoint Location Tracking
Choose from three auto-renewable subscription plans for TrackIt Gold:
- Weekly
- Monthly
- Lifetime
Subscription details:
- Payment charged to iTunes Account at purchase confirmation.
- Auto-renews unless turned off 24 hours before the end of the current period.
- Renewal charged within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period, identifying the cost of renewal.
- Manage subscriptions and turn off auto-renewal in Account Settings.
- Unused portion of free trial forfeited upon subscription purchase.

bluejetty:00160609:ios.description:
“God’s first word is silence.”
-Thomas Keating
Centering Prayer is a method of silent prayer that prepares us to receive the gift of contemplative prayer, prayer in which we experience God's presence within us, closer than breathing, closer than thinking, closer than consciousness itself. This method of prayer is both a relationship with God and a discipline to foster that relationship. Centering Prayer is not meant to replace other kinds of prayer; rather it casts a new light and depth of meaning on them. Centering Prayer is an ancient method of Christian prayer adapted for modern times by Fathers Thomas Keating, William Meninger and Basil Pennington.
The Centering Prayer application will support your daily prayer practice commitment. Beautiful and peaceful, the app includes an adjustable timer, as well as opening and closing prayer options that you may read before and after your silent prayer time. An assortment of sounds and backgrounds allow you to choose the type of environment you want to create for your prayer time. Brief instructions for learning Centering Prayer are also included. 
It is recommended you practice being in relationship with God through Centering Prayer twice a day for 20 minutes to begin with.

Centering Prayer is a method of silent prayer that prepares us to receive the gift of contemplative prayer, prayer in which we experience God's presence within us, closer than breathing, closer than thinking, closer than consciousness itself. This method of prayer is both a relationship with God and a discipline to foster that relationship. Centering Prayer is not meant to replace other kinds of prayer; rather it casts a new light and depth of meaning on them.  Centering Prayer is an ancient method of Christian prayer adapted for modern times by Fathers Thomas Keating, William Meninger and Basil Pennington.
 
The Centering Prayer application will support your daily prayer practice commitment.  Beautiful and peaceful, the app includes an adjustable timer, as well as opening and closing prayer options that you may read before and after your silent prayer time.  An assortment of sounds and backgrounds allow you to choose the type of environment you want to create for your prayer time.  Brief instructions for learning Centering Prayer are also included. 
 
It is recommended you practice being in relationship with God through Centering Prayer twice a day for 20 minutes to begin with.

bluejetty:00146564:ios.description:
Build your mental fitness with Mettle and improve your sleep, reduce anxiety, relieve stress, boost motivation and ultimately be more successful. Co-founded by Bear Grylls, Mettle is the new science-backed tool kit designed specifically to improve men’s mental health globally. We have brought in the best experts, including Paul McKenna and Dr Alex George to help all men lead happier and healthier lives. 
Our mission is to resource all men to be able to deal with their challenges and optimise their lives within just a few minutes a day. Our tools; meditation, mindfulness, breathwork, mind-hacking, hypnosis and daily motivation have been crafted to boost focus and energy, increase confidence, improve relationships and maximise your overall happiness. Mettle’s daily mental tools and challenges fit seamlessly into your routine to help you operate at peak performance and succeed, whatever your goals may be.
Make the most of our men’s mental health tool-kit, it’s been developed in partnership with leading organisations, experts and coaches, including Imperial College London, and leverages the latest research in psychology, neuroscience and performance motivation. Mettle’s content is empirically-backed, proven to work and is personalised to you, ensuring that no matter your goals, Mettle can help you to achieve them.
Prioritise your mental wellbeing and get started on your mental fitness journey with Mettle. Download today and begin your 14 day free trial. 
METTLE FEATURES
MEN’S MENTAL FITNESS TAILORED FOR YOU
- Get personalised mental fitness guidance and tools to help you achieve happiness, focus, and resilience.
- Create habits with AI assisted personalisation, guided meditation, mind-hacking, hypnosis and breathwork sessions to develop a mindset for success, perform at your peak, and handle anything that life throws at you.
START YOUR MENTAL WORKOUT SEAMLESSLY
- From guided meditation to sleep aid tools, find everything you need to elevate your mental health.
- Breathing exercises to soothe anxiety and paced breathing for effective stress relief
- Hypnosis techniques for deeper, restful sleep, reinforced with specific sleep soundscapes 
- Guided meditation and mood boosting insights to transform your outlook, reduce negative thinking loops, and amplify happiness 
- Power through life with the help of effective techniques for calming anxiety, stress, improving your sleep, and much more.
BUILD MENTAL STRENGTH WITH EXPERT-BACKED GUIDANCE
- Meet all of life’s challenges and overcome mental hurdles with expert insight tools.
- Get the mental health support you need to live a fulfilling life and avoid self-limiting behaviours.
- Build comprehensive mental fitness with tools and workouts aimed at improving sleep, calming anxiety, eliminating doubt, and more.
Download Mettle today for a practical approach towards men’s mental health that will help you build a mindset that puts you on track to living a confident, worry-free life.
Mettle is a new app and welcomes all feedback to help us provide the experience that you need.

The largest fleet of official taxis of Spain in just one app.

bluejetty:00013767:ios.description:
Turn your iPhone into a powerful portable PDF scanner. AI-powered auto-detect document borders, remove shadows and enhance clarity instantly. Support OCR text extraction, multi-page batch scanning and multi-format export. Perfect for business, school and personal use.
**Smart AI Scanning**
Automatic document edge detection, perspective correction, shadow & stain removal, and multiple filter modes (color, grayscale, black & white). Get crisp, professional scans in one tap.
**Accurate OCR Text Extraction**
Advanced optical character recognition technology extracts text from scanned documents instantly. Edit, copy and share extracted text freely, support multiple languages recognition.
**Multi-page Batch Scanning**
Scan dozens of pages in seconds with batch mode. Combine multiple scans into one single PDF document, rearrange pages or split files as needed.
**All-round Document Editing**
Add signatures, annotate pages, crop and adjust brightness/contrast directly in the app. Fill forms and sign documents without switching tools.
**Multi-format Export & Share**
Export scans to PDF, JPG, PNG formats. Share via email, cloud drives or messaging apps. Support offline scanning, all files processed locally on your device.
- Business: Receipts, contracts, business cards, invoices, meeting notes

bluejetty:00186240:ios.summary: Experience with us the fascination of newly emerged life. Watch wonderful ultrasound videos of babies in different weeks of pregnancy. If you want, you can get to know the most important structures that can be demonstrated in ultrasound and
bluejetty:00186240:ios.description:
Experience with us the fascination of newly emerged life. Watch wonderful ultrasound videos of babies in different weeks of pregnancy. If you want, you can get to know the most important structures that can be demonstrated in ultrasound and then apply and deepen your knowledge in the ultrasound simulator. This will help you understand the growth of your own baby.
ScanBaby is divided into three different modes:
-Scan mode: Here you can scan a baby all by yourself (not your own actual baby). Turn on labelling mode to see all the important structures colored. This way you can compare the ScanBaby image to your own ultrasound image and understand the shown structures better.
-Learn mode: This beautifully crafted mode teaches you about the developmental stages of your child. Get to know all the changes that happen to you and your baby during pregnancy. We have included artfully crafted 3D scans of real babies that you can move around all by yourself and experience how your baby might currently look like. Of course all of these scans come with labelling as well.
-Watch mode: Here we have included many different ultrasound videos you might actually see in a similar way during your own examination. All come with a short explanation what can be seen. Watch a baby dance inside the uterus, play with the umbilical cord and even react to the caressing of the father.
Terms of use: https://scanbooster.com/index.php/impressum#qx-heading-1479
Please note that we have researched the information presented here with the best of our knowledge and in cooperation with medical experts, but of course we do not assume any guarantee or liability of any kind. Furthermore, the App may under no circumstances be used for medical purposes of any kind. It is intended for the sole purpose of entertainment. All of the displayed babies are already included in the app and therefore NOT your own. Furthermore ScanBaby does not transform your device into an ultrasound probe or similar, nor does it enable you to perform an ultrasound examination on yourself or anybody else. In addition to using this app and before making any medical decisions, the advice of a licensed medical doctor should always be sought.

bluejetty:00120371:ios.name: My City : After School
bluejetty:00120371:ios.summary: In My City the fun starts After School! So call your school friends and invite your neighbors to meet at the park because the fun is about to start. Skating, Reading, Karate Class, RC boat sailing, Graffiti spraying and even shopping. There
bluejetty:00120371:ios.description:
In My City the fun starts After School! So call your school friends and invite your neighbors to meet at the park because the fun is about to start. Skating, Reading, Karate Class, RC boat sailing, Graffiti spraying and even shopping. There are tons of things to do and places to explore. Come and meet all the new characters, Explore all the fun locations and have fun creating your own stories.
Explore After School Hobbies, Playtime and Fun:
After school is the best time to do all the things you really love, My City has just the right activities and locations for you to explore and enjoy. Make sure to visit the city library, Skateboard Park, Pizza Shop and the Karate class. You can relax in the park, visit your karate teachers house and even get creative doing some graffiti. 
Create your own story:
You choose what your afternoon will look like. My City : After School has 6 locations such as the pond, skateboard park, library and the karate dojo. You will discover lots of new clothing, animals and exciting new characters to play with. Because My City games all connect and allow you to move characters and clothing between the games there are no limitation on what you can imagine, create and play.
Game Features
- 6 locations to explore: Library, Karate Class, The Fountain Park, Pizza store, The pond, and a skateboarding area.
- 20 characters you can dress and customize on your after school adventure
- Day night feature looks awesome, check out the fountain when the sun is gone.
- All My City games connect to each other, Easily Move characters and items between games. 
- Daily gifts and furniture to upgrade your home and wardrobe.
- Multi-touch so kids can play together with friends and family on the same screen.
- No Ads, Kids Safe.
Age group 4-12:
Easy enough for 4 year olds to play and super exciting for 12 year to enjoy. 
Play Together
We support multi touch so kids can play together with friends and family on the same screen!
We love making children games, if you like what we do and want to send us ideas and suggestions for our next games of My City you can do so here:
Facebook - https://www.facebook.com/mytowngames
Twitter - https://twitter.com/mytowngames 
Love our games? Leave us a nice review on the app store, we read them all!
Terms of Use: https://www.my-town.com/EULA
Customer Support contact: support@my-town.com
Get Privacy-related information at: https://www.my-town.com/privacy-policy/.

***** The only app that gives you iPhone Battery Alerts on your Apple Watch!
***** The only app that shows your iPhone Battery on your Watch Face [with purchasable upgrade]!
"Remote Battery & Connectivity" is a super convenient utility app
bluejetty:00121935:ios.description:
***** The only app that gives you iPhone Battery Alerts on your Apple Watch!
***** The only app that shows your iPhone Battery on your Watch Face [with purchasable upgrade]!
"Remote Battery & Connectivity" is a super convenient utility app. It enables you to use your Apple Watch to check the charging level of your iPhone, and gives you alerts on the Watch when the iPhone is full charged or when the battery level get critical. On the iPhone app, you can view the battery level of your Watch. In addition, the app gives information on your current data connection and network carrier. After upgrading the app, it can show all this information conveniently on your Watch Face!
Features:
- Check whether your iPhone is fully charged while it is plugged in on the other side of the room
- Check your iPhone charging level without pulling your iPhone out of your pocket
- Check your Watch charging level on your iPhone when it is charging on the wireless charger
- Show your iPhone battery level and connection status on your Watch Face using Complications [with purchasable upgrade]!
- Use Glances to check your iPhone's battery level from the Watch home screen
- Get a notification on your Apple Watch when your iPhone is fully charged, or when its charging level drops below a threshold.
- Customize the alert limits of the battery level 
- Save costs! Use your Watch to quickly check if you have a WiFi or cellular data connection
- Be creative and find many more ways to use the app!
NOTE: This app contains an auto-renewable subscription. It is a weekly, monthly or yearly subscription, and it provides you the option to set custom battery level limits, enables complications on your watch, and removes all ads.
The subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period. Auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase. No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during active subscription period
For more info, see:

With the RARE app, we’ve brought together our three iconic brands – Rare Rabbit, Rareism, and Rare Ones – to offer a one-stop shop for premium, luxurious fashion. Whether you're searching for men’s wear, women’s collections, or kids' clothing, RARE curates a seamless shopping experience where sophistication meets innovation.
Discover RARE: Fashion for the Whole Family
Impeccably Crafted Men's Wear:
From classic essentials to fashion-forward pieces, Rare Rabbit has it all. Dive into the world of meticulously designed men’s wear that brings together timeless classics and contemporary trends whether it’s a formal shirt for that important meeting, a casual T-shirt for a relaxed weekend, or a tailored blazer for an evening event, Rare Rabbit outfits you for every occasion.
Exquisite Women's Collections:
Indulge in the world of Rareism, where every piece is crafted with the modern woman in mind. Whether you’re looking for understated elegance or bold statement pieces, Rareism offers a wide range of choices. From breezy dresses that are perfect for daytime outings to tailored blazers that exude confidence, Rareism brings you collections that embody both femininity and strength.
Outfits for Your Little Ones:
Dressing your kids has never been more fun! Rare Ones offers an array of charming designs that are perfect for little trendsetters. Whether it’s vibrant graphic tees for a playful day out or adorable dresses that combine comfort with style, Rare Ones ensures that your kids are always dressed to impress.
Lifestyle | Fashion | Apparel
RARE offers a curated selection of premium clothing for every member of the family, ensuring that you find something special for every occasion. Whether you’re looking for a classic shirt, a timeless top, or a trendy T-shirt, the RARE app has it all. Our collections span a variety of styles, from formal to casual, sophisticated to playful, and everything in between.
The RARE Brand Experience
RARE is not just a fashion brand – it’s a lifestyle. We are dedicated to providing an elevated shopping experience that goes beyond just clothing. Our mission is to craft experiences that resonate with individuals who appreciate quality, elegance, and individuality. RARE’s aesthetics blend timeless sophistication with contemporary flair, creating a unique and unforgettable brand identity that appeals to discerning customers.
Why Shop With RARE?
Personalized Recommendations:
We understand that fashion is personal, and that’s why we’ve integrated personalized recommendations into the RARE app.
Early Access to Sales & New Collections:
As a valued RARE app user, you’ll be the first to know about our latest collections and exclusive sales. Be ahead of the crowd with early access to our new arrivals and seasonal promotions, ensuring that you never miss out on the latest trends and must-have pieces.
Seamless Checkout:
Enjoy a hassle-free shopping experience with our easy-to-navigate app. From browsing to checkout, we’ve streamlined the process to make it quick, simple, and secure.
Priority Shipping
With our fast-tracked delivery service, we prioritize your purchases, bringing your premium selections straight to your doorstep in no time, all while providing regular updates to keep you informed every step of the way.
Exclusive App Features:
With exclusive app features, you can access special promotions, save your favorite items, and even receive personalized fashion advice from our style experts.
Download the RARE App Now!
Secure Payments | Easy Returns | Dedicated Customer Service | Priority Shipping
Experience the best of family fashion with the RARE app. With features like secure payments, easy returns, dedicated customer service, and priority shipping, shopping with us is as seamless as it gets. Ready to give your wardrobe the RARE upgrade? Download the app now and start shopping!

bluejetty:00042353:ios.description:
Circleback records, transcribes, and turns every conversation into clear, actionable notes you can search in seconds.
Stop worrying about taking notes, missing decisions, or forgetting follow-ups. Circleback captures your meetings, online or in-person, and gives you a transcript and notes you can trust.
What Circleback does for you
• Record meetings automatically with high-quality audio, online or in-person.
• Get accurate AI-powered transcripts with automatic speaker identification.
• Get notes that highlight key points, decisions, and action items.
• Turn meetings into to-dos and follow-ups so next steps are never lost.
• Import phone call recordings, voice memos, and audio from other apps to get a transcript and notes.
• Ask questions across your meetings, like "What did we decide about pricing last week?", and get answers with cited sources.
• Search everything by keyword, speaker, topic, or decision in seconds.
Apple Watch
Record in-person meetings straight from your wrist, no iPhone required. Add the Circleback complication to your watch face and start recording with one tap. When the meeting ends, you'll get a transcript and notes in Circleback, just like any other meeting.
Built for how you work
Circleback fits into your existing tools and workflows. It works great for 1:1s, team meetings, customer calls, interviews, standups, project reviews, talks, and conferences, and it's ideal for founders, product teams, sales, customer success, recruiting, and operations.
Automations and integrations
Use Circleback's automations to push insights where your work happens. Send notes to Slack, Notion, Linear, monday.com, Zapier, and more, and sync meeting outcomes to Salesforce, HubSpot, Attio, Zoho, and other systems of record.
100+ languages supported
Circleback can transcribe and take notes in over 100 languages, including English, Spanish, French, Portuguese, Dutch, German, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Chinese, Turkish, Russian, and more.
Privacy and security you can trust
Your data is private and secure. Circleback is SOC 2 Type II and EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework certified, HIPAA and GDPR compliant, and uses industry-leading practices to protect customer data, including encryption at-rest and in-transit. Circleback does not use customer data to train models. Learn more at security.circleback.ai.

bluejetty:00174720:ios.name: Mark II Artist's Viewfinder
bluejetty:00174720:ios.summary: Artist's Viewfinder assists the filmmaker or still photographer in exploring different places and angles to find the optimal placement for the camera, and to second-guess compositions. By simulating real camera and lens combinations it allo
bluejetty:00174720:ios.description:
Artist's Viewfinder assists the filmmaker or still photographer in exploring different places and angles to find the optimal placement for the camera, and to second-guess compositions. By simulating real camera and lens combinations it allows you to visualize what you are going to shoot without actually setting up the camera. And it's also a great tool to train yourself to see.
Handles Like Your Camera
Exposure compensation. Auto-focus lock. AF confirmation beep. A Quick Control Screen for accessing frequently needed functions. Smart Function Keys. Shutter release via the Volume buttons. We designed the Mark II so that you could feel at home the moment you start working with it. And because it also saves high resolution photos, you can even use it as a regular camera.
Visualize the Grand Landscape
Paired with a 0.5x-class super-wide converter lens*, the Mark II becomes an indispensable tool for landscape and architecture photographers. The combination can simulate super-wide lenses up to around 16mm on the full-frame 35mm format. Or you can use it to compose super-wide stitched images. The Mark II even removes distortion present in the wide converter lens — in real time.
* FOR THE LIST OF SUPPORTED CONVERTER/DEVICE COMBINATIONS PLEASE VISIT: https://www.artistsviewfinder.com/tech-specs/
When There's No Need for Color
In black & white mode Artist's Viewfinder shows just the luminance information of the scene, making it easier to explore tonal structures and simulate what a black & white photograph will look like. Taking it a step further, the optional dark and neutral toolbar theme ensures that colors from the app doesn't interfere with your composition.
Unprecedented Simulation Flexibility
The Mark II leverages our extensive Viewfinder Camera Database, containing more than 800 still and motion picture cameras, 180 medium/large format backs and countless lenses — incorporating real lens data for ALPA, Hartblei, Hasselblad, Leica, Rodenstock, Schneider and Zeiss glass. And you can define your own cameras and lenses when you need something special for the job.
Does What Optical Viewfinders Can't Even Dream Of
Artist's Viewfinder stores location and simulation metadata with the pictures, allowing you to evaluate results of a location scout later on your computer. Or you can send the information off to the rest of the crew or to a rental house, right from the app. It also records a standard GPX format track log, alleviating the need for a separate logging device.
Want to Learn More?
To explore the complete list of features, please visit: https://www.artistsviewfinder.com/features/
Written by the author of the app, The Viewfinder Handbook is the ultimate source of information about the Mark II. Way more than a user manual, this free eBook not only walks you through the ins and outs of the app, but also provides conceptual background, insights and useful hands-on advice. Available in iPad optimized PDF format at: https://www.artistsviewfinder.com/handbook/

bluejetty:00122613:ios.description:
Enjoy instant access to your account information while you’re on the go through Coastal Community’s iPhone app. It’s secure, easy to use, and a convenient way to view your account balances onscreen, transfer funds and pay bills without having to log in!
With Coastal Community’s iPhone app, you can:
• Manage accounts 
• View recent transactions and account activity
• Pay bills or set up future payments 
• View and edit upcoming bills and transfers 
• Transfer money between your accounts, to other Credit Union members, or use Interac® eTransfer to transfer funds to other financial institutions.
• Choose to display account balances onscreen without having to log in 
• Receive messages about your account activity directly to your phone 
• Keep track of foreign exchange rates 
• Find your nearest Coastal Community Location by visiting the Branch/ATM locator utilizing your phone’s GPS
In order to make the best use of this app, please ensure that you have already registered and logged in to Online Banking. If you do not have your Online Banking set up, then this app will still allow you to access the Branch/ATM locator, Rates and our Contact Us information. 
Visit Coastal Community at www.cccu.ca for more details about Online Banking. 
This app is free; however mobile data downloading and Internet charges may apply. Please check with your mobile phone provider for more details. 
Coastal Community’s mobile banking app uses the same level of security as our full Online Banking website. Login using the same information as you do through Online Banking, and once you close the app, then your secure session will end.

bluejetty:00170542:ios.description:
Gabb Messenger™
Friends and family can safely video call with Gabb kids directly through the app. Safe Video Calling uses smart filtration to monitor video calls for potential harm, keeping kids safe & parents at peace.
Gabb Messenger Parental Controls
Gabb Parents can also use Gabb Messenger to access important parental controls to monitor & manage their child's messaging experience. As a Gabb Parent, you'll have access to the following controls:
-Flagged Content: view all flagged images, video calls, texts, and links
-Safe Video Calling: ability to disable/enable at any time
-Deleting Settings: manage whether your child can delete messages on their device
-Contact Management: manage an Approved Contact List and restrict who your child can message & video call
Gabb Messenger Parental Controls are easy to use and perfect for managing multiple devices. Enjoy peace of mind knowing your child is protected while they stay connected to friends and family.
Download Gabb Messenger and get started. You can learn more about Gabb Messenger at gabb.com/gabb-messenger/
More about Gabb
Gabb provides safe tech made specifically to protect kids, connect families, and empower parents. Gabb devices—Gabb Watch 2, Gabb Watch 3, Gabb Phone, Gabb Phone Plus, Gabb Phone 3 Pro—were all created with kids’ safety as the top priority and provide safe “tech in steps” options for kids 5-18.
All Gabb devices come with unlimited talk and text but no social media, internet, or unsafe apps. Parents can stay safely connected with their kids through GPS tracking, safe messaging, geofenced safe zones with alerts when a child’s device enters or leaves specified locations, and more. Gabb’s growing list of safe apps, like Gabb Music and Gabb Messenger, give kids more ways to learn the benefits of technology without all the dangers. Learn more at gabb.com

bluejetty:00120341:ios.name: MedShr: The App for Doctors
bluejetty:00120341:ios.summary: Developed by doctors, MedShr is the easiest and safest way for medical professionals to discover, discuss and share clinical cases and medical images. Join our community and connect with hundreds of thousands of verified doctors, healthcare
bluejetty:00120341:ios.description:
Developed by doctors, MedShr is the easiest and safest way for medical professionals to discover, discuss and share clinical cases and medical images. Join our community and connect with hundreds of thousands of verified doctors, healthcare professionals and medical students sharing knowledge and learning from each other in a secure private network.
MedShr’s Awards include: Facebook App of the Year for Social Good Award; The Evening Standard Startup of the Year 2018; and a World Summit Award from the United Nations.
The app has been featured on the BBC, Sky News, The Evening Standard, The Telegraph and Metro News.
“A revolution in the way Medical Knowledge spreads” *****
- Dr Tzalamouras Basilis, Interventional Cardiology Fellow
DISCOVER AND DISCUSS MEDICAL CASES & IMAGES
From ECGs, scans and X-rays to patient photos and videos, MedShr helps you find and discuss relevant medical cases with colleagues, by specialty and at all grades. MedShr is a totally secure, private network and features an easy to use in-app patient consent form and system for anonymising images. Follow clinical cases you find interesting and learn from your peers with informal and accredited case based discussion.
SHARE KNOWLEDGE WITH VERIFIED MEMBERS
MedShr is the simple way to capture, share and discuss clinical images and videos in your everyday practice. Create a case, obtain consent and start a discussion securely from your mobile. Send medical cases to colleagues, share them with the wider community, export to your e-portfolio or simply organise cases for your personal records. MedShr is safe, secure and enables you to maintain complete control over the privacy of your cases - with all members being 100% verified as doctors, healthcare professionals and medical students.
EXPAND YOUR PROFESSIONAL NETWORK
Medical students and doctors of all levels are joining MedShr to advance their learning as they connect with peers from their university, place of work and across the world. Connect and follow specialists in your field to keep up to date on their latest cases, techniques and learnings. Join groups to learn from others, share findings or just converse around complex and interesting clinical cases. Medical students, junior doctors and specialist trainees use MedShr groups as a resource for informal learning, ahead of case-based examinations and as an aid to formal learning.
MESSAGE CONNECTIONS AND COLLEAGUES
MedShr Messaging allows you to message your connections about anything from arranging to meet at a conference to sharing a link to an interesting case. To get started, tap the message bubble in the top right-hand corner of the home feed to start a new chat. Use MedShr Messaging to reach out to colleagues and build your network.
OBTAIN CPD CREDITS AND SHOW PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT
There are opportunities to learn from and reflect on cases every day. MedShr now makes it easy to request Continuing Professional Development (CPD) credits for each case that you share on MedShr. The simple process makes it easy to receive CPD credit and keep a record of your learning on the go.
HELP MAKE A DIFFERENCE TO THOSE IN NEED
Our community is providing medics in crisis zones and doctors in developing countries with quick access to second and specialist medical opinions so that they can make critical clinical decisions. With your participation, you can collaborate with like-minded professionals and be part of a new frontier in medical education.
“MedShr is a brilliant idea - smartphones connect doctors, making it possible for aid workers to get an instant medical diagnosis” ***** - Rohan Silver, Evening Standard
For support, suggestions and feedback, please contact us at info@medshr.net

bluejetty:00074191:ios.description:
Welcome to Backgammon Classic, one of the most popular board games in the world!
Strategy, skills and good planning will be key to master the game.
How to play?
• The objective of the game is to be the first player to move all the checkers into their home board and bear them off
• The roll of the dice indicates how many points, you can move your checkers
• Roll a double to play twice
• Hit your opponent’s checkers to remove them from the board
• Use the doubling cube to increase the stakes at any point
Why choose Backgammon Classic?
• Start playing right away with a single touch
• Tailored for mobile and tablet devices
• Easy to play with a modern and relaxing look
• Smart and adaptive opponent AI
• Play in 1 or up to 15 points
• Double the stakes anytime 
• Choose the controls
• Auto save so that you can resume whenever you want
Enjoy now hours of exciting card games with Backgammon!

bluejetty:00164604:ios.description:
Stay on track and manage your day with Daily Routine - Planner & Mood! This powerful app helps you stay organized while boosting your mood and motivation. It's the ultimate companion to help you structure your daily tasks, prioritize your goals, and improve your emotional well-being.
Key Features:
Task Planner: Keep track of your daily tasks, from work to personal activities, and set reminders to stay on top of your schedule.
Mood Tracker: Log your mood throughout the day to gain insights into your emotional well-being and identify patterns.
Customizable Routines: Create personalized routines to help you form productive habits and achieve your goals.
Motivational Quotes: Stay inspired with daily motivational quotes that encourage perseverance and inner drive.
Track Your Progress: Easily monitor how your routines and tasks are progressing, helping you stay motivated to achieve success.
Beautiful Design: Enjoy a simple and user-friendly interface with stunning visuals designed to keep you focused.
How it Works:
Set up your routines and tasks.
Log your mood throughout the day.
Get reminded and track your progress.
Stay motivated with personalized quotes and insights.
Whether you’re working on improving your productivity or simply want to track how your day unfolds, Daily Routine - Planner & Mood is the perfect tool to help you stay organized, motivated, and in control.
Download Daily Routine - Planner & Mood now and take the first step towards a more structured and fulfilling life!
Choose from the following subscription options for unlimited access to all features:
• Weekly Subscription
• Yearly Subscription
You may cancel your subscription at any time.
Free trial allows you unlimited access to all features for the duration of 3 days. Your account will be automatically charged for renewal, based on the annual subscription plan, within 24 hours before the end of the 3 days free trial period.
You can cancel auto-renewal at any time, given that the cancellation is at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when making a purchase of an auto-renewing subscription.
Manage your subscription directly from your iPhone

Defeat the scary sorcerer and save the royal heir in a beautiful and captivating story inspired by one of the Grimms’ fairy tales. Queen's Quest: Tower of Darkness is an exciting adventure game that takes place in a faraway realm full of magic and wonders.
TRY IT FREE, THEN UNLOCK THE FULL ADVENTURE FROM WITHIN THE GAME!
Explore 30 hand painted vistas to save the princess! 
The idyllic life of the beautiful queen and her husband is shattered when a scary sorcerer arrives at their palace to kidnap their newborn daughter.
Solve 39 puzzles and HO scenes! 
The godfather Magnus saves our heroine with his magic, but Prince Henrik is turned to stone, allowing the intruder to escape with the royal heiress. Detective skills are called upon to solve the mystery.

bluejetty:00074076:ios.name: ArchiTouch 3D - Home Design
bluejetty:00074076:ios.summary:
Enjoy Creative Architecture with ArchiTouch 3D !
You are looking for an Architecture design app combining efficiency and creative freedom ? ArchiTouch 3D is made for you! Feature-rich and easy to use, ArchiTouch 3D gives shape to your idea
bluejetty:00074076:ios.description:
Enjoy Creative Architecture with ArchiTouch 3D !
You are looking for an Architecture design app combining efficiency and creative freedom ? ArchiTouch 3D is made for you! Feature-rich and easy to use, ArchiTouch 3D gives shape to your ideas. Every change is fast and easy, at any stage of your project. 
Instant navigation between 2D and 3D makes ArchiTouch 3D unique.
Above all, ArchiTouch 3D is the most complete Architecture Design App available on both Mac and iPad. You can store your plans in iCloud and work on them anywhere.
● Design complete floor plans with doors, windows, staircases, different wall sizes and any angle. All dimensions, angles and surfaces are adjusted in real time.
● Adapt ceiling heights and floor levels with a simple input and all impacted elements are automatically positioned.
● Define slab level shifts, sloped walls, mezzanines…
● Create customized roofing. Roofs can be flat, mono or multi pitched but also Mansard, jointed and even curved, with dormers or roof windows… Your architectural choices have no limits!
● Draw an outline of your property directly on the satellite map and insert a site plan image to ease this process. This way, it becomes very easy to draw on top of the image to copy the exact property shape and dimensions.
● Design terraces and exterior items to see your project globally.
● Visualize volumes and control design flaws using the horizontal and vertical 3D cross sections in real time. 
● Unlimited undo/redo feature provides a visual feedback.
… All that at your fingertips !
ArchiTouch 3D contains a complete help system with illustrated examples. And our technical support is at your disposal for more specific questions. Send us an email and we will answer in a few hours.
WHAT’S FREE:
● A trial project to explore all ArchiTouch 3D’s design features (changes are not saved).
● A single floor plan, complete with furniture, 3D view, all dimensions, angles, surfaces… Free floor plan generation in JPG or PDF is reserved for personal use (discrete watermark included).
● Viewing projects received by email or shared in the Cloud is free. Only project author needs a subscription.
IN-APP PURCHASES (SUBSCRIPTIONS):
● Purchase only the needed duration.
● No automatic renewal: you are not committed to renew subscriptions.
● You can purchase a lifetime subscription (unlike a software license purchase, a lifetime subscription means no fee when updating to future versions)
Subscriptions give you access to:
● All complete features 
● Unlimited number of projects
● Professional and high-quality blueprints generation in JPEG or PDF
● DXF 2D and 3D file export.
A subscription purchased on your iPad also activates ArchiTouch 3D for Mac, and vice versa.
If you decide not to renew at the end of the subscription period you can choose a single project which will remain editable without time limit. However, you will need a new subscription to work on multiple projects, generate final plans or export DXF files.
ArchiTouch 3D does not include advertising, requires no login and does not request your e-mail address – even when using only the free floor plan.

bluejetty:00016064:ios.description:
A blast from the past!
Capture your photos with a unique 1-bit camera: only pure black and pure white pixels, no grayscale!
BitCam's interface is delightfully old school, featuring chunky buttons and mechanical sounds the likes of which haven't graced your screen in over 40 years.
In Camera mode, three different pixel resolutions let you experiment, and an 8-color mode brings you a little closer to the current day while preserving the distinct aesthetic.
Or jump over to the editor to dither any photo from your library and experiment with resolutely modern colors & gradients.
Clean, high resolution PNG output means you can print those files, use them in digital collages, or other art projects.
You can also now run BitCam natively on your iPad, and your Mac!
And on Mac, you can install a system extension to use BitCam in any app that uses the camera: Zoom, FaceTime, Google Meet, WebEx, Photo Booth, etc.
The camera mode is entirely free and unlimited. The editor mode offers a 3 day trial, after which it requires a one-time in-app purchase for full access, on all of your account's devices.

bluejetty:00131712:ios.description:
Thanks to everyone for making MyRadar so successful, with over 50 million downloads!
MyRadar Pro is IDENTICAL to the free version of MyRadar; it comes without the ads by default.
MyRadar is a fast, powerful, easy-to-use weather app that displays animated weather radar around your current location and to quickly show what weather is coming your way. Just start the app; your location pops up with animated live radar, with radar loop lengths of up to two hours. This basic functionality provides the quickest way to get a snapshot of the weather on-the-go, and it's what has made MyRadar so successful over the years. Check your phone and get an instant assessment of the weather that will impact your day.
In addition to the live radar, MyRadar has an ever-increasing list of weather and environmentally-related data layers that you can overlay on top of the map; our animated winds layer shows a breathtaking visual representation of both surface winds and winds at the jetstream level; the frontal boundaries layer shows high and low pressure systems as well as frontal boundaries themselves; the earthquakes layer is a great way to stay on top of the latest reports on seismic activity, completely customizable as to severity and time; our hurricane layer allows users to stay on top of the latest tropical storm and hurricane activity throughout the world; the aviation layer overlays AIRMETs, SIGMETs and other aviation-related data, including the ability to track flights and display their IFR flight plans and paths, and the "wildfires" layer allows users to stay abreast of the latest fire activity around the United States.
MyRadar also has the ability to send weather and environmental alerts, including alerts from the National Weather Service, such as Tornado and Severe Weather alerts. A new feature introduced in this version of MyRadar includes the ability to receive alerts based off of Tropical Storm and Hurricane activity; you can configure the app to send you an alert any time a tropical storm or hurricane forms, or is upgraded or downgraded.
One of the most useful features in MyRadar is the ability to provide advanced rain alerts; our patent-pending process for predicting hyper-local rainfall is the most accurate in the industry. Instead of having to check the app all the time, MyRadar will send you an alert up to an hour in advance as to when the rain will arrive at your current location, down to the minute, including details on intensity and duration. These alerts can be a life saver when you're on-the-go and don't always have time to check the weather - our systems will proactively do the work for you and let you know in advance before the rain hits.
In addition to the free features of the app, additional upgrades are available, including real-time hurricane tracking - great for the start of hurricane season. The hurricane tracker provides additional data above and beyond the free version, including the cone of probability for tropical storm/hurricane forecast tracks, and it also includes a detailed synopsis from the National Hurricane Center. The premium upgrades also include the professional radar pack, which allows greater detail of radar from individual stations. Users can select individual radar stations around the US, select the radar tilt angle, and also change the radar product being displayed, including base reflectivity and wind velocity - great for experienced weather buffs looks to stay on top of possible tornado formation.
Download MyRadar today and try it out!
* Aviation Charts subscription (not required in order to use MyRadar) ($24.99 USD per YEAR)
* Payments will be charged to your iTunes account
* Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period
* Auto-renewal may be turned off at any time by going to your settings in the iTunes Store after purchase.
MyRadar’s Privacy Policy, visit: https://myradar.com/privacy
Full terms of service: https://myradar.com/terms

bluejetty:00129718:ios.description:
PureStatus: HD WhatsApp Status, plus AI Studio
Tired of blurry, low-quality videos and photos in your WhatsApp status? When you post a video, WhatsApp shrinks it and the quality drops. PureStatus compresses your video precisely for WhatsApp first, so what you post stays as sharp as HD status allows.
Crystal-clear status in four steps
Open PureStatus and select a video or photo.
Compress it.
Share to your WhatsApp status.
Enjoy crystal-clear HD.
New: AI Studio
Create the post itself, right inside PureStatus.
• Festival Photoshoot: put yourself in 175 festivals and 460 poses, from Diwali, Eid and Holi to Christmas and Chinese New Year. Couple poses take a photo of each person. Add a greeting in your language, written into the picture.
• WhatsApp Stickers: make stickers from text or your own photo, a 6 or 9 sticker pack of you in one go, and animated stickers. Add them to WhatsApp with one tap.
• Photo Restore: fix old, faded and blurry photos and bring back natural colour.
• AI Styles: cartoon, anime, oil painting, watercolour, sketch and 3D looks.
• Object Eraser, Passport Photo, Upscale, Background Remover and Fit to Status.
• AI Image: describe anything and get a picture.
• Photo to Video: give a still photo natural motion. Video HD: upscale old clips. Video Reframe: fit or crop any video to the 9:16 status size, free and on your phone. Photo Slideshow: photos into a status video with six transitions.
Pick a model for each tool, from fast to top quality, and see the price in tokens before you generate. Every result lands in My Creations and posts to Status in one tap. You get 200 free tokens when you activate and 100 free tokens every month; buy packs when you need more.
Get the best results
• Don't edit or crop a video after compressing; the status will lose quality again.
• Compress the original file, not a video that was already shared. Quality that is already gone can't be restored by compression. Use Photo Restore or Video HD for that.
• Compare for yourself: post the compressed and the original version and look at both.
• Vertical videos and photos give the largest viewing area and are the most popular on phones.
Please keep in mind
• Compression stops your HD video from turning blurry on WhatsApp; it does not improve the original.
• The photo function is for HD status only. Sent in a chat, it arrives as a video.
• The video splitter is for longer status videos. Used in chats, the parts arrive as 30-second videos.
Bonus: Video Status Splitter
Longer videos are cut into 30-second parts, precisely and in the best possible quality, so you can post a full video to your status.
Your privacy
Compression runs on your phone. AI tools upload only the photo or video you choose, process it with AI providers, and you keep the result. Nothing is used to train AI models.
Unlock the true potential of your WhatsApp status. Download PureStatus and start sharing in HD.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

Enjin Wallet – Own your digital world
Join 4 million+ people who trust Enjin Wallet to store, manage, stake, and explore Web3 with total control of their keys. Built for Web3 with native Enjin features and multi‑chain support—supporting more than 10 major blockchains—Enjin Wallet is the all‑in‑one super‑app for NFTs and crypto.
Key Features
- Infinite wallet & address management – Create unlimited wallets for day‑to‑day use, savings, trading, or gaming and switch between them with one tap.
- Military‑grade security – Client‑side AES‑256 encryption, 12‑word recovery phrase, plus fingerprint unlock or PIN keep your keys safe and private.
- Multi‑chain compatibility – Full native support for more than 10 leading blockchains and scaling networks, with even more coming soon.
- Native Enjin Blockchain support – Send, receive, and store ENJ, multiverse NFTs, and Enjin Multitokens alongside your favorite multi-chain assets.
- Governance & staking dashboard – Stake ENJ, monitor rewards, and secure the Enjin network without leaving the app.
- Instant NFT claims – Scan Enjin Beam QR codes to drop NFTs straight into your collection.
- Built‑in marketplace – Browse and trade on NFT.io or use other marketplaces or DEX integrations.
- Connected Apps hub – See every WalletConnect or Enjin Connect link in one place and approve signatures with confidence.
- Auto‑add tokens – The wallet automatically detects and displays new tokens and NFTs in any imported address—no manual input needed.
- Unified portfolio & activity feed – View all balances, NFTs, and transactions across every address, priced automatically in your local currency (150+ fiat currencies, including USD, EUR, GBP, TRY, CNY, JPY, and more).
- Custom fees & gas controls – Choose advanced settings for your transactions, or let the wallet optimize them for you.
Why Enjin Wallet?
- Battle‑tested since 2018 and recommended by global leaders in gaming and tech.
- Military‑grade security – Client‑side AES‑256 encryption.
- Backed by the team behind Enjin Blockchain, NFT.io marketplace, and Beam QR technology.
- 100% self‑custodial – you're always in control.
Get started in three easy steps
1. Download Enjin Wallet for free.
2. Create or import a wallet and secure your 12‑word recovery phrase.
3. Start sending, receiving, staking, and collecting in seconds.
Your keys. Your crypto. Your NFTs.
SUPPORT
Need help? Visit enjin.io/help or email support@enjin.io – we're here 24/7.
ABOUT ENJIN
Founded in 2009 & based in Singapore, Enjin offers an ecosystem of integrated blockchain products that make it easy to create, manage, explore, distribute, & integrate blockchain-based assets and NFTs.

bluejetty:00135820:ios.description:
Skyscape’s Buzz is a HIPAA-secure platform for care team collaboration and patient communication, offering rich capabilities including real-time chats, document edit, and signatures, group chats with polling feature and broadcast capabilities, video conferencing, private calls with caller ID, fax number, dictation, audio/video, images, trusted medical knowledge integration, report sharing and a robust API framework enabling linking with external systems such as EMR solutions.
Buzz is intuitive and easy to use. Complying with HIPAA rules and regulations doesn't need to be burdensome, and Buzz proves it with its time-saving features. Your patient’s data is private and accessible only to authorized users. Whether consulting with another healthcare provider or the patient you will never need to worry about security. Buzz platform includes added organization-level security to manage users within an enterprise securely. The best part is that the seamless collaboration between healthcare participants improves patient care as well as patient satisfaction.
Buzz provides in-context integration within conversations to get Lightning™ fast answers via Skyscape's comprehensive portfolio of gold-standard medical information trusted by over 1 million healthcare professionals.
Buzz has a strong track record in home health, & physical therapy as well as medical clinics & hospitals, and other agencies handling the transition of care. Buzz is a recommended platform for any individual provider or organization that needs to quickly and securely exchange private, HIPAA-compliant messages. Customer case studies show improvements in patient experience, enhanced provider satisfaction, as well as a reduction in hospital readmission rates.
Providers can communicate with patients and their families using secure texting, secure email, phone calls, and video channels, helping to improve patient outcomes and satisfaction.
Here are some of the features better described by our customers in their own words!
** Telehealth to the forefront **
“We rely on Buzz Video for our telehealth needs as it’s easy to use, requires no app download by the patient, and is HIPAA-secure” – VP, Clinical Operations, Home Health & Hospice Agency
** Protect your Cell phone numbers with versatile Caller ID **
“Now with Buzz, I can make my calls and know that the patient won’t get my personal number.” – 
** Team Collaboration **
“Buzz allows for seamless collaboration and communication between healthcare professionals with all common methods (audio, video, pics, etc.) of desired content” – App Store Review
** Ease of use **
“User interface is very simple yet elegant with great performance and speed” – App Store Review
** Best in its class **
I’ve used a lot of different messenger products throughout my professional career. Buzz is by far the most versatile, user-friendly, and forward-thinking platform available”
Features that you will find useful in your daily workflow:

Built to help simplify your work needs, the Workforce Central mobile app (formerly known as Kronos Mobile) provides employees and managers quick, secure access to Workforce Central.

Note: Your organization must have UKG Workforce Central configured and mobile enabled. Please reach out to your Workforce Central administrator if you’re having trouble with access.

bluejetty:00052284:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00052284:ios.description:
About the Site24x7 iOS app
ManageEngine Site24x7 is an AI-powered observability platform for DevOps and IT operations. The cloud-based platform’s broad capabilities help you troubleshoot application performance issues and investigate incidents related to websites, servers, networks, and cloud resources in real time. Users can track real-time metrics for over 600 technologies using visual charts and dashboards while on the go—all from a single console.
How the Site24x7 iOS app can help
Based on your user profile, you can receive instant notifications, add comments, analyze the root causes of incidents, track the KPIs of monitored resources, announce scheduled maintenance for known alerts, and authorize remedial actions—all through the mobile app. The Site24x7 iOS app provides availability and performance reports for all monitored resources along with root cause analysis (RCA), service-level agreement (SLA), and downtime reports. 
Get outage histories and performance reports for your monitors. Manage multiple accounts across domains and track your system health using widgets like Alarms and Status. Alarm shortcuts help you access the app directly from the app widget. Quickly assign technicians for faster resolution and create shortcuts to monitor multiple alarms with ease.
The app supports both light and dark themes for a personalized experience. Keep a close watch on every monitor’s status in real time with the NOC View. 
Use the Site24x7 iOS app to:
Troubleshoot issues instantly
* Get instant notifications about performance issues and resolve them with IT automation. Customize status notifications and instantly test alerts using the Test Alert feature.
* View monitor statuses (Up, Down, Trouble, or Critical) and RCA reports on downtime.
* Get outage and performance reports for monitors with detailed breakdowns.
* Detect anomalies in IT performance with the Anomaly Dashboard.
* Access MSP or BU dashboards for customer-specific availability insights.
* Use the NOC View to check the statuses of monitors in selected groups.
* Manage SLAs efficiently with scheduled maintenance and SLA tracking.
* Add monitors and perform administrative actions from the Admin tab.
* Perform actions like opening alarms, assigning technicians, and accessing reports via AppIntent.
Monitor & manage with ease
* Log in with multiple accounts to manage all data centers (DCs) effortlessly.
* Monitor domains and track your server performance using over 80 metrics.
* Set time zones for seamless monitoring and location-based availability views.
* Collaborate on resource updates with incident chats
* DC-based availability tracking for individual accounts.
Personalize your experience
* Use status widgets on the home and lock screens for quick monitor access via the control widget.
* Enjoy a refreshed interface with light and dark themes.
About Site24x7
Site24x7 provides AI-powered, full-stack monitoring specifically designed for DevOps and IT operations. It collects telemetry data from various sources, including servers, containers, networks, cloud environments, databases, and applications, to offer comprehensive observability. Additionally, Site24x7 tracks end-user experiences through both synthetic and real user monitoring capabilities. These features enable DevOps and IT teams to troubleshoot and resolve application downtime, performance issues, and infrastructure challenges, ultimately helping them manage digital user experiences more effectively.
Site24x7 offers a wide range of performance monitoring features for your technology stacks, including the following:
* Website monitoring
* Server monitoring
* APM
* Network monitoring
* AWS, Azure, and GCP monitoring
* Hybrid, private, and public cloud monitoring
* Container monitoring
For any assistance, please get in touch with support@site24x7.com.
Privacy Policy:
https://www.site24x7.com/privacypolicy.html
Terms of Service:
https://www.site24x7.com/terms.html

bluejetty:00014354:ios.description:

bluejetty:00077182:ios.description:
The Western Advocate The Western Advocate app brings together the best of your daily newspaper and its website to take your local news experience to another level.
As the Bathurst region’s trusted voice, we keep you up to date seven days a week with news that’s important to our community. 
Whether it's the breaking news you need to know from around the region or across the nation, our dedicated crime reports, Bathurst Regional Council news, the latest Group 10 rugby league, Bathurst Orange Inter District Cricket, Bathurst Netball Association, Central West Rugby Union updates or any other local sporting results, in-depth analysis explaining the decisions and events affecting our lives, or incisive commentary, you will be the first to know using the Western Advocate app.
The app is free to download, but you need to be a Western Advocate digital subscriber to read articles. Features include:
- Access to breaking news updates 24 hours-a-day
- Browse the latest articles in the topics that interest you most
- Save articles to read later
- Alerts for breaking news and big stories
- Read a digital replica of the day's newspaper
- Play our daily interactive puzzles
Please note: This app features Nielsen's proprietary measurement software which will allow you to contribute to market research or audience ratings services. Please see http://www.nielsen.com/digitalprivacy for more information.

bluejetty:00165247:ios.description:
One platform for every business conversation.
Dialbird is the next-generation business communication platform for modern teams. Bringing calls, messages, and numbers together across web and mobile, it gives your team one shared workspace to stay aligned, responsive, and in control.
Communication that moves with your team
Work seamlessly across both mobile and web, so your team can be on top of every conversation; at the desk, on the go, or anywhere in between.
Stay responsive throughout the day
Voicemail transcripts, call recording, auto-replies, and custom greetings help your business stay organized, available, and consistent from first contact to follow-up.
Clear separation between work and personal
Use business numbers without relying on personal numbers, giving your team the privacy they need and your business the professionalism customers expect.
Collaborate with more context
A shared inbox, shared numbers, shared contacts, internal threads, and team chat give your team the visibility needed to respond faster and work better together.
Greater control by default
Manage business hours, working hours, call forwarding, number blocking, and user access settings with the flexibility to match the way your business operates.
Business numbers and calling
Manage your included number, add more as needed, and handle calls with forwarding, greetings, recording, voicemail transcripts, and blocking controls.
Messaging and teamwork
Keep conversations moving with a shared inbox, shared contacts, snippets, contact lists, broadcast messaging, team chat, and internal collaboration tools.
Availability and admin
Set working hours, automate replies, and manage permissions with role-based access in one secure and encrypted platform.
Built for every stage of growth
From early-stage teams to growing operations, Dialbird is designed to scale with your business.
Terms of Use : https://dialbird.io/terms

bluejetty:00083324:ios.summary:

HoloFame is a pretend live-stream stage where simulated AI fans cheer, chat and send gifts, just for you. Feel famous instantly, with nobody watching but you and your fr
bluejetty:00083324:ios.description:
Go live to AI fans who hear you, remember you and react in real time.
HoloFame is a pretend live-stream stage where simulated AI fans cheer, chat and send gifts, just for you. Feel famous instantly, with nobody watching but you and your friends.
AI FANS WHO REACT TO YOU
Talk and the chat answers. Your AI fans listen to what you say, call you by name, notice when you go quiet and rarely repeat themselves. A big library of chat messages in 19 languages keeps every stream fresh. Every fan is simulated by AI.
CREATE YOUR OWN FANS
Build named AI fans with their own roles, traits and interests. They join your streams, cheer you on and remember you the next time you go live.
NATURAL VOICES
Every fan sounds different. Add optional lifelike voices that download in the background and hear your fans speak up, read out gifts and say hello.
SEASONAL EVENTS
Limited-time themes, effects, gifts and badges come and go with the seasons. Halloween is coming!
SAVE AND SHARE
Record your whole live, then save it or share it with friends in one tap.
MADE FOR BIG SCREENS
Stream full screen on the big inner display of iPhone Duo, or use the new landscape layout on iPad.
VOICE CHANGER AND FILTERS
Change your voice live with fun effects like Helium, Deep and Robot. Add camera filters and effects to look the part.
MORE TO EXPLORE
• Front and back cameras at once, with a draggable picture-in-picture
• Use a video from your library as your stream background
• Custom username, follower count and profile photo
• Gifts, donation alerts, raids and milestone celebrations from your simulated audience
• Pick the chat vibe: Hype, Funny, Happy, Curious and more
JUST FOR FUN
HoloFame is a simulator. Every viewer and fan is AI-generated, nobody real is watching, and nothing is posted or broadcast. Practice on camera, make your friends smile, or just play.
PREMIUM
Go Premium for unlimited streams, no ads, a much bigger AI audience, more coins, Hater mode and a verified badge. Choose a subscription or a one-time Lifetime purchase.
Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscription anytime in your Apple Account settings. Any unused portion of a free trial is forfeited when you purchase a subscription.
Terms of Use (EULA): https://holofame.app/terms.html
Privacy Policy: https://holofame.app/privacy-policy.html
Support: support@holofame.app

bluejetty:00160002:ios.name: HSL
bluejetty:00160002:ios.summary: Buses, trains, the Metro, trams and ferry – all in one app. The HSL app allows you to buy public transport tickets for the Helsinki region, find the best routes using the Journey Planner, view all timetables, and receive personalized trans
bluejetty:00160002:ios.description:
Buses, trains, the Metro, trams and ferry – all in one app. The HSL app allows you to buy public transport tickets for the Helsinki region, find the best routes using the Journey Planner, view all timetables, and receive personalized transport information.
You can buy single, day and season tickets for both adults and children via the HSL app. Adult multi-journey tickets and discounted tickets for students and passengers aged 70 and over are also available via the app. You can pay using the most popular payment methods, including debit/credit cards, MobilePay, phone bill and commuter benefits.
The HSL app's Journey Planner helps you find routes and informs you about the ticket needed for your journey. You can view real-time stop-specific departure and arrival times and track vehicles in real time. The app also displays any service changes and disruptions, and you can choose to receive notifications about these updates directly on your phone.
More information about Helsinki region public transport: hsl.fi

bluejetty:00021076:ios.description:
Modern Age is a classic geopolitical, economic, and military strategy, where you have to appear in the role of the president of the modern state.
Are you ready to become a president of Russia or the USA?
Maybe Afghanistan will flourish under your rule?
You can lead any modern state.
Manage the state, explore new technologies, and expand your territory. Fight other countries and prove yourself as a wise president and successful military leader! Your civilization needs a strong leader! 
War System
Annex states and kingdoms, send troops to capture resources. Build a fleet, prepare military units, buy or produce military equipment. Erect airfields, arsenals, barracks, and shipyards. Send spies and saboteurs.
Ministries
Manage the ministries. Make the life of your citizens better and safer. 
This will help you: the police, the security service, the Ministry of Health, Education, Defense, Infrastructure, etc.
Diplomacy
Sign non-aggression pacts, trade agreements, build embassies. Participate in UN work, put forward resolutions.
Laws and Religion
Make laws depending on the chosen path of civilization development. Choose the official religion of your state.
Production and Trade
Produce food and raw materials for the manufacture of goods. Get resources. Trade with other states.
Taxes
Will you bet on production or high taxes? What is your strategy?
And much more awaits you in the most epic game in the genre of military strategies for mobile devices! Are you ready to become a president? Which path do you choose? Will you become a dictator or a mild president? Your choice and your strategy will be the key to the success and prosperity of the country and the whole civilization.
You can play the game without access to the Internet.
Terms of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula
