bluejetty:00073677:ios.description:
Get there faster with Banktivity
Take your budgeting and money-management skills to the next level – fast – with Banktivity’s powerful suite of macOS/iOS tools, insights and strategies.
BANKTIVITY: A PROVEN APPROACH TO BETTER MONEY MANAGEMENT
For more than 20 years, tens of thousands of focused, disciplined and ambitious people like you have relied on Banktivity to help them achieve all their financial goals. And quite often, faster than they ever imagined.
No matter where you are on your financial journey, Banktivity provides the Clarity, Confidence, Control and Certainty you need to make the very most of your money. Safely. Securely. And Privately. 
A PLACE FOR EVERYTHING
One of the greatest advantages of Banktivity is bringing all your financial accounts into one place. Our Direct Access service connects to more than 14,000 banks worldwide, automatically delivering your latest transaction to all your macOS/iOS devices. And our set-up assistant imports all your old data and downloads current transactions from your bank account online.
THE BIG PICTURE FOR GREATER CONTROL
Your financial picture couldn’t be clearer with all of your accounts – checking, savings, credit cards, real estate, mortgages and brokerage – securely connected to Banktivity. You’ll easily track, categorize, tag, reconcile and manage every transaction (including online bill pay). Do it all yourself or let Banktivity’s transaction templates do it for you.
And with Banktivity’s “Update Everything” button, you can easily update all your accounts all at once. Sync devices, download Direct Access data, security prices, even currency exchange rates.
BUDGETING YOU CAN LIVE (AND SAVE) WITH
The best budget is based on reality. And the reality is there are things we have to pay for and things we want to buy. Banktivity’s Envelope Budgeting is built around this belief and lets you assign money to different categories. Recurring bills, day-to-day living expenses and those things we’d like to do or have. And any money not spent in one category carries over into your savings.
Banktivity automatically budgets scheduled transactions – bills and paychecks – categorized to your Envelope Budget. And you’ll always know well how you’re tracking with Banktivity’s visually-driven Budget vs. Actual reports.
INVESTMENT MANAGEMENT MADE EASY 
Banktivity’s intuitive investment features helps you better manage stocks, bonds, mutual funds, IRAs, 401(k)s, CDs and other assets. You can track buys, sells, splits, dividends, options and more. And Banktivity calculates IRR, ROI, and gains and losses. You can even choose which lots you sold from.
Built-in report templates (Income & Expense, Net Worth, Payee Summary and more) dynamically analyze your finances. You can assign tax codes to generate Tax reports or export to TurboTax. Or view holdings in the Portfolio of Investment Summary reports – presented in comprehensive graphics that let you drill down for details, export or print.
ON THE GO, IN THE KNOW
No matter where you are, you can enter transactions with Banktivity for iPhone. And you can sync accounts, budgets and investments to all your macOS/iOS devices. Should you need help or have questions, we provide unlimited email support, U.S.-based Live Chat (Mon-Fri, 9AM- 4PM EST) for quick solutions. Plus, there’s easily-accessed Help Files, Support Articles, and video tutorials.
A CHOICE OF 3 SUBSCRIPTIONS TO MEET YOUR NEEDS
From budgeting and goal-setting basics to handling the complexities of managing multiple assets, international stocks and currencies, you’ll find a plan that meets your exact needs.  And when you consider, Banktivity subscribers save on average an extra $500 every year, every Banktivity subscription pays for itself many times over!
No matter what financial goals, if you want to get there faster, you need to get Banktivity.

bluejetty:00065907:ios.name: CrazyStone DeepLearning
bluejetty:00065907:ios.summary:
The strongest, the best Go app in the world based on Crazy Stone employing Deep Learning technology ! 
*New Features*
-We have introduced an online game feature. Enjoy online games against players all over the world !
-IAGA Rating Certific
bluejetty:00065907:ios.description:
The strongest, the best Go app in the world based on Crazy Stone employing Deep Learning technology ! 
*New Features*
-We have introduced an online game feature. Enjoy online games against players all over the world !
-IAGA Rating Certification Tests 
Challenge the Dan/Kyu tests provided by the International AI Go Association.
-Premium Membership 
Completely ad free, higher levels and additional features for Premium Members.
Crazy Stone has made a huge step forward by combining Deep Neural Networks with Monte Carlo Tree Search. The highest level of Crazy Stone Deep Learning has achieved 5d in kgs rating and in this lite version, we have provided you the highest level of 2d for FREE!
* 17 levels of play from 15k to 2d
There are 17 levels of play (15k-2d) for all the board sizes.
Crazy Stone has improved not only in strength, but also in his style of play and the lower levels are perfect for players who want to learn the game of Go.
Now, the strongest level for Premium Members is 5d. 
* IAGA Rating Certification Test 
Challenge the Dan/Kyu tests provided by the International AI Go Association. You will be awarded certificate images if you pass the tests.
(You will need to register an AI Game Account to challenge the tests. Registration is free)　
* Export and import sgf game files
You will be able to import and export game records in sgf format from other apps. Also you can copy game record data to the clipboard.
* Rating Mode 
Test your skills with serious games against the AI, keeps track of the results of your games and the history of your rating!
The Rating Mode will be partly unlocked if you reach 7k IAGA Rating. If you become a premium member, all of the Rating Mode features will be unlocked immediately.
* Other features
・Friendly 3 input methods
You can choose from 3 options of input methods (Zoom, Cursor & Touch).
・17 levels of play for each board size (9x9, 13x13, 19x19)
・Human vs Computer, Human vs Human (sharing a single device) 
・Computer vs Computer Games 
・Handicap games, variable options of Komi
・Hint (suggest)
・Instant Undo (available even when the computer is thinking)
・Automatic territory calculation
・Japanese/Chinese Rules 
・Suspend/Re-start games
・Save/Load game record in sgf files
・Automatic and manual replay of a game record 
・Highlight the last move
・COM resign feature
・Byoyomi games 
 (You will not be able to select computer level in timed games)
・Atari warning
・Highlight the last move
・Play speed can be adjusted 
■ Subscription Details
The benefits of Premium Members are:
-Completely ad free
-Maximum AI playing strength will rise to 5dan
-Play Rating Mode for all 3 board sizes
-Challenge the IAGA Certification Tests higher than 7kyu 
About the subscription
-Monthly Subscription for Premium Membership.
-Customers will be charged a monthly fee to their iTunes Account.
-The Subscription will be renewed automatically unless cancelled more than 24 hours before the end of it's current period.
-Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal.
How to cancel the subscription
-Form the app
Touch the Manage Subscription button and then touch Cancel Subscription.
-From your device
Move to Settings > iTunes Store and App Store > Apple ID > Subscription
-It is not possible to prorate usage fees, cancel or refund the subscription for the current period.
-After cancelling the subscription, you will be able to play Engine Server Games until the current subscription period expires.
Privacy Policy https://www.unbalance.co.jp/privacy/en/igominna/
Terms of Use https://www.unbalance.co.jp/eula/en/igominna/
* This app is certified by International AI Go Association

Introducing MyCleaner - the ultimate phone storage cleaning and organising app for your iPhone and iPad!

Enjoy the duo's puppet-like behaviour as you move their arms and legs into the correct yoga positions shown in the top corner. Enjoy the zen sounds of the water and zen environment as you have fun posing the fitness couple. Namaste, have fun, and enjoy this zen experience.

Namaste, have fun, and enjoy this zen experience.

bluejetty:00150101:ios.name: RapidIdentity App
bluejetty:00150101:ios.summary:
Identity Automation makes it easier than ever to provide an additional layer of security when signing into work and personal apps with the RapidIdentity Mobile Application. 
The RapidIdentity Mobile Client enables organizations to use Push
bluejetty:00150101:ios.description:
Identity Automation makes it easier than ever to provide an additional layer of security when signing into work and personal apps with the RapidIdentity Mobile Application. 
The RapidIdentity Mobile Client enables organizations to use Push and Time-based One-Time Passcode (TOTP) authentication methods in place of passwords or as a second verification step during the login process to RapidIdentity and RapidIdentity SSO enabled applications. RapidIdentity TOTP works offline and does not require any cellular or wifi connection. 
The RapidIdentity Mobile Client can also generate TOTP passcodes for RapidIdentity and other personal SaaS services and web applications that support mobile-generated passcodes, enabling users to consolidate other authentication tools into a single app. It supports all the same apps supported by Google Authenticator, including Gmail, LastPass, Evernote, Dropbox, Facebook, and much more.
With the RapidIdentity Mobile App, you can also lock specific passcodes behind a PIN or your phone Touch ID, so even if your phone is taken, your codes are not left exposed.
When an organization employs RapidIdentity Mobile Client to facilitate authentication to their environment, it is necessary to have RapidIdentity Server version 4.8.2 or later to ensure the mobile device can receive notifications from RapidIdentity Server.

bluejetty:00130570:ios.summary: Ever wondered how you’ll look as you grow older or what you looked like as a child? Age Swap: AI Face Aging App is your time machine for seeing yourself at every stage of life, from baby to age 120, in high-definition detail. Dive into life
bluejetty:00130570:ios.description:
Ever wondered how you’ll look as you grow older or what you looked like as a child? Age Swap: AI Face Aging App is your time machine for seeing yourself at every stage of life, from baby to age 120, in high-definition detail. Dive into lifelike aging transformations that reveal your future look and let you relive your past, all in one app!
Age Yourself – Experience Every Chapter
From infancy to old age, Age Swap’s advanced AI brings each age to life with remarkable realism. Select a specific age to see how you’ll look, or explore different stages with a single tap. It’s not just an aging app—it’s an experience of your life journey.
Age Reel – Share Your Life in Motion
Our Age Reel feature takes your aging journey to the next level, creating a seamless animation of your transformation from baby to 120 years old. Watch your life unfold and share this unique, captivating reel with friends and family on social media. Age Reel is perfect for anyone who loves to play with transformations and see their future self in a whole new way.
Discover Your Past and Future
Want to see yourself as a toddler, a young adult, or in your senior years? Age Swap offers precise aging transformations for each stage, allowing you to explore every phase of life. Whether you’re curious about your past or looking forward to your future self, Age Swap makes it easy to see every age.
Group Age Swap – Fun with Friends and Family
Beyond individual transformations, Age Swap lets you age as a group. Planning a reunion? Generate laughs by seeing how everyone will look at your 50th reunion, or bring back nostalgic memories by turning your group into toddlers again. Want to see your favorite band as they might look in the future or as a group of young kids? With Age Swap, it’s all possible. Perfect for sharing and creating unforgettable moments with friends, family, and social media.
Why Choose Age Swap: AI Face Aging App?
Age Swap is more than a typical photo editing app. With its dedicated focus on age transformations, it’s perfect for anyone who wants to explore their look through the ages. From baby to elder, Age Swap delivers realistic results that are fun, insightful, and shareable. Join the Age Swap community and discover yourself through the years!
Privacy-Focused Design
We prioritize your privacy. Age Swap works directly on your device, so no photos are uploaded or shared externally. Your data remains safe and secure.
Privacy Policy: https://thepbstudios.co/privacy/
EULA: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00175229:ios.name: Access - by McGraw Hill
bluejetty:00175229:ios.summary:
Learn when you want, where you want, and how you want. Access is your personal medical resource that makes studying easier and more efficient.
Search across a number of medical resources such as videos, podcasts, images, infographics, and t
bluejetty:00175229:ios.description:
Learn when you want, where you want, and how you want. Access is your personal medical resource that makes studying easier and more efficient.
Search across a number of medical resources such as videos, podcasts, images, infographics, and textbooks, including Harrison’s Principles of Internal Medicine or Tintinalli’s Emergency Medicine, so that you can learn in a way that suits your style and time constraints.
• Find and save resources - search anything from symptoms to procedures and then favorite, or save to a collection.
 • Refine by content type - get the type of content you want to suit your learning style or time constraints.
 • Search within content - find the fine details you need.
 • View figures and tables - view content in its entirety, or just the images and tables.
 • View content offline - whether it’s a case of bad wifi, or you are traveling, you can always take your content with you.
 • Curate new collections - save content into your own personal reference library, so you always know where your favorite resources are.
 • Personal dashboard - create and personalize your own dashboard, allowing you to tailor the Access experience to your needs.
 • Caters to your specialty - This app has content from the full Access suite of sites, which cater to the following specialties; general medicine, anesthesiology, biomedical science, cardiology, dermatology, emergency medicine, hematology medicine, neurology, advanced practice nursing, ObGyn, pediatrics, pharmacy, physiotherapy, and surgery.
This app's content is only fully accessible to users that are linked to an institution that subscribes to a McGraw Hill Access product. All users are offered seven days to link their profile to their subscribing institution.

bluejetty:00018942:ios.description:
Bubble Wars – Played by over 10 million users across the world, is an epic bubble shooter game featuring amazing bubble busting levels and addictive gameplay with serious bubble shooting and popping fun. Get on a war with the colorful world of bubbles, literally. What’s more? This bubble shooting game is completely FREE! 
Make a combination of 3 or more bubbles with same color to make them explode! To make it more exciting, the entire army of bubbles sits on a spinning ring full of bubbles. Each time you shoot the bubbles, the bubble ring spins, thus changing the dynamics of your strategy in real time. Challenge your hunger and test your skills to shoot, pop and defeat the army of bubbles in Bubble Wars..
## Challenging Game Modes ##
Attack mode: Shoot colored bubbles at the bubble spinner circle and try to shrink it. If you get 3 or more colors in a row the bubbles burst and are destroyed. Otherwise the circle can grow again. Once it is large enough to hit you, the game ends.
Defend modes: Shoot colored bubbles at a bubble spinning ring that surrounds you. If you get 3 or more colors in a row the bubbles burst are destroyed. Otherwise the ring can start shrinking around you. Once it reaches you, the game ends.
## Awesome Features ##
-- Exciting Gameplay
-- Exploding Bubbles – Just Point and Shoot 
-- Multiple Bubble Combinations
-- High Scores to keep a tab and challenge yourself. 
-- Fast Paced Arcade Game
-- Accurate and Simple controls
-- Continuous updates 
-- And much much more...
Original and widely played bubble shooter arcade game is back with serious fun and shooting challenges of course.  
Thanks for playing Bubble Wars and we would love to hear back from you!

bluejetty:00039880:ios.description:
The Autel Charge application bring you an excellent experience when you're charging on Autel MaxiCharger at home or on the road. 
 The advantages of our intelligent charging solutions for home use include:
• Scan the QR code on your home charger to streamline the setup and configuration process. 
• Link Autel charge card to start and stop charging via it.
• Fast and convenient charging via the Autostart feature. 
• Schedule charging sessions during off-peak times to reduce electricity costs. 
• View real-time charging statistics including: Power usage, energy costs, charging amperage, charge duration and much more! 
• View monthly energy consumption details. 
• Set your local energy prices to calculate charging costs using home chargers. 
• Distribute charging power evenly within a charger group to maximize charging efficiency within limited total charging power via dynamic load balancing.
• Home Charger Sharing supporting sharing home chargers with other drivers for extra revenue.
• Fast and convenient self-service invoicing for reimbursement of charging costs. 
• Convenient management of charge records by exporting charge history as Excel files by month. 
When on the road, the Autel Charge application offers the following features: 
• Start and stop charging using your Autel Charge card or by scanning the QR code on the public charger. 
• Displays the availability status of public chargers on the map. (available, in-use, out of order, etc.)
• Filter chargers displayed on the map by desired connector types. 
• Filter by required charging power on the map. 
• View site information within the map including pictures, address, energy prices, hours of operation, quantity of chargers and connectors. 
• Navigate to a desired site using the integrated navigation map. 
• Link your credit card to streamline the payment process using public chargers. 
• Scan QR code to start and stop the charger with just one tap.

 The advantages of our intelligent charging solutions for home use include:
• Scan the QR code on your home charger to streamline the setup and configuration process. 
• Link Autel charge card to start and stop charging via it.
• Fast and convenient charging via the Autostart feature. 
• Schedule charging sessions during off-peak times to reduce electricity costs. 
• View real-time charging statistics including: Power usage, energy costs, charging amperage, charge duration and much more! 
• View monthly energy consumption details. 
• Set your local energy prices to calculate charging costs using home chargers. 
• Distribute charging power evenly within a charger group to maximize charging efficiency within limited total charging power via dynamic load balancing.
• Home Charger Sharing supporting sharing home chargers with other drivers for extra revenue.
• Fast and convenient self-service invoicing for reimbursement of charging costs. 
• Convenient management of charge records by exporting charge history as Excel files by month. 

When on the road, the Autel Charge application offers the following features: 
• Start and stop charging using your Autel Charge card or by scanning the QR code on the public charger. 
• Displays the availability status of public chargers on the map. (available, in-use, out of order, etc.)
• Filter chargers displayed on the map by desired connector types. 
• Filter by required charging power on the map. 
• View site information within the map including pictures, address, energy prices, hours of operation, quantity of chargers and connectors. 
• Navigate to a desired site using the integrated navigation map. 
• Link your credit card to streamline the payment process using public chargers. 
• Scan QR code to start and stop the charger with just one tap.

Perfect for Puzzle Lovers!

Download now and start sliding your way to victory!

bluejetty:00076665:ios.description:
The private family journal trusted with 240+ million memories. From bump to birthdays and beyond — save every photo, video and milestone in one safe place, beautifully organized by child.
NEW! Transform your memories into premium Photo Books you can hold forever — created effortlessly from your most-loved moments already in BackThen. Our most requested feature, minus the hassle.
WHY FAMILIES CHOOSE BACKTHEN
1. Private & secure — You control who sees what. No ads. No data-sharing. Ever.
2. Effortlessly organized — Photos auto-sorted by child on their own timeline.
3. Full resolution — We never compress your images. Your memories, kept at their best.
4. Timelapse magic — Watch how their face changes over time with our unique technology.
5. Photo Books & prints — Create premium keepsakes from the photos already in your app.
6. The whole family — Grandparents, aunts, uncles — everyone included on any device.
DESIGNED FOR EVERY STAGE
• Pregnancy Journal — Track bump photos, maternity moments & milestones
• Newborn & Baby Book — Document firsts, growth markers & everyday memories
• Growing Up — Build a lasting digital family album from year to year
SAVE & ORGANIZE
• Auto-organize from any device — mobile or desktop
• Ordered chronologically from the moment you save — every photo and video in the right place
• Photos at full resolution, videos at any length, unlimited milestones including height & weight
• Each child gets their own timeline, viewed together or individually
• Find any moment with instant scroll or search by date
SHARE SECURELY
• Invite family and friends — you set their permissions
• Everyone gets notified when new memories are added
• 100% private — no ads, no data-sharing, no exceptions
LOOK BACK & ENJOY
• Unique timelapse technology shows how their face changes
• Fun sibling and cousin comparisons at the same age
• Auto-created highlights, flashback reels and animated stickers
PRINT YOUR FAVORITES
• NEW: Premium Photo Books — beautifully laid out, printed to the highest quality
• Auto-created calendars, montages and prints from your favorite photos
• Available in the UK, US, Canada and Europe
• Printed locally using your original-resolution photos for the best results
TRUSTED BY MILLIONS
• From the team behind Lifecake — the original online childhood journal, founded in 2012
• Connecting families across 182 countries
• All devices welcome — iOS, email, web & other mobile platforms
TRY IT FREE
• 1GB free storage to try all features
• VIP subscription: £4.99 / $6.49 / €5.99 per month
• Nothing to lose — all your content returned if you choose to leave
Questions? support@backthen.app
Privacy: https://www.backthen.com/privacy
Terms: https://www.backthen.com/terms

bluejetty:00068300:ios.description:
Bose Connect unlocks the full potential of your Bose Bluetooth® Product. 
EASY ACCESS TO EVERYTHING
Get quick access to the key features on your products, like the auto-off timer, volume control, and battery readings. And it’s the easiest way to manage multiple Bluetooth connections. But that’s just the beginning.
SHARE THE MUSIC
MUSIC SHARE lets you listen together. Now two pairs of Bose® wireless headphones can share the experience - listen together, at the same time, while one of you DJ’s. New PARTY MODE lets you sync two SoundLink® speakers for double the audio…ideal for listening in two different places, and new STEREO MODE immerses you in music by separating the sound into Left and Right channels across two paired speakers for that amazing stereo experience.
GET THE MOST OUT OF YOUR HEADPHONES
CONTROLLABLE NOISE CANCELLATION on our QC®30 headphones lets you decide how much of the world to let in by adjusting the level of noise cancellation right in the app. And the built-in HEART RATE MONITOR for our SoundSport® Pulse headphones displays your heart rate clearly in the app.
AND SO MUCH MORE
From viewing product details to personalizing settings, get the most out of your Bose wireless products. It even downloads the latest software in the background and only installs it when you’re ready. See how our simple app can make all the difference.
 * NOTE * 
Bose Connect works with Bose Frames, QC®35, SoundSport® wireless, SoundSport® Pulse wireless, SoundSport® Free wireless, QuietControl™ 30, SoundLink® wireless II, ProFlight® headphones, and SoundWear Companion speaker, SoundLink® Color II, SoundLink® Revolve, SoundLink® Revolve+, SoundLink® Micro, and S1 Pro® speakers   
Some features may not be available for all products.
The Bluetooth® word mark and logos are registered trademarks owned by Bluetooth SIG, Inc. and any use of such marks by Bose Corporation is under license.
https://www.bose.com/en_us/legal/california_privacy_notice_of_collection.html
https://worldwide.bose.com/privacypolicy 
Location
Location access is optional and is used only for the Find My Buds feature. Find My Buds uses your device's location to help identify the last known location of your earbuds. If you do not use Find My Buds, you can decline location access and continue to use the rest of the app. Location information used by Find My Buds is stored locally on your device and is not transmitted to Bose.

Ace the TEAS Without Losing Your Sanity
Studying for the ATI TEAS exam? Let’s be real, it’s a lot. Science, math, reading comprehension, and grammar rules you haven’t thought about since middle school. But don’t worry, we made an app that won’t waste your time, speed up your studying, and make sure you ace your TEAS the first time.
EZ Prep’s TEAS Study App is the fastest, smartest, and least painful way to crush the TEAS and get on with your nursing school dreams. Whether you're at home, stuck at work, or ignoring your responsibilities in the bath, study on the go with personalized questions, snark‑free explanations, and a slick app that actually works offline.
THIS IS AUTHENTIC CONTENT
Written by real educators and nurses who have actually taken the exam, the app is aligned with the latest ATI 2025 TEAS 7 blueprint so you’re not just studying random trivia. You’re studying what’s actually on the test.
What You Get:

bluejetty:00162327:ios.description:
لعبة أسئلة وأجوبة عربية ممتعة ومتنوعة: اختبر معرفتك عبر عشرات التصنيفات ومستويات متزايدة الصعوبة، واجمع النقاط وافتح الإنجازات.
ما يقدّمه التطبيق:
• تصنيفات متعددة: معلومات عامة، دين، تاريخ، جغرافيا، علوم، رياضة وغيرها.
• مئات المستويات مع أسئلة اختيار من متعدد، وأسئلة صور وألعاب تركيز.
• اللعب بدون إنترنت: المستويات المحمّلة تعمل دون اتصال وتُزامن نقاطك لاحقًا.
• إنجازات ومكافآت: اجمع النقاط، حافظ على سلسلة الأيام، وافتح الإنجازات.
• حساب وملف شخصي: احفظ تقدّمك على أكثر من جهاز.
• اختبارات أونلاين إضافية عند توفر الاتصال.
• المجتمع: غرفة عامة ورسائل خاصة بين اللاعبين (لمن هم 13 عامًا فأكثر)، مع إمكانية الإبلاغ عن أي رسالة وحظر أي لاعب، ومراجعة البلاغات من فريق الإدارة.
• نقاط قابلة للكسب: مشاهدة إعلان قصير أو شراء نقاط، واشتراك اختياري لإزالة الإعلانات.
ملاحظات:
• التطبيق مجاني ويحتوي على إعلانات، ويمكن إزالتها باشتراك اختياري مدفوع.
• المحتوى الذي ينشئه المستخدمون في المجتمع قد يحتوي على آراء اللاعبين، ويمكنك الإبلاغ عنه أو حظره في أي وقت.

bluejetty:00156350:ios.summary: Wake up without the jolt. Wonderwake is a gentle alarm clock built for better sleep and a slower rise - fade-in nature sounds, no cortisol spike, no panic. Rest easy knowing your gentle wake-up is automatically backed up by your iPhone’s sy
bluejetty:00156350:ios.description:
Wake up without the jolt. Wonderwake is a gentle alarm clock built for better sleep and a slower rise - fade-in nature sounds, no cortisol spike, no panic. Rest easy knowing your gentle wake-up is automatically backed up by your iPhone’s system alarm, so you won’t oversleep.
Bring the same gentleness to the rest of your day with a power nap timer, circadian rhythm insights and sleep tracking.
Standard alarms force your body awake with a shock. The adrenaline fades, but the grogginess - sleep inertia - lingers for hours. You reach for coffee before you've had a moment. The day starts before you're ready for it.
Wonderwake dissolves that pattern. Volume rises so slowly you barely notice it's happening. Sound grows into your morning instead of tearing you out of sleep.
HOW IT WAKES YOU
- Fade-in alarm: choose how gradually volume rises and create a sunrise-style effect as gentle sound fills the room
- Nature sounds and calming melodies: birdsong at dawn, rain on leaves, ocean waves, ambient chimes, and more
- Smart backup: a loud iPhone system alarm sounds at your set time if gentle sounds haven't woken you, so you won't oversleep
- Alarm shuffle: a different gentle sound each morning so your brain never tunes it out
- Custom alarm sounds: import your own audio for a more personal wake-up
- Sunrise alarm & wake-up light: turn your smart lamp into a sunrise alarm. Wake up to gradually brightening light and calming sounds for a gentler morning. Works with compatible Apple HomeKit lamps and bulbs.
YOUR DAY, YOUR RHYTHM
- Circadian rhythm & body clock: explore your likely energy peaks and dips throughout the day, with guidance on when to focus, rest and wind down
- Power nap timer: a second clock mode for daytime rest. Choose a quick 20-minute nap or a longer break, and see how your duration aligns with estimated sleep cycles
- Quiet Hours: block the apps you keep doomscrolling, from social feeds to endless videos. Schedule a break for bedtime, focused work or a calmer morning
- Dream journal: save your dreams and morning reflections
- Ready in under a minute: no account, no onboarding, open and set your alarm
- Sleep cycle alarm: enter your sleep goal, Wonderwake finds the ideal wake-up window based on your cycles
- Sleep schedule coach: find your bedtime window with Sleep Gate and build consistent bedtimes and wake times, week by week
- Sleep tracking & sleep debt: explore your sleep history and estimated sleep debt using Apple Health data from compatible wearables, or Phone Motion estimates without a watch
- Lock Screen and Dynamic Island live activity for at-a-glance alarm status
- Privacy built in: your data is protected, no hidden sharing
WHO IT'S FOR
You've tried every alarm app and still wake up tense. You're building a slow morning ritual - maybe a 5am start, a meditation alarm, a mindfulness practice before the noise begins - and a single jarring alarm undoes all of it. You're a light sleeper and the wrong sound at the wrong moment ruins your whole night.
You hit snooze four times, not because you're lazy, but because waking always feels like an emergency. You're sensitive to sound and a standard alarm leaves you with a headache or anxiety before the day has even started. You have ADHD and sensory shock from a loud alarm sets the wrong tone for everything that follows.
WHAT USERS SAY
"The best wake up alarm, period." - The_next_big_thing (AU)
"Every morning I get the sound of nature easing me out of sleep and it works every time. The volume is gradual and won't leave you in a panic." - Halliba (UK)
"This app fits all my needs and gently wakes me up whenever needed. Well designed UI is just a cherry on top." - Deniz Ozmaden (US)
Try it free for 7 days. No payment required.
Your morning doesn't have to start with a shock.
Terms of Use: https://wonderwake.app/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://wonderwake.app/privacy/
Questions? Ideas? Let us know at dev@somnify.org

bluejetty:00065959:ios.name: DRAGON QUEST II
bluejetty:00065959:ios.summary:
The second instalment in the celebrated Dragon Quest series finally comes to mobile! Explore fair lands and foul dungeons in this all-time classic RPG!
Every wondrous weapon, spectacular spell and awesome adversary in this rich fantasy wor
bluejetty:00065959:ios.description:
The second instalment in the celebrated Dragon Quest series finally comes to mobile! Explore fair lands and foul dungeons in this all-time classic RPG!
Every wondrous weapon, spectacular spell and awesome adversary in this rich fantasy world is yours to discover in a single standalone package. Download it once, and there’s nothing else to buy, and nothing else to download!
※In-game text is available in English only. 
◆ Prologue
A century has passed since the events of DRAGON QUEST, during which time three new nations have been founded by the offspring of the great hero of Alefgard.
But the peace they have long enjoyed is no more. Demon hosts summoned forth from the darkness by the fallen High Priest Hargon have brought the land to the brink of ruin once again.
Now, the young prince of Midenhall—a descendant of the legendary warrior Erdrick—must set out to find the two other heirs to the heroic bloodline so that together they might defeat the nefarious Hargon and restore peace to their world.
◆ Game Features
・Whether you’re keen to pick up where the first part of the Erdrick Trilogy left off, or are entirely new to the series, DRAGON QUEST II: Luminaries of the Legendary Line is sure to take you on an unforgettable journey.
・In this early example of an open-world adventure, players are free to wander the wilds, brave monster-infested dungeons, or take to the seas in search of new lands—discovering ever more powerful abilities and valuable treasures along the way!
・Simple, Intuitive Controls
The game’s controls are designed to work perfectly with the vertical layout of any modern mobile device, and the position of the movement button can be changed to facilitate both one- and two-handed play.
・Experience the multi-million selling series, beloved both in Japan and beyond, and see how the masterful talents of series creator Yuji Horii first combined with the revolutionary synthesizer sounds of Koichi Sugiyama and the wildly popular manga illustrations of Akira Toriyama to create a gaming sensation.
[OS Compatibility]
iOS 12.0 or higher

bluejetty:00133172:ios.description:
Chatbot AI Plus is a powerful, AI-powered virtual assistant that can help you manage your daily tasks, answer your questions, and even write and chat for you. With its advanced natural language processing capabilities, Chatbot AI Plus can understand your voice commands and written queries, and provide you with accurate and helpful responses in real time. Whether you need to schedule a meeting, look up a recipe, or just have a casual conversation, Chatbot AI Plus is always ready to assist you.
Core Features: -
Voice and Text Chat: -
Chatbot AI Plus can chat with you in both voice and text formats, providing a flexible and natural user experience. You can ask it questions, tell it to perform tasks, or just chat about your day.
Personalization: -
Chatbot AI Plus can learn your preferences and interests over time, and tailor its responses to your specific needs. Whether you're looking for news, weather, or entertainment, Chatbot AI Plus can provide you with recommendations that are relevant to you.
Writing Assistance: -
With Chatbot AI Plus, you can dictate your emails, texts, and other written documents, and it will convert your speech into text automatically. You can also ask Chatbot AI Plus to proofread and edit your writing, providing helpful suggestions and corrections.
Data Privacy: -
Chatbot AI Plus takes your privacy and security seriously, and will never share your personal information with third parties. All your data is encrypted and stored securely on your device.
Overall, Chatbot AI Plus is an innovative and powerful AI app that can help you be more productive, informed, and connected. Whether you're at home, at work, or on the go, Chatbot AI Plus is always ready to assist you.
Download Now!
INFORMATION REGARDING THE SUBSCRIPTION
Full access to all available features is limited to subscribers. There are different terms to choose from. If you opt for a subscription, you will pay the price set for your country and displayed in the app. If you don’t cancel the subscription at least 24 hours before the end of the current term, it will automatically renew for the originally selected period and your deposited payment method will be charged. You can also disable the auto-renew feature in your App Store account settings.
For more information, please visit the link https://support.apple.com/en-us/HT202039
Privacy Policy: http://prettyboamedia.com/privacy-policy/
Terms of Use: http://prettyboamedia.com/terms-conditions/

bluejetty:00018523:ios.description:
Application Description:
Zain Cash is an electronic mobile payment service that allows you to have complete control over your financial life, with secure and convenient means to conduct financial transactions and process monthly payments. Download the Zain Cash app, register it on your mobile wallet and get a Mastercard. To subscribe, all you need to do is visit any Zain shop or authorized agent.
You can now use your mobile phone to pay bills, transfer money locally, top-up your mobile account, buy pre-paid internet and voice balances and many other features at any time and place.
Not only is it secure, but the application offers access to a set of user-friendly services to conduct transactions easily. The services are available to all local mobile network operators’ subscribers and can be activated through Zain shops and/or authorized agents. The service is regulated by the Central Bank of Jordan CBJ (JOMOPAY).
Some of the main services offered by Zain Cash are:
Digital Vouchers
Corporate
Transfer money locally 
Pay bills 
Buy prepaid cards
Cash deposit and withdrawal
Group disbursement funds
Reporting tools 
Remote QR and POS payments
Online shopping 
eFAWATEERcom payments
For more information, please visit the website mentioned below: jo.zain.com/english/zainservices/zaincash

Make studying feel like a game! Sovi uses spaced repetition and active recall to help you memorize faster. Practice with custom cards, or explore folders free pre-made decks shared by students. Take multiple-choice quizzes, and organize your files with our simple, minimalistic aesthetic.
► EMOTIONAL SUPPORT CHATBOT
 Experience an AI chat assistant that cares about your well-being. Sovi provides patient, personalized guidance for complex study topics while acting as a sounding board to relieve stress and everyday anxiety. Whether you need a step-by-step breakdown or just someone to listen, Sovi is your 24/7 companion.

 Sovi combines the best tools across mobile and web. Build your ultimate routine with:
 • Assignment Helper: Upload a full, multi-page assignment at once for an all-in-one, step-by-step study guide PDF. No more snapping questions one by one.
 • AI Notes & Cheatsheets: Instantly organize and review class materials.
 • AI Writing Assistant: Perfect your essays and writing assignments.
► ALL SUBJECTS, ANY LEVEL
 From middle school to college, Sovi adapts to your exact learning level across Math, Biology, Chemistry, Physics, Statistics, and more. Fill knowledge gaps, build long-term understanding, and confidently tackle Test Prep (AP®, SAT®, ACT®, GRE® and school exams).
► EXPERT MATH GUIDANCE
 Sovi provides deep conceptual support for almost every math topic:

Main Features:
* Draw everything what you want with the tools and colors what you like.

* Change the background color by pressing on the ColorsPicker.

* Import photos from your album or take pictures through camera or choose images from template to trace, annotate, and have fun with them.
* Save your drawings to your Photos Library.
* Print your drawings to AirPrint enabled printers.
* Draw together and share with your friends and family through the social media app. Just send your drawing to them and they can open it and draw on it too and then send it back.

Transfers

Locations

bluejetty:00185426:ios.description:
The Tower of Hanoi (also known as the Tower of Brahma or Lucas' Tower) is a classic mathematical puzzle.
The objective is to move the entire stack of disks from the leftmost peg to the rightmost peg, following these simple rules:
- One at a time: Only one disk can be moved at a time.
- Top disk only: You can only move the topmost disk from any peg.
- Size matters: A larger disk can never be placed on top of a smaller disk.
Challenge yourself and see how many levels you can conquer!
Features：
- 26 progressive difficulty levels
- Screen Gesture supported.
- Supports wrong move alert
- Supports undo moves
- Supports resuming game
- Game Center supported
Subscriptions:
-------------------------------
* Premium Features: 3 Months ($2.99)
* premium Features: 1 Year ($8.99)
The subscriptions auto-renews at the end of the term, unless cancelled 24 hours in advance. Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal.Subscriptions may be managed by you and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to your Account Settings after purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when you purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.
Term of privacy: http://www.jijijaja.com/apps/privacyGame.htm

bluejetty:00127188:ios.description:
The easy place to relax is with you wherever you go thanks to the official Smooth Player app. 
You’ll enjoy free and unlimited access to all your favourite Smooth FM stations, an endless playlist of songs you know and love, the latest news, sport and finance on the go, plus hundreds of podcasts to explore from the NOVA Entertainment Podcast Network.
Features:
- Listen live to Smooth FM stations wherever you are with local news, traffic and weather.
- Keep track of your favourite Smooth FM shows and switch between different music playlists.
- Enjoy more music and radio stations than ever before from within the app switch from Smooth FM to Nova, FIVEAA and Star 104.5 with a swipe.
- Access on-demand news from within the Player sourced from our partners including The Australian, News24, The Daily Telegraph, Fox Sports Australia, and News.com.au.
- Listen your way through hundreds of podcast titles in the Nova Podcast Network.
- Choose from news, sports, comedy and entertainment titles with new content uploaded daily.
- Listen with Apple CarPlay
- Enter Smooth radio competitions for your chance to win!
From Michael Bublé to the Bee Gees, Backstreet Boys to George Michael, Madonna to Robbie Williams, the Smooth FM playlist includes all your favourite music to shut out the noise of everyday life. 
Join hosts Cameron Daddo, Richard Wilkins, David Campbell Bogart Torrelli, Ty Frost, Simon Diaz & Byron Webb as they take you on your smooth listening journey with more music, less talk.
Listen to:
- Smooth FM 95.3 Sydney
- Smooth FM 91.5 Melbourne
- Smooth FM Adelaide
- Smooth FM Perth
- Smooth FM Brisbane
- Smooth Relax
- Smooth 80s
- Smooth Vintage
- Access all of NOVA Entertainment's FM and AM stations including Nova, Star 104.5 and FIVEAA.
- Listen to our Partner stations, such as News24 Radio, The Rock, Coles Radio, FOX SPORTS News and talkSPORT
- Plus hundreds of podcast titles on the NOVA Entertainment Podcast Network

bluejetty:00128549:ios.description:
Lock your notes. Only you can access them.
Secure Notes is a private and secure notes app designed to protect your thoughts, passwords, voice memos, and sensitive information. Everything is encrypted on your device, and even we cannot read your data.
If you need a truly private place for your notes, Secure Notes gives you full control, strong protection, and a simple experience that works every day.
Built for real privacy
- Your notes are yours. Always.
- No tracking
- No analytics on your content
- No data selling
- No external access to your notes
All data is stored securely on your device and, if enabled, inside your private iCloud account.
This is not just a locked notes app — it is built for real privacy.
Powerful protection
Secure Notes uses multiple layers of protection to keep your data safe.
3-layer security: lock the app, folders, and individual notes
Face ID, Touch ID, or passcode protection
Lock specific notes with additional security
Encrypted storage on device
Designed to prevent unauthorized access
Your notes stay protected even if your device is lost or accessed by someone else.
Write, record, and organize
Capture everything in one place.
Secure text notes for daily use
Voice notes up to 10 minutes
Speech-to-text: transcribe any voice note with one tap
Markdown editor with formatting support
Live preview for better writing experience
Organize notes into folders
Whether you are writing ideas, journaling, or storing important information, everything stays private and accessible.
Sync across your devices
iCloud sync between iPhone and iPad
Instant updates across devices
Your data remains under your control
No external servers. No unnecessary exposure.
Designed for speed and simplicity
Fast and responsive performance
Clean, modern interface
Dark mode support
No ads or distractions
Reliable experience every day
Additional features
Trash recovery for up to 30 days
Improved text rendering
Enhanced Markdown editing
Notifications to stay on top of your notes
Continuous performance improvements
Why people choose Secure Notes
Private journaling and personal thoughts
Password and sensitive information storage
Financial tracking and private records
Health notes and personal logs
Recovery phrases and secure data storage
Anything you want to keep hidden, protected, and under your control.
Security you can trust
All notes are encrypted and stored locally unless you enable iCloud sync.
We do not have access to your data and cannot read your notes.
Deleting the app removes all unsynced data permanently.

bluejetty:00069074:ios.name: Aysa
bluejetty:00069074:ios.summary:
From VisualDx, Aysa is the easy-to-use app to get personalized answers to your skin condition questions. Aysa helps you screen your skin symptoms and prepare for your practitioner visit.
Key Features and Privacy:
· Symptom Checker:
bluejetty:00069074:ios.description:
From VisualDx, Aysa is the easy-to-use app to get personalized answers to your skin condition questions. Aysa helps you screen your skin symptoms and prepare for your practitioner visit.
Key Features and Privacy:
· Symptom Checker: Use the phone's camera to take a picture of your skin concern & Aysa quickly finds symptom matches to provide personalized, helpful information about the symptoms, all while protecting your privacy.
· Symptom Content and Images: Symptom content and images to help improve user awareness about them.
· Equity in care: Image library has representation of all skin types, including the leading skin of color image collection.
· Privacy: Aysa protects your privacy by encrypting your image as it is sent to our machine learning model and discarding it immediately after analysis.
About VisualDx and Aysa:
Your skin is unique; skin conditions can look different from person to person. Aysa is built on the resources of VisualDx, the award-winning clinical decision support software focused on equity in medicine for over 20 years. Its curated library of more than 120,000 medical images includes every skin color and type, and what each of 200 skin conditions can look like at every stage. The workflow even allows you to select skin color, ensuring the best information and images possible.
Aysa knowledge and recommendations are based on best available evidence ordered according to standard industry protocols, interpreted by expert opinion. Best available evidence is evaluated by source type, statistical validity, and clinical suitability. Content includes materials adapted from leading textbooks, literature review articles, PubMed, the US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC), the World Health Organization (WHO), and Infectious Diseases Society of America (IDSA). Leading content sources are reviewed, as is medical literature in general, with ongoing targeted searches in MEDLINE and PubMed. Editorial contributors and staff follow a protocol from most to least evidence: from meta-analyses and systematic reviews of randomized controlled clinical trials to cohort studies to case-control studies to case series to individual expert opinions.
More Info:
Terms of Use: http://www.visualdx.com/legal/acceptable-use-policy-notice 
Privacy Policy can be found here: https://askaysa.com/visualdx-privacy-policy/
The support URL can be found here: https://askaysa.com/contact/

bluejetty:00198925:android.summary:
Periodic Table PRO - is a mobile chemistry assistant on your phone. It is an organizational chart representing all chemical elements in an ordered form by atomic number, electron configuration, and chemical properties.
The main components
bluejetty:00198925:android.description:
Periodic Table PRO - is a mobile chemistry assistant on your phone. It is an organizational chart representing all chemical elements in an ordered form by atomic number, electron configuration, and chemical properties.
The main components of the table include horizontal rows (periods) and vertical columns (groups or families). Each element is represented by a symbol and an atomic number. As you move from left to right and from top to bottom, the atomic numbers and electron configuration of the elements change, reflecting patterns in their chemical behavior.
The periodic table helps to better understand the properties of elements, their relationships and trends. It is also useful for predicting reactions and researching new materials, as well as simplifying chemistry learning and practical applications.
Using our application you can easily answer any question related to Chemistry, for example: what is the atomic mass of Samarium and Polonium?
What is the melting point of Rubidium, what is its RTEC and CAS number?
In what year and by whom were Bromine, Gold, Sulfur and Livermorium discovered?
What does Bismuth, Molybdenum, Indium, or Argon look like?
Benefits of the PRO version:
- More interactive tables
- Chemical dictionary
- Atomic mass calculator
- Chemical reactions
- More than 3200 isotopes
- Chemical Element Notes
- Favorite properties and quick access to them
- Improved filtering in the search engine
Additional properties of Chemical Elements:
+ Molar heat of vaporization
+ Molar heat of fusion
+ Specific heat capacity
+ Thermal expansion
+ Liquid density
+ Volumetric modulus of elasticity
+ Young's modulus of elasticity
+ Heat transfer coefficient
+ Speed of sound
+ Refractive index
+ Poisson's ratio
+ Shear modulus
+ Brinell hardness
+ Mohs hardness
+ Vickers hardness
+ Half-life
+ Radioactivity
+ Period of existence of an element
+ Name of spatial symmetry group
+ Number of spatial symmetry group
+ CID number
+ RTEC number
+ Nuclear effective cross section
+ Standard electrode potentials
+ Molar volume
+ Country of discovery

CodeREADr is an enterprise-grade barcode scanner and data capture app used by businesses and integrated by developers for capturing, validating and tracking data (AIDC).

You can collect data with form fields, secondary scans, multiple choice answers, drop-down menus, photos, GPS locations, and signatures. You can record and validate the data embedded in each scanned barcode and know who scanned (app usernames), what they scanned (i.e. barcodes, RFID/NFC, OCR), when they scanned (timestamps), where they scanned (GPS), how they scanned (capture type), and why they scanned (your configured workflow).
To try the app, simply register within the app or at CodeREADr.com to use our Free Plan (limited to 50 scans per month). 
Ideal for ticket validation, access control, inventory, asset tracking, logistics, attendance, security patrols, lead retrieval, coupon/voucher/loyalty programs, retail price audits, scan-to-order services, and more.
The app uses the devices built-in camera but you can optionally use rugged, dedicated scanning devices and accessories with standard keyboard emulation. 
Features: 
* Fast, accurate scanning of print and mobile barcodes using the device's own camera.
* Secure, real-time recording and validation of every scan. 
* Manage users, databases, services, and more with the integrated SaaS web service. 
* Scan offline for recording and validation with Auto-Sync in the background.
* Simply hover the camera over the target barcode to read it.
* Scan up to 50 commercial, industrial and medical barcode types. 
* SD PRO Scan Modes: Batch (captures up to 100 barcodes in a single camera view), Framing (select decoding window), Targeting (targets one code among many), Selecting (preview multiple codes and select), and Triggering (simulates pressing a button or trigger to scan a specific barcode).
* SD PRO Rule-Based Scanning: Create rules to scan only the barcode(s) you want to capture in the camera view.
* Auto-Next-Scan for continuous, repetitive scanning (no need to press any buttons).
* Kiosk Mode for unattended applications and to hide in-app settings.
* Developer API, Postback URL and Direct Scan to URL for using your own servers.
* Scan Mask technology (Pattern Matching) if no database is available.
* Import databases. Export barcodes.
* Custom question-answer scripts for form data.
* Conditional and custom validations of scanned and collected data.

apple-macos:6760547827.name: HARETO: AI Travel Journal
apple-macos:6760547827.description:
Ask, and the AI writes the day up as a photo journal.
From an afternoon out to a long trip around Japan.
Plan it, record it and look back on it with family or friends, in one journal.
■ Turn a day into a photo journal
• Ask, and the AI writes the day from your plans, photos, places and notes
• Choose the tone first, then rewrite any of it
• Move the photos, show one large, leave some out
• At the end, ask for a summary of the trip
■ Recording is just collecting
• Photos from that time appear as suggestions, matched on your iPhone; only what you add is uploaded
• The roads you took, kept on the map, by hand or automatically in hours you set
• Notes, voice input, impressions, costs, bookings, reusable packing lists
• Weather where you are heading, at home and abroad (Japan Meteorological Agency / MET Norway)
■ It starts with a place you want to go
• Save places with no date on them, with travel times between them
• Give a place a date and it becomes a plan; a day that will not fit is flagged
• Tell the AI your destination, interests and pace; it builds the day around your saved places, yours to edit
■ One journal, made together
• Invite family or friends with a 6-digit code or a link
• Photos land on the day they were taken, so everyone's shots share one itinerary
• Anyone on the trip can edit a plan; impressions stay per person, with names
• Companions join on the free plan; storage and seats follow the trip creator's plan
■ Long trips stay in order
• Three views: Plan the days, Schedule to record them, Memories to read them back
• Split a long trip into sections by area or period and jump to any day
■ Publish it, take it with you
• Publish to Everyone's Trips, or unlisted for people with the link
• Hide home and other places, choose which hours go out; tracks are coarsened
• Share images and fly-through 3D movies of your route, plus PDF export: a journal for after, an itinerary for before
■ You can start without an account
Plans, records, photos, GPS tracks and packing lists work without signing in. Cloud storage, AI journals, sharing, Everyone's Trips and export need one.
■ Who it is for
• People who take the photos but never write the trip up
• Families and friends who want one record, not five camera rolls
• Anyone on a long trip, a road trip or van life
■ Why it is built this way
The developer rode the length of Japan and found that the longer a trip runs, the sooner the record stops: evenings go on planning tomorrow, leaving nothing for today's record. So planning and recording sit side by side, and the journal goes to the AI.
■ Free, Plus and Premium
Records, plans, GPS tracks and packing lists are unlimited on every plan. Paid plans raise cloud storage, AI allowance and seats.
• Free: 300 cloud photos, 3 AI journals and 1 AI plan a month, 2 people per trip, one shared trip
• Plus: 5,000 photos, 30 AI journals and 10 AI plans a month, 4 people, unlimited shared trips
• Premium: 15,000 photos and 5 GB of video, 60 AI journals and 20 AI plans a month, 6 people, unlimited shared trips, no HARETO logo
Photo figures are cloud storage limits, not device limits, counted across the trips you created. AI uses count against whoever ran them.
Auto-renewing subscriptions
• HARETO Plus and HARETO Premium: monthly (1 month) or yearly (1 year)
• Prices appear in your currency in the app and in the In-App Purchases list on this page
• Charged to your Apple ID at purchase; renews for another period of the same length unless auto-renewal is switched off at least 24 hours before the period ends, and renewal is charged in those 24 hours
• Cancel or change plan in iPhone Settings > your name > Subscriptions > HARETO; access runs to the end of the paid period. Refunds follow Apple's process
